name: Loaded Pretzel Bombs
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. Dijon mustard, plus more for serving (optional)
4 1/2 oz. cheddar, shredded, combination of white and yellow if desired(about 1 2/3 cups)
instructions: In a large, cold skillet, cook bacon over medium heat, turning occasionally, about 8-12 minutes or until crisp. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate. Discard all but 1 tsp. bacon fat.

Reduce heat to medium-low. Cook scallions, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl. Let bacon and scallions cool. Transfer bacon to a cutting board and finely chop. (Alternatively, crumble bacon with fingers.) Transfer back to a paper-towel-lined plate or to a small bowl.

In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium-high speed, beat cream cheese until smooth, about 1 minute. Add mustard, pepper, and cooled scallions and mix with a spoon or spatula until just combined. Add cheddar, mozzarella, salt, and bacon and mix until just combined.
Transfer dough onto a lightly floured surface and divide into 4 equal pieces (about 158 g each). Form each into a smooth ball. Cover and let rest for 15 minutes.

Working one piece at a time, roll dough into a 6” rope, starting from the center and working toward the ends. Divide rope into 3 equal pieces (about 53 g each), tucking any added dough underneath to reach the correct volume. Roll each piece into a smooth ball.

Turn dough balls smooth side down. Flatten or stretch to a 3” round. Using a small cookie scoop, place 1 ½ tsp. filling in the center. Bring 3 edges of dough up and over the filling, firmly pinching seams to seal. Turn dough seam side down and gently shape dough until smooth and taut.
Transfer filled balls to a parchment-lined baking sheet. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 30 minutes and up to 12 hours.

Prepare a paper-towel-lined baking sheet and set aside. In a large pot, bring water and baking soda to a boil. Carefully add each dough ball, smooth side down, until floating, about 10 seconds. Using a fine-mesh sieve, transfer to the paper-towel-lined baking sheet, smooth side up. Let drain for 10 minutes.
Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°. Double-stack 2 baking sheets and line each with 2 pieces of parchment. Spray parchment with cooking spray.
Arrange 6 balls on each prepared sheet. Brush each dough ball with egg wash, coating all sides. Using sharp scissors, snip an “X” onto top of each round. Generously sprinkle with coarse salt.
Bake for 20 minutes, then increase oven temperature to 400° and continue to bake until deeply golden brown, about 10 minutes more. Serve warm.
description: Our loaded pretzel bombs are stuffed full of bacon and three types of cheese and wrapped in a homemade pretzel bun.

name: Churro Sandwich Cookies
ingredients: 1/3 c. (71 g) packed light brown sugar
1/3 c. (66 g) plus 1/2 cup (100 g) granulated sugar, divided
1 tbsp. plus 3/4 tsp. ground cinnamon, divided
8 tbsp. dulce de leche, store-bought or homemade
A piping bag, a large star or ridged tip
instructions: In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium-high speed (or in the large bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment), beat butter, brown sugar, salt, 1/3 cup granulated sugar, and 3/4 tsp. cinnamon until pale and fluffy, 2 to 3 minutes. Beat in egg and vanilla until combined. Beat in cream of tartar and baking soda. Add flour and beat on low speed until just incorporated. Cover and refrigerate until cold, about 1 hour.
Arrange racks in upper and lower thirds of oven; preheat to 350°. Line 3 baking sheets with parchment.
In a small bowl, stir remaining 1/2 cup granulated sugar and 1 Tbsp. cinnamon.
Scoop dough into 1-Tbsp. portions (about 20 g each). Roll each ball in cinnamon sugar, then arrange 8 rounds on each prepared sheet for a total of 24.

Bake 2 sheets of cookies, rotating sheets top to bottom and front to back halfway through, until puffed and set around the edges, 9 to 11 minutes. Do not overbake; cookies will continue to set as they cool.
Let cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes, then transfer cookies to wire racks and let cool completely. Repeat with remaining cookies.

In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment (or in a medium bowl, using a handheld mixer), beat butter, cinnamon, and salt on medium-high speed until light and fluffy, 2 to 3 minutes.
Add confectioners' sugar and beat until incorporated. Add cream and continue to beat until light and fluffy, 2 to 3 minutes more.
Transfer buttercream to piping bag fitted with star tip. Pair cookies by size and arrange flat side up on a clean work surface.

Pipe a ring of buttercream around the edge of 1 cookie from each pair. Fill the center with about 2 tsp. dulce de leche. Top with remaining cookie, flat side down, and gently press to sandwich together.
description: Our churro sandwich cookies feature chewy cinnamon sugar cookies filled with cinnamon buttercream and a rich dulce de leche filling.

name: Sheet-Pan Quesadillas
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. In a large skillet over medium heat, heat olive oil. Add bell peppers and onion and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Remove from skillet and set aside. Add ground beef to skillet and cook, breaking up meat with a wooden spoon, until beef is no longer pink, about 5 minutes. Drain fat, then stir in cumin, chili powder, paprika and season with salt and pepper.

On a half sheet, place 6 tortillas around the edges of the pan so that about half of each tortilla hangs over side. Place another tortilla in the center to cover pan completely, then top with ground beef, pepper and onion mixture, cheeses, and green onions.

Place another tortilla in the center (on top of all fillings), then fold each tortilla towards center. Place a second baking sheet on top of tortillas (to help quesadilla hold is shape!) and bake until tortillas are beginning to turn crispy, about 20 minutes. Remove baking sheet from on top and continue baking until tortillas are golden and crispy, about 15 minutes more.
Slice into rectangles and serve warm with sour cream and pico de gallo.
description: Make serving a crowd easier than ever with these sheet-pan quesadillas. They're not only so easy to prepare, but are loaded with your favorite fillings.

name: Apple Cheddar Bundles
ingredients: 2 medium Honeycrisp apples (about 1 1/4 lb.), cored, sliced 1/8" thick
1 (17.3 oz.) frozen package puff pastry, thawed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400° and line 2 sheet trays with parchment. In a medium bowl, toss apples, lemon zest, and 4 tablespoons honey.

Cut each pastry sheet into 4 (4.5" x 4.5") squares for a total of 8. In a small bowl, whisk egg with a splash of water. Brush outer edges of pastry with egg wash. Rotate pastry squares so a corner faces you. Place 1 tablespoon grated cheese on the bottom. Top with 10 to 11 apple slices. Place 1 tablespoon grated cheese on each side of apple slices. Fold left side over top and lightly press to seal. Fold right side over top and press to seal. Brush tops and sides of pastry with egg wash; sprinkle with sea salt. Arrange 4 pastries on each prepared tray.
Bake puffs, rotating trays halfway through, until pastry is puffed up and golden brown around the edges, 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes.
Arrange on a platter. Drizzle with remaining 2 tablespoons honey. Top with pecans and thyme.
description: Cheddar, apples, and honey are the stars in this fall favorite recipe, which includes store-bought puff pastry, pecans, and fresh thyme.

name: Peanut Butter-Stuffed Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. granulated sugar, plus more for rolling
instructions: Preheat oven to 350° and line two large baking sheets with parchment paper. Make filling: In a medium bowl, combine peanut butter and powdered sugar and mix until smooth. Using a 2-teaspoon cookie scoop, scoop into 22 small balls and freeze until hardened, 30 minutes.

In a large bowl, combine butter, brown sugar, and sugar and beat until light and fluffy, then add egg and vanilla and mix until evenly combined. Add the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt and mix until evenly combined.

Scoop a heaping tablespoon of the cookie dough and flatten into a pancake-like circle on the baking sheet. Place a frozen peanut butter ball on top. Bring the edges of the dough around the peanut butter ball and pinch the edges together to seal, adding more dough if necessary to cover the frozen peanut butter completely.
Roll stuffed cookie dough ball in sugar and place back on prepared baking sheets. Repeat until all dough is used, spacing the cookies about 2” apart.
Bake until the cookies are set, about 12 minutes. Serve warm or at room temperature.
description: Gooey peanut butter and rich chocolate come together in this irresistible stuffed cookie recipe.

name: Eggs Benedict Hash Brown Bites
ingredients: 8 slices Canadian bacon, cut into 2″ rounds or squares
1/2 cup store-bought or homemade hollandaise sauce, warmed
Thinly sliced chives and smoked paprika, for serving
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 450°. Place 3 tots in each of 8 wells of a standard 12-cup muffin tin.
Bake tots for 10 minutes. Remove from oven. Using the bottom of a small measuring cup or a spoon, flatten tots into a single layer; season with a pinch of salt.
Continue to bake until tots are crisp and adhering to each other, 8 to 10 minutes more. Let cool slightly, then transfer to a platter.
Meanwhile, one at a time, crack eggs into a small fine-mesh sieve to strain some of excess egg white. Pour each egg into individual small bowls or ramekins.
Fill a medium pot halfway with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low to maintain a very gentle simmer; the bubbles should barely be breaking the surface.

With your bowl hovering over the water, gently drop one egg into simmering water. Gently stir water around egg, keeping it moving in a circular motion. Repeat with another egg to cook 2 eggs at the same time.
Cook until whites are set, 3 to 4 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer to a paper towel-lined plate. Repeat with remaining eggs; season with a pinch of salt.
Top each tater tot base with a slice of bacon, then top with a poached egg and 1 Tbsp. hollandaise sauce. Sprinkle with chives and paprika.
description: Our Eggs Benedict hash brown bites are sure to satisfy all of your breakfast cravings.

name: Boman Martinez-Reid’s Harissa Egg  Wild Rice Bowl
ingredients: Handful of walnuts or your favorite nuts, crushed
instructions: Cook rice according to package directions.
Meanwhile, in a medium skillet over medium heat, heat oil. Fry eggs sunny-side up; sprinkle with harissa while they cook.
Place hot cooked rice in a large bowl. Add avocado. Squeeze juice of lemon over and stir to combine. Add harissa seasoning to taste and stir again. Fold in walnuts.
Transfer rice mixture to a serving bowl. Top with sunny-side-up eggs. Finish with a light sprinkle of turmeric.
description: Boman Martinez-Reid stopped by the Delish Test Kitchen to teach us how to make his harissa egg and wild rice bowl.

name: Butternut Squash Latte
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz. freshly brewed espresso or 2 oz. freshly brewed coffee
instructions: In a medium pot over medium heat, bring milk, cardamom, squash, brown sugar, and allspice to a simmer. Remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes, then strain through a fine-mesh sieve into a small bowl; discard solids.
Using a frother or small whisk, vigorously mix until frothy, if desired.
Pour espresso into a mug. Stir in salt. Top with foamed milk, then sprinkle with turmeric. Garnish with cinnamon stick.
description: Creamy, warmly spiced, and just sweet enough to feel like a treat, our butternut squash latte is everything you love about the season in a single, sippable mug.

name: Bagel Breakfast Sliders
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°. Grease a 13” x 9” baking dish with cooking spray.
In a large bowl, whisk eggs and milk until light and frothy.
In a cold, large skillet over medium heat, cook bacon, turning occasionally, until crispy, 8 to 10 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate. Pour off all but 1 Tbsp. fat.

Pour egg mixture into skillet. Cook over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally with a spatula or wooden spoon, until eggs are nearly set, 2 to 3 minutes; season with salt and pepper and stir in chives. Remove from heat.

Spread cream cheese onto bottom halves of bagels. Arrange in prepared dish, side by side. Spread egg mixture over bagels. Crumble bacon over. Sprinkle with cheddar, then close with top halves of bagels. Brush tops with melted butter. Sprinkle with everything bagel seasoning.
Bake sliders until bagels are toasted and cheese is melted, about 10 minutes.
description: This recipe transforms the classic grab-and-go breakfast sandwich into a shareable start to your day that any brunch crowd will be obsessed with.

name: Crispy Hash Brown Breakfast Tostadas
ingredients: Hot sauce (such as Frank’s), for serving
instructions: In a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat, heat oil. Add hash brown and cook, undisturbed, until browned on the bottom, 1 to 2 minutes.

Flip hash brown and, using a lightly greased burger press or spatula, gently press down to flatten. Loosen patty with a spatula to ensure it’s not sticking, then cook until browned on the bottom, 1 to 2 minutes more.
Flip hash brown; lightly season with salt. Top with cheese. Cover and cook until cheese is melted, about 30 seconds.
Transfer to a plate. Top with egg. Sprinkle with bacon (if using). Serve with hot sauce alongside.
description: In our crispy hash brown breakfast tostadas, a store-bought frozen hash brown patty is pressed and pan-fried until crisp, then topped with cheese, a fried egg, and crispy bacon for a fast, satisfying bite that hits every crunchy, cheesy note.

name: Jelly Donut French Toast
ingredients: 1 loaf brioche, cut into 6 thick slices, preferably day old
3 tbsp. butter, plus more as needed
instructions: In the bottom of each slice of bread, make a 2” wide slit to create a pocket, being careful not to cut all the way through.
Fill a pastry bag or resealable baggie with jam and fill each pocket with jam.
In a large shallow bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, and vanilla. Dip each slice of bread in mixture, turning to coat.
In a medium skillet over medium heat, melt butter. Working in batches, add bread to skillet and cook until golden, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Repeat with remaining slices, adding more butter as needed.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve immediately.
description: Our jelly donut French toast combines the jammy filling of a jelly donut with the pillowy soft goodness of French toast, and, of course, plenty of powdered sugar.

name: Slow-Cooker Pumpkin Butter
ingredients: 1/3 c. (71 g) packed light brown sugar
1 tbsp. plus 1 tsp. pumpkin pie spice
instructions: In a slow cooker (at least 2 qt.), mix pumpkin puree, granulated sugar, cider, brown sugar, pumpkin pie spice, vanilla, and salt until combined.
Cover and cook on High, stirring every hour, until desired consistency is reached, 2 to 3 hours.
Let cool slightly, then transfer to mason jars and refrigerate until ready to use.
description: You'll want to eat this easy slow-cooker pumpkin butter with everything this Fall.

name: Dole Whip Mimosas
ingredients: 1/4 c. sugar, for rimming champagne flutes
instructions: Pour sugar onto a shallow dish. Run a pineapple wedge around 6 champagne flutes and dip in sugar. Set aside.
In a tall glass, stir together pineapple juice and coconut milk until combined. Pour into champagne flutes and top off with champagne.
Garnish each flute with whipped topping and a fresh pineapple wedge.
description: Want to jazz up your boozy brunch? Try these Dole Whip Mimosas from Delish.com.

name: Blueberry Cornbread
ingredients: 1 tbsp. vegetable oil or melted butter
instructions: Preheat a grill to 400° and bank coals to one side or, if using a gas grill, turn off burners on one side to create an indirect heat zone. (If baking in an oven, preheat to 400°.) Grease a 10" cast-iron skillet with oil.

In a medium bowl, whisk cornmeal, flour, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt to combine. In a large bowl, whisk eggs until combined, then whisk in butter, sour cream, and milk. Using a rubber spatula, fold in dry ingredients until no streaks remain.
Pour half of batter into prepared pan. Sprinkle 1 cup blueberries over, then top with remaining batter. Top with remaining blueberries and sprinkle with granulated sugar, if using.

Place cast-iron skillet on grill over indirect heat and cover grill. Bake, making sure temperature remains consistent, until cornbread is golden brown and firm to the touch, and a tester inserted into center comes out with a couple moist crumbs attached, 25 to 30 minutes. (If baking in an oven, place cast-iron skillet in center of oven and bake 25 to 30 minutes.) Let cool at least 15 minutes before serving.
description: Featuring a crisp, buttery crust and blueberries galore, this easy skillet blueberry cornbread will become your new favorite cookout classic.

name: Breakfast Crunchwrap Supreme
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together sour cream, lime juice, jalapeño and paprika. Season with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Bake frozen hash brown patties according to package instructions.

In a large bowl, combine eggs and milk and whisk until frothy. In a medium nonstick pan, melt butter over medium heat. Pour egg mixture into the pan. Let set slightly then reduce heat to medium-low. Drag the eggs with a spatula or wooden spoon to create curds. When the eggs are almost cooked to your liking, season with salt and pepper. Fold in chives and remove from heat.

Spread the jalapeño sauce onto the center of each flour tortilla, then top each with a hash brown patty, scrambled eggs, bacon, cheddar and Monterey Jack. Fold tortillas around the center, creating pleats. After wrapping, quickly invert crunchwraps so the pleats are on the bottom and they stay together.

In a medium nonstick pan over medium heat, heat a very thin layer of vegetable oil. Working one at a time, add crunchwrap seam-side down and cook until tortilla is golden on the bottom, 3 to 5 minutes. Flip crunchwrap and cook until the other side is golden, 3 to 5 minutes more.
Repeat with remaining crunchwraps. Cut each in half and serve warm.
description: If you love the Taco Bell classic, skip the drive-thru and make it at home with our easy breakfast Crunchwrap Supreme recipe.

name: Blueberry Scones
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. (300 g.) all-purpose flour, plus more for surface
1/2 c. (1 stick) cold unsalted butter, cut into cubes, plus 2 Tbsp. unsalted butter, melted
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk flour, granulated sugar, baking powder, and salt. Add butter and cut into flour mixture with your hands or a pastry cutter until crumbles are the size of peas. Add blueberries and lemon zest and toss to coat.
Make a well in center of blueberry mixture. Pour egg, buttermilk, almond extract, and vanilla extract into well. Mix with your hands until just combined.

Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat to an 8" circle. Cut into 8 triangles and arrange on a large parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush scones with melted butter and sprinkle with coarse sugar. Freeze 10 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°. Bake scones until lightly golden, about 25 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack and let cool completely.
In a small bowl, whisk confectioners' sugar, lemon zest and juice, and cream until smooth, adding more cream if needed until desired consistency is reached.
Drizzle glaze over cooled scones.
description: These buttermilk scones have a sugary, crispy crust, a soft and pillowy middle, and pockets of juicy, exploding blueberries.

name: Fro-Yo Fruit Bites
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine yogurt, milk, honey and vanilla and whisk until smooth.
In an ice tray, distribute fruit in each of the cube molds.
Spoon yogurt mixture over fruit, filling molds completely. Freeze for 5 hours, or until frozen solid.
description: These fro-yo fruit bites combine yogurt, fresh fruit, and honey to create the perfect frosty snack or on-the-go breakfast.

name: How To Make Homemade Croutons
ingredients: 1 loaf of crusty bread, cut into 1" cubes (about 6 cups)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. In a large bowl, toss cubed bread with oil and butter until evenly coated. Add in salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, rosemary, and Parmesan, and toss to combine until evenly distributed. Divide seasoned bread between two large baking sheets.
Bake until golden and crispy, flipping halfway through, about 15 minutes total.
Let cool completely and store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.
description: Your croutons, your call. Grab some bread, a little oil or butter, your favorite spices or herbs, and get ready for some crunchy goodness to happen in just 20 minutes.

name: Buffalo Ranch Chickpea Wraps
ingredients: 1/4 head of napa cabbage, shredded (about 3 cups)
2 tbsp. thinly sliced chives or scallions
1/4 c. ranch dressing, plus more for serving
4 (10") high-protein or regular tortilla wraps, warmed
instructions: In a large bowl, drizzle chickpeas with oil; season with 1/2 tsp. salt and toss to combine. Sprinkle with ranch seasoning and toss to coat. Transfer chickpeas to an air-fryer basket; reserve bowl for sauce.
Cook at 400°, shaking basket halfway through, until crisp and starting to brown, 15 to 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, in another large bowl, toss cabbage, carrot, celery, and chives; season with remaining 1/2 tsp. salt. Add ranch dressing and vinegar and toss to coat.
In reserved bowl, whisk hot sauce, honey, and butter. Add chickpeas and toss to coat.

Divide chickpea mixture and cabbage mixture among tortillas. Top with cheese (if using). Fold in left and right sides of each tortilla, then fold end closest to you over filling. Tightly roll up from bottom end, keeping sides tucked in, to form a burrito shape. Cut each wrap in half.
description: These buffalo ranch chickpea wraps have that Buffalo flavor I love, in a meatless, handheld format that’s easy to take on the go.

name: Creamy Peanut-Lime Chicken With Noodles
ingredients: 2 tbsp. tamari or reduced-sodium soy sauce
2 small or 1 large boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 8 oz.), chopped into 1/2" pieces
1 small red bell pepper, seeds and ribs removed, thinly sliced
3 scallions, white and green parts separated, thinly sliced
1/3 c. roasted, salted peanuts, finely chopped
instructions: Bring a medium pot of water to a boil; generously season with salt. Add noodles and stir to prevent sticking. Remove from heat and let soak until tender, 13 to 15 minutes. Drain in a colander, then rinse with cold water.
Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, whisk peanut butter, chili sauce, tamari, sriracha, lime zest, lime juice, 1/4 tsp. salt, and 1/4 cup warm water until smooth; set aside.

In a large skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add chicken, season with salt, and cook, stirring often, until lightly golden in spots and almost cooked through, about 4 minutes. Add bell pepper, garlic, white scallion parts, and ginger; season with salt, if needed. Reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring often, until peppers are tender, about 3 minutes more.
Add noodles to skillet and toss well to combine. Remove from heat, add reserved sauce, and toss to coat.
Divide noodles among bowls. Top with green scallion parts, cilantro, basil, and peanuts. Serve with lime wedges alongside.
description: Creamy peanut butter combines with chili sauces, garlic, and ginger in this dinner for a sauce that perfectly coats rice noodles and chicken.

name: Chopped Greek Chicken Sandwich
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. coarsely chopped rotisserie chicken meat
1/3 c. coarsely chopped pitted Kalamata olives
instructions: In a large bowl, toss cucumber, tomato, onion, garlic, chicken, feta, and olives. Fold in tzatziki, lemon juice, oregano, pepper, and salt until combined.
Divide lettuce among rolls. Stuff with chicken mixture.
description: This chopped Greek chicken sandwich combines classic Greek salad ingredients with store-bought staples for a quick and easy lunch.

name: Spicy Tuna  Crispy Rice Bowls
ingredients: 4 c. cooked long-grain or sushi rice
Chili crisp and toasted seaweed snacks, for serving
instructions: In a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, heat 2 tsp. oil. Add rice and spread into an even layer. Using the handle of a wooden spoon, poke 5 to 6 holes throughout to let steam escape. Let cook, undisturbed, for 5 minutes.

Distribute remaining 3 tsp. oil into holes and around edges on pan. Continue to cook until bottom side of rice is very golden, 20 to 30 minutes more. You can add more oil as needed around the edges to encourage color. To check on rice, lift edges or near a hole in the center with a spoon. If you feel your stove has hot spots on it, rotate the pan every 5 minutes for even coloring.
Divide rice among bowls. Top with a scoop of spicy tuna, edamame, avocado, cucumbers, and scallions.
Drizzle with chili crisp and serve with seaweed snacks alongside.
description: This spicy tuna bowl with crispy rice and veggies is a quick and easy lunch we're obsessed with.

name: Starbucks Copycat S'mores Frappuccino
ingredients: 1/3 c. cold brew (or strong brewed coffee, chilled)
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine 1 tablespoon marshmallow fluff and 1 tablespoon heavy cream. Beat until smooth, then add remaining heavy cream and beat until stiff peaks form, 3 to 4 minutes.
Spread the remaining marshmallow fluff inside the bottom of your glass, then drizzle with chocolate syrup.

Add coffee and milk, then ice, and then vanilla ice cream into blender. Blend until smooth. Break graham cracker in half, then break one half into another half. Add 3/4 of the graham cracker to blender and reserve the last 1/4 for topping. Blend until smooth.
Pour drink into prepared glass and top with whipped marshmallow cream and a drizzle of chocolate syrup. Crush remaining graham cracker and sprinkle on top.
description: Coffee, marshmallow, chocolate, graham crackers, AND ice cream? Yes, please!

name: Copycat Costco Sheet Cake
ingredients: 2 (15.25-oz.) boxes white cake mix (we used Pillsbury)
A piping bag, a star tip
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat oven to 350°. Grease 2 (13" x 9") metal baking pans with cooking spray; line each with parchment, allowing excess to extend over the two long sides for easy removal.

In a large bowl (or the large bowl of a stand mixer), whisk cake mix and salt. Add egg whites, sour cream, milk, oil, and vanilla. Using an electric mixer on medium speed (or the paddle attachment of the stand mixer), beat until combined and no lumps remain, about 2 minutes.
Divide batter between prepared pans, smoothing to distribute across bottom of pans (batter will be thicker than typical box cake mix batter).
Bake cakes until lightly browned on top, pulling away from the sides of the pan, and springy to the touch, 20 to 25 minutes.
Let cakes cool at least 10 minutes in pans, then invert onto a wire rack and let cool completely.
Remove parchment. Using a serrated knife, trim domed tops off cakes. Discard cake (or save for snacking!).

In the large clean bowl of stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat cream cheese, confectioners’ sugar, and salt, scraping down sides of bowl as needed, until smooth, 1 to 2 minutes. Add milk and instant pudding and beat until combined, about 1 minute more. Scrape down bowl, then add heavy cream and continue to beat until thick and light, 1 to 2 minutes more.

Arrange one layer of cake on a platter. Top with mousse. Using an offset spatula, spread in an even layer, leaving a 1/2" border on all sides. Top with remaining cake, trimmed side down. Refrigerate cake until ready to use.
In the large bowl of stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat shortening, water, vanilla, and salt on medium-high speed until smooth and creamy.

Add 1 cup (113 g) confectioners’ sugar and beat on low speed just until combined. Continue to add confectioners’ sugar in 1-cup increments, beating after each addition, until all sugar is added. Increase mixer speed to medium-high and beat until smooth and fluffy, about 1 minute more.

Transfer one-quarter of frosting to a piping bag fitted with a star tip. Using offset spatula, frost top and sides of cake with remaining frosting. Pipe a shell border around top and bottom of cake as desired. Decorate with sprinkles (if using).
description: This copycat Costco sheet cake features layers of fluffy white cake filled vanilla cheesecake mousse covered with light and airy frosting.

name: Copycat TruFru
ingredients: 16 oz. fresh strawberries, tops removed, halved
1 1/2 c. dark or milk chocolate chips
1 c. dark or milk chocolate chips
instructions: Arrange strawberries cut side down on paper towels to soak up excess moisture.
In a small microwave-safe bowl, heat white chocolate chips and 1 Tbsp. oil in 30-second increments, stirring between each, until melted and smooth, about 1 minute total.
Using a fork, dip strawberry halves into chocolate. Tap fork on side of bowl to remove excess chocolate.
Arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Freeze until chocolate is hardened, about 15 minutes.
In another small microwave-safe bowl, heat dark chocolate chips and remaining 1 Tbsp. oil in 30-second increments, stirring between each, until melted and smooth, about 1 minute total.

Using fork, dip strawberries into dark chocolate. Tap fork on side of bowl to remove excess chocolate. Return to baking sheet. Continue to freeze until completely solid, at least 1 hour and up to overnight.
In a small microwave-safe bowl, heat white chocolate chips and 1 Tbsp. oil in 30-second increments, stirring between each, until melted and smooth, about 1 minute total.
Using a fork and working gently, dip raspberries into chocolate. Tap fork on side of bowl to remove excess chocolate.
Arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Freeze until chocolate is hardened, about 15 minutes.
In another microwave-safe bowl,heat dark chocolate chips and remaining 1 Tbsp. oil in 30-second increments, stirring between each, until melted and smooth, about 1 minute total.

Using fork, dip raspberries into dark chocolate. ztap fork on side of bowl to remove excess chocolate. Return to baking sheet. Continue to freeze until completely solid, at least 1 hour and up to overnight.
In a small microwave-safe bowl, microwave peanut butter until melted, about 45 seconds.
Using a fork, dip bananas into peanut butter. Tap fork on side of bowl to remove excess peanut butter. Arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Freeze until chilled, about 30 minutes.
In another small microwave-safe bowl, heat dark chocolate chips and oil in 30-second increments, stirring between each, until melted and smooth, about 1 minute total.

Using fork, dip bananas into dark chocolate. Tap fork on side of bowl to remove excess chocolate. Return to baking sheet. Continue to freeze until completely solid, at least 1 hour and up to overnight.
description: TruFru is pretty common in most grocery stores, but it’s also just fun to make your own at home. Plus, with my recipe, you can get versatile with whatever fruit or chocolate you prefer!

name: Baked Apple Oatmeal
ingredients: 4 tbsp. (1/2 stick) butter, melted, plus more, softened, for pan
1/2 tsp. ground cinnamon, plus more for sprinkling
1/4 c. honey, plus more for drizzling
2 small tart apples (about 12 oz.; such as Granny Smith), cored, peeled, and chopped (about 1 3/4 c.)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 13"-by-9" or 3-qt. baking dish with softened butter.
In a large bowl, whisk oats, baking powder, cinnamon, salt, and nutmeg.
In a medium bowl, whisk eggs, milk, honey, vanilla, and melted butter. Add to dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Stir in apples and walnuts. Transfer mixture to prepared dish.
Bake until oatmeal is just set and golden brown and apples are tender, 40 to 45 minutes. Let cool about 20 minutes. Serve warm with yogurt; drizzle with honey and sprinkle with cinnamon.
description: Baked apple oatmeal is studded with chopped apples and walnuts. It's perfect for big family brunches or make-ahead breakfasts.

name: Blueberry French Toast Casserole
ingredients: 1 (1-lb.) loaf unsliced challah, cut into 1" cubes (about 10 c.)
1/2 c. pure maple syrup, preferably robust
2 tbsp. unsalted butter, cut into pieces, plus more for dish
1/4 c. plus 1 Tbsp. turbinado sugar, divided
Whipped cream or Greek yogurt, for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°. On a large baking sheet, spread bread in an even layer and bake, stirring halfway through, until lightly toasted but not browned, about 10 minutes. Let cool on sheet.

Meanwhile, in a small saucepan over medium heat, bring syrup, orange zest and juice, 2 cups blueberries, and a pinch of salt to a simmer. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until berries have softened, released their juices, and only about half are still intact, about 10 minutes.
Transfer 1/2 cup blueberry sauce to a small bowl and stir in remaining 1 cup blueberries. Transfer remaining sauce to an airtight container, cover, and refrigerate until ready to use.

Butter bottom and sides of a 13" x 9" baking pan. In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium speed, beat eggs until well combined. Add milk, cream, vanilla, nutmeg, 1/4 cup sugar, and 1/2 teaspoon salt until smooth. Add bread, tossing, until well soaked, about 5 minutes. There will still be some custard in the bowl.

Spread about two-thirds of soaked bread in prepared pan. Spoon blueberry mixture over. Top with remaining bread, gently pressing down so top is an even height. Scatter butter pieces over, cover, and refrigerate 10 to 12 hours.
Let casserole and reserved blueberry syrup sit at room temperature while oven preheats; preheat to 350°. Sprinkle remaining 1 tablespoon sugar over casserole.
Bake casserole until puffed and the edges are crisp, about 45 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes.
Cut into large squares. Serve with blueberry sauce alongside. Dollop with whipped cream.
description: This recipe takes classic French toast ingredients of milk, sugar, and eggs and injects them with a heap of blueberries for a custardy, not-too-sweet breakfast.

name: Nutella-Stuffed Pancakes
ingredients: 2 tbsp. melted unsalted butter, plus more, softened, for cooking and serving
instructions: Onto a parchment-lined baking sheet, dollop 1 heaping tablespoon of Nutella and spread into a flat disc about 2" wide. Repeat with remaining Nutella. Freeze until solid, at least 30 minutes or up to 1 hour.

Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Make a well in the center and add egg, millk, and vanilla. While whisking, stream in melted butter and whisk to combine. Fold in dry ingredients until just combined. (Do not overmix; some lumps are okay.)
Heat a large griddle or nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot but not scorching, about 2 minutes.

Melt enough butter to cover surface of griddle, then pour a scant 1/4 cup batter onto griddle and smooth into a circle with the back of a measuring cup or ladle. Place a frozen Nutella disc in the center of batter and spoon a bit more batter on top of Nutella. Spread batter on top to cover Nutella.

Cook pancakes until bubbles form on top and sides start to lift from pan, 2 to 3 minutes. Flip and continue to cook until bottom is golden brown and pancake is fluffy, 2 to 3 minutes more. Transfer to a wire rack. Wipe off griddle, then repeat with more butter and remaining batter (you should get about 8 pancakes).
Divide pancakes among plates. Serve with syrup and more butter alongside.
description: These easy and fluffy Nutella-stuffed pancakes are the best way to upgrade your brunch game.

name: Strawberry-Rhubarb Breakfast Cake
ingredients: 1 c. (2 sticks) unsalted butter, room temperature
2 c. (400 g.) plus 2 tbsp. granulated sugar, divided, plus more for dusting (optional)
3 c. finely chopped fresh rhubarb (from about 4 stalks) or frozen rhubarb, thawed, drained, divided
3 c. sliced fresh strawberries (from about 1 lb.), divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 13" x 9" pan with baking spray. Line with parchment, leaving a 2" overhang on both long sides.
In a large bowl, whisk all-purpose flour, almond flour, salt, and baking soda until combined.

In another large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium-high speed (or in the large bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment), beat butter and 2 cups granulated sugar until light and fluffy, about 4 minutes. Add eggs, one at a time, beating to blend after each addition. Add almond extract and beat until combined.

Add half of dry ingredients and beat on low speed until just combined. Add buttermilk and remaining dry ingredients. Continue to beat on low speed until just combined. Fold 2 cups rhubarb and 2 cups strawberries into batter.
Spread batter into prepared pan. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup rhubarb, 1 cup strawberries, and 2 tablespoons granulated sugar.
Bake cake until light golden and a tester inserted into the center comes out clean, 65 to 75 minutes. Let cool completely in pan.
Using parchment overhang, lift cake out of pan. Dust with more granulated sugar, if desired, before slicing.
description: Life’s too short not to have cake for breakfast. As much as we like a hearty, savory meal in the morning, sometimes we deserve to indulge in something sweet.

name: Eggs Benedict Rolls
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 400°. Spray an 8" or 10" ceramic baking dish with cooking spray. Sprinkle bottom of dish with cornmeal.

In a medium skillet over medium-high heat, melt 1 Tbsp. butter. Working in batches if needed, cook bacon, turning occasionally, until edges start to turn brown, about 30 seconds per side. Transfer to a cutting board and cut into 1/2" pieces.

In a medium bowl, whisk eggs and milk. In a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat, melt remaining 2 Tbsp. butter. Cook egg mixture, gently stirring with a rubber spatula, until eggs scramble, about 30 seconds. Remove from heat and keep stirring until eggs are just beginning to cook, about 15 seconds. Return to medium heat and cook, stirring, until eggs are scrambled and just set, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat; season with salt and black pepper.

On a work surface, spread pizza dough to a 15" x 10" rectangle. Spread mustard over dough; season with cayenne. Top with bacon and scrambled eggs. Starting with the long side facing you, roll pizza dough into a log. Using a sharp knife, cut into 12 pieces about 1 1/2" wide. Arrange slices in prepared pan cut sides up.
Bake rolls until dough is golden brown, about 25 minutes.
In a standard blender or tall cup slightly wider than an immersion blender, blend egg yolks, lemon juice, salt, cayenne, and 1 tsp. water until frothy.
In a small skillet over medium-low heat, melt butter (or melt butter in a microwave in 10-second increments).
With the motor running on medium speed, slowly drizzle in melted butter in a thin stream. Continue to blend until sauce is emulsified, thick, and yellow in color.
Drizzle half of hollandaise on top of rolls. Top with chives. Serve remaining hollandaise alongside.
description: These eggs Benedict rolls transform one of our favorite brunch dishes into a shareable and crowd-pleasing roll form with pizza dough.

name: Breakfast Focaccia
ingredients: 1 rosemary sprig, leaves plucked, coarsely chopped
instructions: Coat a large bowl with 3 Tbsp. oil. In another large bowl, whisk flour, kosher salt, and yeast to combine. Add water and mix with a silicone spatula just until a wet dough forms. Transfer to prepared bowl. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit at room temperature until risen and doubled in size, about 1 hour.

Meanwhile, in a large stainless steel or cast-iron skillet over medium heat, heat 1 Tbsp. oil; swirl to coat pan. Add sausage and cook, breaking up into small pieces, until starting to brown on the outside, 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer sausage to a plate; reserve remaining oil in pan.
Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 450°. Grease a 13" x 9" metal baking pan with remaining 2 Tbsp. oil and reserved 1 Tbsp. sausage oil from skillet.

Transfer half of dough to prepared pan. Using your fingertips, spread as much as possible to each corner. Top dough with half of sausage crumbles and half of cheese. Place remaining dough on top. Using your fingertips, gently spread remaining dough over filling. Top with remaining sausage and cheese, then tomatoes and rosemary leaves.
Create 6 indentations in dough. Crack an egg into each; season with sea salt and pepper.

Bake breakfast focaccia, rotating pan halfway through and checking at around 20 minutes, until dough is puffed and golden brown, and egg whites are set but yolks are still slightly runny, 23 to 28 minutes. If you like your eggs more set, leave it in closer to 28 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes, then serve warm.
description: Reimagine classic focaccia into the ultimate breakfast featuring layers of crumbled breakfast sausage, shredded cheese, and juicy cherry tomato and jammy eggs.

name: Mini Steak & Egg Crunchwraps
ingredients: 3 tbsp. extra-virgin olive oil, divided, plus more for skillet
1 poblano chile (or 1 bell pepper), thinly sliced
Finely chopped fresh cilantro, for serving
Sour cream, salsa, and/or guacamole, for serving
instructions: In a large resealable plastic bag, combine sirloin, lime juice, tomato paste, chili powder, garlic powder, cumin, paprika, chipotle chile powder (if using), 1 Tbsp. oil, and 1 tsp. salt. Let sit at room temperature until ready to use.

Pour oil into a large skillet just to coat. Add onion and poblano chile; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and softened, 6 to 8 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

In a medium bowl, beat eggs until blended. In same skillet over medium heat, melt butter. Add eggs; season with salt and pepper. Cook, agitating occasionally, until eggs are scrambled to your liking, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl; wipe out skillet.

In same skillet over medium heat, heat 1 Tbsp. oil. Add steak mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 4 to 6 minutes. Transfer to plate with vegetables. Wipe out skillet.
Using a ring mold or cookie cutter, cut 3" rounds from the center of 6 tortillas (you might be able to get 2 rounds from a single tortilla).

Arrange 6 whole tortillas on a work surface. Divide steak, veggies, and eggs among whole tortillas. Top with cilantro and a tortilla chip. Pile cheese on top of chips. Top with cut-out tortilla rounds, gently pressing down. Fold edges of bottom tortillas up and around cut-out tortillas, creating pleats.

In same skillet over medium heat, heat remaining 1 Tbsp. oil. Arrange Crunchwraps seam side down and cook until golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes. Carefully turn and cook until other side is golden brown, about 3 minutes more.
Top with more cilantro. Serve with sour cream, salsa, and/or guacamole alongside.
description: Our mini steak & egg Crunchwraps take a classic Crunchwrap, shrink it down, and fill it with a breakfast medley of steak, eggs, peppers, onions, and cheese.

name: Baked Feta Frittata
description: A block of feta is placed into the center of a super-herby frittata and drizzled with harissa for an unbeatable brunch dish.

name: Crescent Roll Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 4 oz. cold cream cheese, cut into 8 pieces
1/3 c. sliced scallions (from about 3 scallions), plus more for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 13" x 9" baking dish with butter. In a small bowl, using a fork, mix cream cheese, scallions, and 1/2 tsp. salt.

On a work surface, spread out rolls. Divide cream cheese mixture among rolls, arranging on top of widest part. Roll up dough into a crescent roll, enclosing cream cheese mixture. Arrange on a diagonal in prepared pan.
In a medium bowl, whisk eggs, milk, cream, and Gouda; season with salt. Pour mixture around rolls, making sure not to pour directly on top. Sprinkle tops of rolls with everything bagel seasoning.
Bake casserole until eggs are puffy and set and rolls are golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes before serving.
description: Pop a can of crescent rolls, stuff 'em with scallion cream cheese, and bake in a frittata-style, savory egg custard to create this easy breakfast casserole.

name: Bee Sting Bagel Breakfast Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tbsp. store-bought or homemade hot honey, plus more for serving
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 400°. Spread bacon in a single layer on a foil-lined baking sheet, making sure not to overlap.
Bake bacon 15 minutes. Brush with hot honey. Continue to bake until honey is caramelized and bacon is crispy, about 10 minutes more. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain.
Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, combine cream cheese, scallions, and jalapeños; season with salt and pepper. Spread cream cheese mixture on cut sides of bagels.

In a medium bowl, beat eggs until blended. In a large skillet over medium heat, melt butter until slightly foamy. Add eggs. Using a spatula, gently nudge cooked egg edges toward center of skillet, tilting skillet so runny eggs move toward edges. Cook, maintaining a mostly undisturbed, thin layer of egg, until just set, 1 to 2 minutes; season with salt and pepper.
Top eggs with cheese. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until cheese is just melted, about 2 minutes more.
Divide eggs and bacon among 4 bagel halves. Top with more hot honey and hot sauce (if using). Close with remaining bagel halves.
description: This Bee Sting bagel breakfast sandwich is loaded with hot honey, crispy bacon, spicy-sweet cream cheese, and a perfectly cooked runny egg.

name: Monte Cristo Rolls
ingredients: Confectioners’ sugar and maple syrup, for serving
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°. Grease a 13" x 9" baking dish with butter.
On a lightly floured surface, spread out 1 can of pizza dough until flattened into a rectangle shape. Spread mustard over the surface, leaving a 1/4" border. Layer ham over mustard.
Unravel second can of dough and place on top of ham. Spread raspberry jam over, leaving a 1/4" border. Layer cheese over jam, covering entire surface. Layer turkey over cheese.
Starting from the left side, tightly roll up dough, making sure to tuck in edges. Slice roll into 6 pieces. Transfer to prepared dish laying flat like a cinnamon bun.
In a small bowl, beat egg and cream until blended. Brush tops and sides of rolls with egg mixture. (It will be a little heavier and more custard-like than a typical egg wash.)
Bake rolls until puffy and golden brown on the outside, 40 to 45 minutes. Let cool slightly.
Transfer rolls to a platter. Dust with confectioners’ sugar. Serve with syrup alongside.
description: I’ve transformed a Monte Cristo sandwich into cinnamon rolls, but with a secret hack that means these come together in less than an hour.

name: Croque Monsieur Breakfast Casserole
ingredients: 1 large loaf country-style bread, cut into 1" cubes
4 tbsp. unsalted butter, plus more for pan
4 oz. ham, torn into 1" pieces, divided
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°. On a baking sheet, spread bread in an even layer and bake until dried out and crispy, 10 to 15 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl.
In a large glass measuring cup, whisk eggs, half-and-half, and mustard; season with salt and pepper. Pour over toasted bread and toss to coat. Let soak 10 minutes.

Increase oven temperature to 350°. Grease a 13"-by-9" baking dish with butter. Add about half of bread to prepared dish. Top with 1 cup Gruyére and half of ham. Top with remaining bread and pour remaining liquid over. Top with 1/2 cup Gruyére and remaining ham.
Bake casserole until bread is crispy and golden and cheese is melted, 30 to 40 minutes.

Meanwhile, in a medium pot over medium heat, melt butter. Add flour and whisk into butter. Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and smells nutty, about 2 minutes. While whisking, slowly pour in milk and continue to whisk until smooth. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened enough to just coat a spoon, but not as thick as gravy, about 1 minute. Stir in nutmeg; season with salt and pepper.
Preheat broiler. Pour sauce over casserole and top with remaining 1 cup Gruyére.
Broil, watching closely, until cheese is melted and golden in spots, 2 to 5 minutes.
description: This croque monsieur breakfast casserole is the savory brunch recipe you'll love. It's layered with melty cheese, ham, and a silky béchamel.

name: Homemade Pancakes
ingredients: 2 tbsp. unsalted butter, melted, plus more, softened, for cooking and serving
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk flour, granulated sugar, baking powder, and salt. In a large bowl, whisk milk, egg, and vanilla. While whisking, stream in melted butter and whisk to combine.
Gently fold dry ingredients into milk mixture until just combined (do not overmix; some lumps are okay).
Preheat a griddle or other large heavy skillet over medium heat until hot but not scorching, 2 to 3 minutes.

Melt enough butter to cover surface of griddle, then pour about 1/4 cup batter onto griddle. Cook pancake until bubbles form on top and sides start to lift from pan, 2 to 3 minutes. Flip and cook until bottom is golden brown and pancake is fluffy, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack. Wipe off griddle, then repeat with more butter and remaining batter (you should get about 10 pancakes).
Divide pancakes among plates. Serve with butter and syrup.
description: If you're looking for the best homemade pancake recipe, stop here. Our easy recipe is made from a simple batter, but results in light and fluffy pancakes.

name: Best Quiche
ingredients: 6 oz. cooked ham steak, finely chopped (about 1 cup), patted dry
instructions: On a lightly floured surface, roll pie dough to a 1/4"-thick round. Lift and carefully transfer to a glass or metal 9" pie dish, letting sides slump into place (do not stretch).
Using a sharp knife or kitchen shears, trim around edges of dough, leaving about 1/4" excess. Fold excess dough underneath dough lying on top rim of pie pan. Using clean fingers, crimp to seal.
Refrigerate dough until cold, about 30 minutes.

Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 375°. Cut a large square piece of foil or parchment and scrunch to wrinkle. Line dough with scrunched foil, then fill to the brim with pie weights, uncooked rice, or dried beans.

Bake crust until top and sides are dry and set, 20 to 25 minutes. Remove foil with pie weights. In a small bowl, whisk 2 egg whites until blended. Brush over bottom of crust. Continue to bake until bottom is dry and set, about 5 minutes more. Let cool completely, at least 30 minutes.
In a medium bowl, whisk 2 whole eggs and 2 egg yolks until blended. Whisk in cream, milk, salt, and pepper until combined.
Spread ham and cheese across bottom of crust. Top with chives. Gently pour egg mixture over top.
Bake quiche until filling is puffed and set with just a slight jiggle in the middle when pan is shaken, 30 to 35 minutes. Let cool. Slice and serve at room temperature.
description: Our favorite quiche features a soft, creamy filling studded with ham, chives, and Gruyère inside a crunchy, buttery pie crust.

name: Classic Homemade Waffles
ingredients: Pure maple syrup and unsalted butter, for serving
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk egg, buttermilk, oil, and vanilla until smooth.

In a large bowl, whisk flour, granulated sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until combined. Pour egg mixture into dry ingredients and stir until just combined; batter should be lumpy. Let rest 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat waffle iron according to package instructions. Spray heated iron with cooking spray.

Pour a generous amount of batter into the middle of iron until completely covered. Cook waffle until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and tent with foil to keep warm. Repeat with remaining batter.
Divide waffles among plates. Drizzle with syrup and top with butter.
description: These classic homemade waffles are perfectly crispy and fluffy, and so simple to make at home for a Sunday brunch.

name: Frittata
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. In a medium bowl, whisk eggs, mozzarella, and cream; season with salt, black pepper, and red pepper.

In a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat, heat oil. Add shallot and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until shallot is translucent, about 5 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes more. Add spinach and cook, stirring frequently, until wilted, about 2 minutes; season with salt and black pepper.
Pour egg mixture into pan over vegetables. Dollop with ricotta.
Bake frittata until eggs are just set and edges are golden brown, about 12 minutes.
description: Quiche﻿’s less-fussy cousin, frittatas, are the answer to almost every meal dilemma. Our recipe ensures you nail a fluffy, crispy-edged frittata every time.

name: French Toast
ingredients: 3 tsp. unsalted butter, divided, plus more for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°. Set a wire rack in a baking sheet; set aside.
In a large, wide bowl or pie plate, whisk eggs to blend. Whisk in milk, granulated sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt until combined.
Add 2 bread slices to egg mixture and let soak, partially submerged, until bottom half of bread is saturated, about 30 seconds. Using a fork, flip bread and soak 30 seconds longer.

Meanwhile, in a large skillet over medium heat, heat 1 teaspoon butter and 1 teaspoon oil just until butter starts to bubble. Add soaked bread and cook until golden brown and crisp on both sides, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer French toast to reserved rack and place in oven to stay warm. Repeat with remaining butter, oil, and bread.
Divide French toast among plates. Serve with more butter and maple syrup alongside.
description: Our tried-and-true favorite French toast recipe is anything but soggy, and has all the tips you need from choosing the perfect bread to making the best batter.

name: Sloppy Joe Eggs
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, seeds and ribs removed, finely chopped
1 lb. ground breakfast sausage or ground turkey
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 400º. In a large ovenproof skillet or pot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Cook onions, carrot, and bell pepper, stirring occasionally, until softened and golden, 10 to 12 minutes.

Reduce heat to medium. Add ketchup and cook, stirring occasionally, until color is darkened, 5 to 7 minutes. Add garlic and chili powder and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add vinegar, mustard, and Worcestershire and cook, stirring, until warmed through, about 1 minute more. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Increase heat to medium-high. Cook sausage, stirring frequently and breaking meat apart, until browned, 5 to 7 minutes.
Add tomatoes, 1/2 tsp. salt, and vegetable mixture. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer until slightly reduced, 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Make 4 indentions in meat mixture. Crack 1 egg into each; season with salt.
Bake sloppy Joe eggs until egg whites are set and yolks slightly runny (shake pan to test this), 8 to 10 minutes.
Top with Parmesan; season with pepper. Serve with toast alongside (if using).
description: Nostalgia meets breakfast in this ultra-comforting one-pot sloppy Joe eggs recipe full of breakfast sausage and poached eggs.

name: Crispy Potato, Bacon, Egg & Cheese Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 tsp. neutral oil, plus more for brushing
2 small Yukon Gold potatoes, unpeeled, each cut into 24 (1/16"-thick) slices
8 slices of bacon, cut in half
instructions: Arrange racks in center and lower third of oven; preheat to 400°. Brush a baking sheet with a thin layer of oil. A silicone baking mat works really well here if you have one. Line another baking sheet with foil, then set a wire rack inside.

Sprinkle one-quarter of Parmesan in a single layer in one corner of oiled baking sheet, making a 7" x 5" rectangle. Repeat with remaining Parmesan in the other three corners of sheet, so that all four corners have a Parmesan rectangle, with the 7" side parallel to longer side of baking sheet. On top of each cheese rectangle, arrange potato slices in a single layer in 3 rows of 4 (for a total of 12), shingling so they overlap. Brush potatoes with oil; season with 1/4 tsp. salt.
Arrange bacon slices on prepared wire rack. Transfer sheet with potatoes to lower oven rack and sheet with bacon to center rack.
Bake until edges of potatoes are starting to brown and crisp, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, stir mayonnaise, ketchup, and Cajun seasoning until smooth.

Leave bacon in oven; remove potatoes. Using a thin metal spatula, gently release each potato from sheet, keeping Parmesan layer intact. This part takes a little bit of patience and elbow grease, but if potatoes aren't releasing, bake for 5 minutes more. Flip so that the potato side is in contact with sheet.

Return to oven and continue to bake until potatoes and Parmesan are crisp and brown on the edges and bacon fat is rendered, about 5 minutes more (the bacon may need more or a few less minutes, depending on the brand and thickness). Remove sheets from oven; turn off oven.

Move bacon to one side of rack. Arrange potato sheets potato side up on rack. Top each potato sheet with a slice of American cheese. Return sheet with rack to warm oven and let sit until cheese melts, about 5 minutes.

In a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, heat 1 tsp. oil. Crack an egg into a small bowl, then slide into skillet. Repeat with remaining 3 eggs. Cook, mostly undisturbed, until white is set, 3 to 4 minutes. Transfer eggs to a plate; season with salt and pepper.

Arrange potato sheets with a short end facing you. Top bottom half each potato sheet with Cajun mayonnaise, 4 pieces of bacon, 1 egg, and 2 tomato slices; season tomatoes with a pinch of salt and pepper. Fold potatoes over to make a handheld sandwich.
description: Smoky bacon, a runny egg, melty American cheese and spicy mayo are wrapped in a layer of crispy potatoes in this creative take on a B.E.C. bagel.

name: Huevos Rancheros Breakfast Bowls
ingredients: 2 lb. unpeeled sweet potatoes, cut into 1/2" to 3/4" pieces
3 tbsp. adobo sauce from a can of chipotle chiles
4 tsp. grated cotija, plus more for serving
1/4 c. store-bought or homemade salsa verde or salsa roja
instructions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, heat 3 Tbsp. oil. Cook potatoes, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 10 minutes. Reduce heat to medium. Add water; season with 1/2 tsp. salt. Cover and cook until softened, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer potatoes to a plate.

In same skillet over medium heat, cook onions and garlic, stirring frequently, until onions are softened and translucent, about 7 minutes. (If pan seems dry at this point, add 1 Tbsp. oil.) Return potatoes to skillet.

In a small bowl, mash half of beans and keep the other half whole. Add beans and adobo sauce to onion mixture. Cook, stirring frequently, until heated through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat and keep warm.

In another large nonstick skillet over medium heat, heat 2 Tbsp. oil. Working 2 at a time, fry tortillas, turning halfway through, until lightly golden and edges begin to curl, 3 to 4 minutes total. Transfer tortillas to a large plate or baking sheet. Sprinkle with cotija.
In same skillet over medium heat, heat remaining 1 Tbsp. oil. Fry eggs, undisturbed, until whites firm up, about 2 minutes; season with remaining 1/4 tsp. salt.
Divide hash among bowls. Top with a fried egg, avocados, salsa, cilantro, and more cotija. Arrange tortillas on sides of bowls.
description: This easy twist on a breakfast classic includes a smoky sweet potatoes and bean hash, fried eggs, avocado, and crispy tortilla.

name: Sheet-Pan Frittata
ingredients: 1 oz. Pecorino Romano, finely grated (about 1/2 c.)
8 oz. farmers’ cheese or part-skim ricotta
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°. Grease a baking sheet with butter.

In a large skillet over medium heat, heat oil. Cook broccoli, stirring occasionally, until bright green and tender, about 5 minutes; season with salt. Add shallots and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until shallots are softened, about 5 minutes. Add kale and cook, stirring frequently, until wilted, about 1 minute more. Let cool slightly.
In a medium bowl, whisk eggs, milk, cream, and Pecorino; season with salt and pepper. Pour vegetable mixture into prepared sheet.
Pour egg mixture over, making sure all corners are covered. Dollop farmers’ cheese on top. Drizzle chili crisp over.
Bake frittata until eggs are firm to touch, 15 to 17 minutes. Let cool slightly.
description: This easy brunch recipe makes a frittata with a rich and creamy egg base with broccoli, garlic, farmers cheese, and chili oil drizzle, all on a sheet pan.

name: Bacon Apple Grilled Cheese
ingredients: 1 Granny Smith apple, thinly sliced, divided
1 Pink Lady apple, thinly sliced, divided
instructions: On a slice of bread, spread 1 Tbsp. mustard, then top with 3 slices cheddar, 4 to 5 apple slices, and 3 slices bacon. Top with another slice of bread. Repeat to make 3 more sandwiches.
Spread outsides of each sandwich with a thin layer of mayonnaise.
Heat a large skillet over medium-low heat. Cook sandwiches, turning halfway through, until golden on both sides and cheese is melty, 3 to 4 minutes per side.
description: This bacon apple grilled cheese is perfectly sweet, savory, and the ideal fall treat.

name: Ina Garten’s Charlie Bird’s Autumn Salad
ingredients: 3 tbsp. plus 3/4 cup good olive oil, divided
1 c. cherry or grape tomatoes, halved through stem
1 c. coarsely chopped fresh mint leaves (from about 2 bunches)
1/2 c. roasted, salted pistachios, coarsely chopped
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 425°. On a baking sheet, toss squash, 3 Tbsp. oil, 1 1/2 tsp. salt, and 3/4 tsp. pepper.
Roast squash, tossing occasionally, until browned and tender, about 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan over high heat, bring farro, cider, bay leaves, 2 tsp. salt, and 2 cups water to a boil. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, uncovered, until farro is tender, about 30 minutes. (If liquid evaporates before farro is tender, add a little more water.) Drain farro mixture and transfer to a large serving bowl. Discard bay leaves.

In a small measuring cup, whisk lemon juice, 1 1/2 tsp. salt, 3/4 tsp. pepper, and remaining 3/4 cup oil. Stir three-quarters of vinaigrette into warm farro. Set aside for at least 15 minutes to cool.

Before serving, stir tomatoes, mint, parsley, pistachios, and radishes into farro. Add arugula, squash, and remaining vinaigrette and lightly fold in Parmesan to not break it up too much. Sprinkle with salt and serve immediately.
description: Ina Garten's Charlie Bird's Autumn Salad is a seasonal spin on her classic recipe, with butternut squash, farro, pistachios, and lots of lemon, mint, and parsley.

name: Chicken Shawarma Bowls
ingredients: 1 c. long-grain white rice, rinsed, drained
1 tbsp. plus 2 tsp. extra-virgin olive oil
2 bell peppers, seeds and ribs removed, chopped
Pinch of crushed red pepper flakes
Store-bought or homemade hummus and pita, cut into triangles, warmed, for serving
instructions: In a medium pot over medium heat, combine rice, a large pinch of salt, and 2 cups water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until rice is tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and keep covered, 10 minutes, then fluff rice with a fork.

Meanwhile, in a large skillet over medium-high heat, heat 1 tablespoon oil. Working in batches if needed, cook chicken, turning occasionally, until golden brown and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part registers 165°, about 5 to 7 minutes per side. Transfer chicken to a cutting board and let rest 10 minutes, then slice into thin strips.
In a large bowl, combine cucumbers, bell peppers, onion, tomatoes, and feta. Add red pepper, juice from 1 lemon, and remaining 2 teaspoons oil; season with salt. Toss to combine.
In a small bowl, stir yogurt, dill, and juice from remaining 1 lemon.
Divide rice among bowls. Top with chicken, veggies, a dollop of yogurt sauce, and a dollop of hummus. Serve with pita alongside.
description: These easy chicken shawarma bowls are perfect for meal prepping and make for a quick weeknight dinner.

name: BBQ Protein Bowls
ingredients: 1 1/4 tsp. kosher salt, divided, plus more
1/4 tsp. freshly ground black pepper, divided, plus more
1/2 c. store-bought or homemade BBQ sauce, plus more for serving
1 c. fresh or thawed frozen corn
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions.

Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine garlic powder, onion powder, 3/4 tsp. salt, and 1/4 tsp. pepper. In a large skillet over medium heat, heat oil. Season chicken all over with spice mixture and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part registers 165°, about 7 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board. Remove skillet from heat.

In a large bowl, combine cabbage and carrots. In a medium bowl, whisk yogurt, vinegar, mustard, and sugar; season with 1/2 tsp. salt and 1/4 tsp. pepper. Pour over cabbage mixture and toss to combine.

Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Return to skillet along with beans and BBQ sauce. Bring to a simmer over medium-low heat and cook, stirring occasionally to coat chicken, until sauce thickens, 2 to 3 minutes; season with salt and pepper.
Divide rice among bowls. Top with chicken mixture, coleslaw, corn, and pickles. Drizzle with BBQ sauce and sprinkle with scallions.
description: With grains, BBQ chicken, corn, slaw, and pickles, these BBQ protein bowls are so flavor-packed, you'll forget that they're good for you.

name: Peanut Chickpea Protein Bowls
ingredients: 1/4 head of red cabbage, shredded or finely chopped (about 3 cups)
2 tbsp. finely chopped fresh cilantro, plus more for serving
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk garlic, ginger, peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil. Add warm water, 1 tsp. at a time, until desired consistency is reached.
Make Ahead: Sauce can be made 3 days ahead. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate.

On a large clean kitchen towel or paper towels, spread out chickpeas. Top with a second clean towel and gently press to remove as much moisture as possible from chickpeas. (If you can, pick off and discard as many chickpea skins as possible; this will help the chickpeas crisp up better.)

In a large, deep, heavy skillet (preferably at least 2" deep) over medium heat, heat oil. Add chickpeas; season with 1/2 tsp. kosher salt and gently toss to coat. Spread chickpeas in a single layer and cook, tossing occasionally, until browned and slightly crisp, 4 to 5 minutes. (The chickpeas may cause the oil to spit, so use a splatter screen if you have one!)

Add garlic and ginger and continue to cook, tossing constantly, until chickpeas are crispy all over and garlic and ginger are lightly browned, 1 to 2 minutes more. Transfer chickpea mixture to a clean plate.
In a medium bowl, toss cabbage, cilantro, and 1/4 tsp. salt.
Spread 3/4 cup rice among bowls. Top with cabbage mixture, cucumbers, carrots, and chickpeas. Sprinkle with peanuts and more cilantro; drizzle with peanut sauce. Serve with lime wedges alongside.
description: Crispy chickpeas﻿, cabbage slaw, and brown rice are drizzled with creamy peanut sauce for a craveable protein-packed dinner that’s both hearty and healthy.

name: Greek Power Bowls
ingredients: 2 c. cooked quinoa or brown rice
1 c. halved cherry or grape tomatoes
instructions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add chicken; season with oregano, salt, and pepper. Cook, turning halfway through, until golden brown and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part registers 165°, about 8 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board. Let rest 5 minutes, then thinly slice.
Divide quinoa among bowls. Top with cucumber, avocado, tomatoes, olives, feta, dill, and chicken. Drizzle with dressing.
description: If you're looking for an easy, healthy lunch, then turn to these Greek power bowls, filled with chicken, grains, and fresh veggies.

name: Italian Grinder Chicken Salad Wrap
ingredients: 1/2 c. finely chopped Black Forest ham (from about 2.5 oz.)
1/2 c. finely chopped provolone (from about 2.5 oz.)
1/2 c. thinly sliced pepperoni (from about 2.5 oz.)
1/2 c. thinly sliced soppressata (from about 2.5 oz.)
1/3 c. coarsely chopped banana peppers or peperoncini
description: This protein-packed chicken salad takes all the classic Italian grinder ingredients and wraps them all up into a hearty lunch that’s easy to eat on the go.

name: Tuscan Chicken Wrap
ingredients: 1 tbsp. chopped fresh oregano or 1 tsp. dried oregano
1 1/2 oz. packed baby spinach or arugula (about 1 1/2 c.), divided
2 c. cooked chopped rotisserie chicken (about 8 oz.), divided
instructions: In a small bowl, mix mayonnaise, basil, sun-dried tomatoes, Parmesan, oregano, scallion, and garlic until combined.

Spread one-quarter of mayonnaise mixture onto 1 wrap, leaving a 1" border. Top with one-quarter of spinach, 1/2 cup chicken, 1 ounce cherry tomatoes, and 1 ounce mozzarella. Fold in sides of wrap, then tightly roll bottom of wrap away from you, keeping sides tucked in, until a burrito shape forms. Repeat with remaining mayonnaise mixture, wraps, spinach, chicken, cherry tomatoes, and mozzarella. Slice wraps in half to serve.
description: A whole wheat wrap is spread with Parmesan-herb mayonnaise and wrapped around chopped rotisserie chicken, creamy mozzarella, spinach, and cherry tomatoes.

name: Chicken Club Egg White Wrap
ingredients: 4 slices cooked bacon, broken into 1/2" pieces
2 (1/2"-thick) slices ripe tomato, cut into cubes
instructions: In a blender, pulse egg whites, cornstarch, salt, and xanthan gum just until combined, about 10 seconds. (Don't overblend; whites will become too frothy.)

In an 8" nonstick skillet over medium-low heat, heat 1 tsp. oil. Add a scant 1/3 cup egg white batter, swirling pan to allow batter to spread into a circle as evenly as possible. Cook, undisturbed, until bubbles appear and surface looks matte, 2 to 3 minutes.
Using a large plastic spatula, carefully flip wrap and cook until cooked through, about 1 minute more. Transfer to a plate. Repeat with remaining egg white batter and oil.
Make Ahead: Wraps can be made 3 days ahead. Store in an airtight container and refrigerate.
In a small bowl, stir mayonnaise and pesto.
Spread each egg white wrap with 1 Tbsp. mayonnaise mixture. Top each with one-quarter of lettuce, 2 avocado slices, then one-quarter of chicken, bacon, and tomatoes.
Fold in left and right sides of each wrap, then fold end closest to you over filling. Tightly roll up from bottom end, keeping sides tucked in, to form a burrito shape. Cut each wrap in half.
description: Creating sturdy egg white wraps might seem like a feat that only a factory can achieve, but it’s surprisingly easy to make them, and a chicken club, at home.

name: Coconut-Lime Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 scallions, white and green parts separated, thinly sliced
Basil leaves and finely chopped roasted, salted peanuts, for serving
instructions: In a large stainless-steel skillet over medium heat, heat oil and swirl to coat. Pat chicken dry; season all over with salt, coriander, cumin, and cayenne. Cook chicken, turning occasionally, until cooked through and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part registers 165°, 6 to 8 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board.

In same skillet over medium heat, whisk milk, garlic, peanut butter, lime juice, and sriracha. Bring to a simmer, scraping browned bits from bottom of skillet. Let dressing cool. If dressing thickens too much, just stir in 1 to 2 Tbsp. water until it gets to a consistency that you like.

In a large bowl, toss romaine, carrots, celery, and white scallion parts; season with a pinch of salt. Add 1/4 cup dressing and toss to coat. Transfer salad mixture to a large platter or serving bowl.
Slice chicken and place on top of salad. Top with more dressing, coconut, basil, peanuts, and green scallion parts.
description: This coconut-lime chicken salad is full of juicy chicken, crisp romaine, shredded carrots, crunchy celery, fresh herbs, chopped salty peanuts, and toasted coconut with a spicy coconut lime dressing.

name: Avocado Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts, poached and cut into bite-sized pieces
1/2 c. corn kernels, fresh or frozen
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk lime juice, jalapeño, honey, and olive oil. Whisk in cilantro, then season with salt and pepper.

In a large bowl, combine chicken, avocado, mango, tomatoes, corn, and red onion. Pour on prepared dressing and gently toss until salad is coated in dressing, then season to taste with salt and pepper.
description: Classic chicken salad gets a summer upgrade with diced avocado, corn, mango, cherry tomatoes, red onion, and a simple herby dressing.

name: Italian Grinder Bean Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. finely chopped roasted red bell peppers
1/4 c. finely chopped banana peppers or peperoncini
2 oz. hot soppressata or pepperoni, finely chopped or quartered
2 oz. salami, finely chopped or quartered
1/4 c. fresh basil leaves, thinly sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk oil, vinegar, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, sugar, and 1/4 tsp. salt.
Add onion, beans, mozzarella, bell peppers, and banana peppers to bowl; season with remaining 1/2 tsp. salt, then toss to combine.
Add soppressata, salami, and tomatoes and toss again to combine. Top with basil.
description: To make this Italian grinder bean salad, we took everything you love from a chopped sandwich—genoa salami, hot soppressata, red onion, pepperoncini, and roasted red peppers—and added mozzarella and beans.

name: Panera Thai Chicken Salad
ingredients: 2 tsp. grated or chopped peeled ginger
1 clove garlic, grated or finely chopped
2 medium carrots, chopped into 1/2" pieces (about 1 c.)
1 red bell pepper, seeds and ribs removed, chopped into 1/2" pieces (about 1 c.)
1 c. frozen shelled edamame, thawed, patted dry
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk vinegar, chili sauce, lime juice, and salt. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.
Make Ahead: Vinaigrette can be made 1 week ahead. Store in an airtight container and refrigerate.

In a medium bowl, whisk peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, chili sauce, ginger, oil, and garlic until smooth. Whisk in 1 tablespoon cold water to combine; if sauce is still too thick, add more cold water, 1 teaspoon at a time, until a smooth, pourable consistency is reached. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.
Make Ahead: Sauce can be made 1 week ahead. Store in an airtight container and refrigerate.
Place a rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°. In a medium ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat, heat 1 tablespoon oil.

Season chicken with 1 teaspoon salt. Add to pan, reduce heat to medium, and cook, undisturbed, until golden brown on one side, 4 to 5 minutes. Turn and cook on second side until golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes more.

Transfer skillet to oven and roast until chicken is cooked through and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part registers 160°, about 5 minutes. Transfer chicken to a cutting board and let rest 10 minutes. Cut into 1/4" strips.
Meanwhile, in another medium skillet over medium heat, toast almonds, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl.

In same skillet over medium heat, heat remaining 1 teaspoon oil. Add carrot and cook, tossing occasionally, until tender and blistered on all sides, 2 to 3 minutes; season with salt. Transfer to a medium heatproof bowl.
In same skillet over medium heat, cook bell pepper, tossing occasionally, until blistered, 2 to 3 minutes; season with salt. Transfer to bowl with carrots.
In same skillet over medium heat, cook edamame, tossing occasionally, until blistered, 1 to 2 minutes; season with salt. Add to bowl with carrots and peppers.
In a large bowl, toss romaine and cilantro with vinaigrette. Divide among bowls and top with vegetables and chicken. Drizzle with peanut sauce. Top with almonds and wonton strips.
Make Ahead: Chicken and vegetables can be cooked 3 days ahead. Let cool, then store in separate airtight containers and refrigerate.
description: This copycat version of Panera's classic Thai Chicken Salad allows you to enjoy it at home any day of the week.

name: Hot Honey Shrimp Lettuce Wraps
ingredients: 1 lb. large shrimp, peeled, tails removed
2 tbsp. gochujang or chili garlic sauce
2 scallions, thinly sliced, green and white parts separated
Butterhead lettuce leaves, matchstick carrots, and toasted sesame seeds, for serving
instructions: Pat shrimp dry. In a medium bowl, toss shrimp and garlic; season with salt.
In a large skillet over medium heat, heat oil. Add shrimp and cook, turning halfway through, until pink and cooked through, about 2 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.

In same skillet, whisk honey, broth, gochujang, white scallion parts, and 1/4 tsp. salt. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened to a glaze, 3 to 4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Return shrimp to skillet and toss to coat.
Divide shrimp among lettuce leaves. Top with carrots, scallion green parts, sesame seeds, and remaining glaze.
description: Our hot honey shrimp lettuce wraps feature juicy shrimp coated in a glaze of sweet honey, spicy gochujang, and savory scallion.

name: Chicken Caesar Wraps
ingredients: 1 c. white bread, cut into 1/2” cubes
1 tbsp. plus 1 tsp extra-virgin olive oil
3/4 tsp. freshly ground black pepper, divded
1 large chicken breast (about 1/2 lb.) sliced in half lengthwise.
2 tbsp. to 1/4 cup store-bought or homemade Caesar dressing
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. On a rimmed baking sheet, toss bread with 1 teaspoon olive oil, ¼ teaspoon garlic powder, ¼ teaspoon salt, and ¼ teaspoon pepper. Spread in a single layer and bake until golden and crisp, 10 to 12 minutes.

Meanwhile, season chicken on all sides with oregano and remaining ½ teaspoon garlic powder, ½ teaspoon salt, and ½ teaspoon pepper. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, heat remaining 1 tablespoons oil until shimmering. Cook chicken, turning occasionally, until both sides have a nice sear and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of breast registers 165º, about 8 minutes per side.
Transfer chicken to a cutting board. Once cool enough to handle, slice chicken into strips.
In a large bowl, toss chicken, croutons, lettuce, Parmesan, and desired amount of Caesar dressing; season with salt and pepper
Divide salad among tortillas and wrap up burrito-style. Slice in half and serve.
description: Everything you love about a classic chicken Caesar salad, all wrapped up in a flour tortilla for a handheld, homemade classic.

name: Chicken Pesto Pasta
ingredients: 2 (8-oz.) boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1" pieces
instructions: In a medium skillet over medium heat, heat oil. Add chicken; season with 3/4 tsp. salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and an instant-read thermometer registers 160°, 4 to 5 minutes total. Transfer to a plate.
