In same skillet over medium heat, cook garlic and red pepper flakes, stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add water, cream, and 1/2 tsp. salt and bring to a simmer. Add penne and cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta is al dente and liquid is reduced to a sauce that coats the pasta, 8 to 10 minutes.

Stir in Parmesan and chicken and toss until cheese is melted and chicken is warmed through, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat and fold in pesto; if sauce feels dry, add water, 1 Tbsp. at a time, until a creamy sauce forms. Season with more salt, if needed. Top with basil (if using).
description: Featuring store-bought pesto along with just six other ingredients, this 30-minute one-pan meal is truly the lazy cook’s dream.

name: Chopped Cheese
ingredients: 2 tsp. store-bought or homemade adobo seasoning
2 vine-ripened or roma tomatoes, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat a large stainless steel or cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. Pour in oil and swirl to coat skillet. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until onion begins to soften, about 5 minutes. Add ground beef and adobo seasoning; season with salt. Cook, breaking up beef into small pieces with a wooden spoon or spatula, until beef is no longer pink, about 6 minutes.

Spread beef in pan and top with cheese slices. Reduce heat to medium. Cover skillet and cook until cheese begins to melt, about 2 minutes. Uncover and stir cheese into beef until completely melted and creamy.

Place each roll on a sheet of parchment. Scoop out some bread from each side of roll. Spread cut sides of each roll with 2 Tbsp. mayonnaise. Fill rolls with ground beef mixture, lettuce, and tomatoes; season tomatoes with pepper. Tightly wrap sandwich in parchment and cut in half to serve.
description: A bodega classic with seared adobo-seasoned ground beef and chopped onions, gooey American cheese, and lettuce-tomato-mayo on a soft hero roll

name: Cowboy Pasta Salad
ingredients: 1 tbsp. plus 1 tsp. finely chopped chipotle chiles in adobo
1 red bell pepper, seeds and ribs removed, finely chopped (optional)
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk oil, lime juice, chiles, honey, and 1/2 tsp. salt

In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook pasta, stirring occasionally, until al dente according to package instructions. Drain pasta and transfer to a large bowl. Add half of dressing and toss to combine.

In a large skillet over medium-high heat, arrange beef in a single layer; season with salt and pepper. Cook, breaking up meat with a wooden spoon, until no pink remains, about 5 minutes. Drain any excess fat. Add chili powder, garlic powder, cumin, onion powder, and paprika; season with salt and pepper.

Add seasoned ground beef to the big bowl with the pasta. Toss with onion (if using), bell pepper (if using), beans, corn, tomatoes, and remaining dressing to skillet; season with salt. Fold in cheese and scallions.
description: What could possibly make taco salad even better? Pasta, of course! Incorporate all the flavors of you favorite Tex-Mex salad into this easy summer side.

name: Club Sandwich
instructions: Using a toaster (or in a large skillet), toast bread until golden brown, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer bread to a plate.
Spread butter on both sides of every slice. Spread 1 Tbsp. mayonnaise on one side of one slice of bread. Top with lettuce and tomatoes; lightly season with salt and pepper. Place bacon on top.
Spread 1 Tbsp. mayonnaise on both sides of a second slice of bread and place on top of bacon. Top with cheddar, turkey, and ham, folding to fit.
Spread remaining 1 Tbsp. mayonnaise on one side of third slice of bread and close sandwich mayonnaise side down.
Secure with toothpicks. Cut into 4 triangles.
description: The club sandwich is a lunch classic, and the diner-perfect sandwich is easy to make at home with all your favorite layers.

name: Buffalo Chicken Wrap
ingredients: 1/2 c. hot sauce (such as Frank's RedHot Original)
2 tbsp. plus 1 tsp. extra-virgin olive oil, divided
1 lb. boneless skinless chicken breasts, sliced lengthwise into 1"-thick strips
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk blue cheese, mayonnaise, vinegar, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper. Add carrots and cabbage and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.

In a medium bowl, whisk hot sauce, cayenne, garlic powder, cumin, paprika, 2 tablespoons oil, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper. Reserve 1/4 cup sauce; cover and refrigerate until ready to use.
Add chicken to bowl with remaining hot sauce mixture; toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes or up to 24 hours.

In a large skillet over medium-high heat, heat remaining 1 teaspoon oil. Remove chicken from marinade, add to skillet, and cook until cooked through and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part registers 165°, 4 to 5 minutes. Discard marinade.
Divide blue cheese slaw, chicken, and reserved hot sauce between tortillas. Tightly roll up and serve.
description: This jam-packed wrap has all the best parts of Buffalo wings and blue cheese.

name: Caprese Sandwich
ingredients: 2 tbsp. store-bought or homemade basil pesto
instructions: In a small pot over medium heat, bring balsamic vinegar to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until reduced by about two-thirds and is syrupy, about 5 minutes. Let cool.

Meanwhile, toast bread, if desired. Divide arugula among 4 slices of bread. Top with tomatoes and mozzarella. Drizzle some balsamic glaze over mozzarella. Layer basil leaves over. Drizzle with oil; season with with salt and pepper. Spread a thick layer of pesto over one side of remaining bread slices. Close sandwiches pesto side down and cut in half.
description: With crusty bread, perfectly ripe tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, pesto, balsamic, basil, and arugula, this is the most refreshing summer sandwich.

name: Cobb Salad
ingredients: 1 head of romaine lettuce, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a jar, shake oil, vinegar, mustard, and honey; season with ¾ tsp. salt and ½ tsp. pepper.
On a large platter, spread out lettuce, then add rows of hard-boiled egg, chicken, bacon, avocado, blue cheese, and tomatoes; season with salt and pepper.
Drizzle salad with dressing. Top with chives.
description: To make the perfect Cobb salad, you MUST use homemade dressing. Our recipe is filled with crispy bacon, hard-boiled eggs, chicken breast, and creamy avocado.

name: Poke Bowls
ingredients: Pinch of crushed red pepper flakes
2 green onions, thinly sliced, plus more for garnish
1 tsp. toasted sesame seeds, plus more for garnish
1 lb. sushi-grade ahi tuna, cut into 1/2" cubes
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, red pepper flakes, green onions, and sesame seeds. Add tuna and toss to coat. Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes or up to 1 hour.
To serve, add rice to the bottom of four bowls. Top with tuna and toppings of your choice. Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds before serving.
description: Poke bowls are healthy, and offer lots of opportunity for customization and creativity. The best thing about them? They’re super easy to make at home!

name: Dirty Chai Martini
ingredients: Ground cinnamon and star anise, for serving
instructions: In a medium pot over medium-high heat, bring sugar, water, tea, allspice, cardamom, and ginger to a boil. Strain through a fine-mesh sieve into a medium heatproof bowl or container. Let cool.
In a cocktail shaker, combine vodka, espresso, Kahlúa, and 1 1/2 oz. chai syrup. Fill shaker with ice, cover, and vigorously shake until outside of shaker is very frosty, about 20 seconds.
Strain into a martini glass. Dust with cinnamon, then garnish with star anise.
description: Our dirty chai martini is the drink you didn't know you needed—a boldly spiced, espresso-spiked cocktail that bridges the gap between your morning ritual and your evening plans.

name: Harvest Punch
ingredients: 2 oranges, sliced into triangles, plus more for glasses
instructions: Rub rims of glasses with an orange slice. Dip rims into cinnamon sugar, turning to coat.
Place ice in a large punch bowl. Add cider, Prosecco, beer, and vodka. Add apples, orange slices, and cinnamon sticks. Ladle punch into prepared glasses.
description: Apple cider and ginger beer might seem like a weird pairing, but with fresh fruit and cinnamon (plus bubbly!), we promise you, this harvest punch works.

name: Moscow Mule Pops
instructions: In a large bowl or glass measuring cup, stir ginger beer, vodka, zest of 2 limes, and juice of 2 limes until combined.
Divide ginger beer mixture among ice-pop molds. Top with zest of 2 limes, then insert a stick into the center of each.
Freeze until solid, at least 5 hours and up to overnight.
In a small bowl, mix sugar and zest of 2 limes. Sprinkle pops with sugar mixture.
description: These easy, boozy Moscow Mule pops are the easiest way to beat the heat this summer.

name: St. Germain Spritz
ingredients: 3 oz. dry sparkling wine, such as brut Champagne, Cava, or Prosecco
Celery rib and cucumber slice, for garnish
instructions: Fill a collins or other cocktail glass with ice; Add St. Germaine and stir to chill. Top with wine and soda water and stir gently to combine. Garnish with celery and cucumber.
description: If you’re a fan of the refreshing, low-alcohol Hugo Spritz, you're going to love this lightly sweet, fruity, easy St. Germain Spritz cocktail.

name: Joey King  Maisie Williams’s Black Magic Midnight Margaritas
ingredients: Lime wedges, plus 4 oz. fresh lime juice
1 (6-oz.) container frozen blackberries, plus more for serving
3 oz. store-bought or homemade simple syrup
instructions: Pour sugar onto a plate. Rub a lime wedge around the rims of 4 glasses, then dip rims into sugar, turning to coat.
In a blender, blend ice, tequila, blackberries, Cointreau, simple syrup, orange juice, and lime juice on high until smooth, about 1 minute.
Divide margarita among prepared glasses. Garnish with more blackberries, lime wedges, and mint.
description: The stars of Practical Magic 2, Joey King and Maisie Williams, stopped by the Delish Test Kitchen to show us how to make their black magic midnight margaritas.

name: Jungle Bird
ingredients: 1/2 c. (110 g) demerara or turbinado sugar
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium-low heat, heat sugar and water, stirring occasionally, until sugar is dissolved, about 5 minutes. Let cool.

In a cocktail shaker, combine pineapple juice, rum, Campari, lime juice, and 1/2 oz. demerara syrup. Fill shaker with ice, cover, and vigorously shake until outside of shaker is very frosty, about 20 seconds.
Strain into an ice-filled rocks glass. Garnish with quartered pineapple crown.
description: The Jungle Bird is a gorgeous tiki drink made with rum and Campari for a slightly bitter, surprisingly refreshing cocktail.

name: Grapefruit-Rosemary Mocktail Spritz
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium-high heat, bring sugar, rosemary, salt, and 1/2 c. water to a simmer. Reduce heat to medium-low to maintain a gentle simmer and cook, stirring often to dissolve sugar, about 2 minutes. Let cool slightly.
Transfer syrup and rosemary to an airtight container. Refrigerate until ready to use.
Make Ahead: Syrup can be made 3 days ahead. Keep refrigerated.
In a shallow bowl or plate, mix sugar and paprika.
Gently rub edge of a tall glass with grapefruit wedge, leaving a small amount of juice on rim; reserve wedge for serving. Roll glass in sugar mixture to coat rim.

Fill glass with ice. Add sparkling water, grapefruit juice, and 3/4 oz. rosemary syrup. Using a cocktail spoon, stir to combine. Push rosemary sprig through center of reserved grapefruit wedge and garnish glass.
description: This easy to make, booze-free cocktail recipe hits all the marks: It’s tart, herby, slightly sweet, and a little smokey.

name: Raspberry Mint Shrub Mocktail
ingredients: 8 fresh raspberries, divided, plus more for serving
8 fresh mint leaves, divided, plus 2 mint sprigs
instructions: In a medium bowl, mash raspberries with a fork. Add sugar and stir to combine. Cover and let sit at room temperature at least 24 hours and up to 48.
Strain raspberry mixture into a large measuring cup or clean bowl. Add vinegar and refrigerate until ready to use.
Make Ahead: Shrub can be made 1 week ahead. Cover and keep refrigerated.
Divide raspberries, mint leaves, and lime juice between tall glasses. Using a spoon, mix until mint and raspberries are slightly broken down.
Fill glasses with ice. Add 1/2 cup raspberry shrub to each. Top off with seltzer. Garnish with a mint sprig and more raspberries.
description: Muddled with raspberries and mint, then topped with seltzer, this Raspberry Mint Shrub is a fun mocktail that's perfect for slow summer afternoons.

name: Espresso Mocha Crunch Mocktail
instructions: In a cocktail shaker, combine espresso, syrup, and soda water. Fill shaker with ice and vigorously shake until outside of shaker is very frosty, about 20 seconds. Divide between 2 coupe or martini glasses.
In a medium bowl, whisk cream and confectioners’ sugar until soft peaks just barely form. Spoon whipped cream over mocktail; smooth top with a spoon.

Crush 3 Oreos with your fingertips or place in a zip-top bag and crush with the bottom of a glass or rolling pin. Sprinkle crushed Oreos over half of whipped cream. Gently open enough of remaining 2 Oreos to attach to side of each glass.
description: Our espresso mocktail packs a punch with an espresso base, creamy top, and tons of Oreo crunch with none of the alcohol.

name: Bee's Knees Mocktail Spritz
instructions: In a small heatproof bowl or cup, microwave water and honey until honey is dissolved and smooth, about 30 seconds. Stir and let cool. (Alternatively, in a small pot over medium-low heat, bring water and honey to a simmer and cook, stirring, until honey is dissolved.)
Make Ahead: Honey syrup can be made 1 month ahead. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate.
Spoon 1 oz. honey syrup into a shallow dish. Dip rosemary into syrup, shaking off excess. Pour sugar onto another shallow dish. Add rosemary and toss to generously coat in sugar.
Transfer rosemary to a plate. Let sit at room temperature to set, about 45 minutes, or refrigerate up to 1 day.
In a cocktail shaker, combine gin, lemon juice, 1 oz. honey syrup, and 2 to 3 ice cubes. Cover and vigorously shake until outside of shaker is very frosty, about 20 seconds.
Strain mocktail into a chilled stem glass. Top off with club soda. Garnish with lemon peel and sugared rosemary sprig.
description: This Bee’s Knees mocktail spritz, inspired by the gin-based classic drink, has lemon, a sweet honey syrup, and is topped off with a sparkling club soda.

name: Old Fashioned Cocktail
ingredients: Orange peel and maraschino cherry, for serving
description: Chilled bourbon, bitters, and a hint of sugar combine to make our classic old fashioned recipe.

name: Dirty Martini
ingredients: 3 to 4 Spanish, Cerignola, or Castelvetrano green olives
instructions: Fill a cocktail mixing glass or medium glass measuring cup with ice. Add gin, vermouth, and olive brine. Vigorously stir until very cold, 30 to 45 seconds. Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Skewer olives and place in glass. Serve cold.
description: Let this be your go-to guide to create the perfect dirty martini with chilled gin, dry vermouth, and olive brine.

name: Manhattan Cocktail
instructions: Fill a medium liquid measuring cup or mixing glass with ice. Add bourbon and vermouth and stir until well chilled.
Strain into a (preferably frosty) coupe glass. Garnish with cherries and a few dashes of bitters.
description: When it comes to booze-forward classic cocktails, the whiskey-based Manhattan cocktail is as iconic as they come.

name: Moscow Mule Cocktail
ingredients: 4 fresh mint leaves, plus more for garnish
instructions: Divide mint leaves between copper mugs. Add lime juice and muddle mint until leaves start to bruise and slightly break down.
Fill mugs with ice and add vodka. Top off with ginger beer and gently stir to combine. Garnish with more mint and a lime wedge.
description: Vodka, fresh lime juice, and spicy-sweet ginger beer combine in an adorable little copper mug to make the iconic Moscow Mule cocktail.

name: Lychee Martini
ingredients: 3 oz. juice from canned lychee or simple syrup, plus 6 canned lychee
instructions: Fill a cocktail shaker with ice. Add gin, lychee juice, St-Germain, and vermouth. Cover and vigorously shake until outside of shaker is very frosty, about 20 seconds.
Strain into 2 chilled martini glasses. Skewer lychee onto 2 cocktail picks and place in glasses.
description: Our sweet, floral, fruity lychee martini is just what you need for the summer.

name: White Negroni
instructions: In a small pitcher, combine Lillet, gin, and Suze. Fill with ice and stir until very chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass with a large ice cube. Garnish with lemon peel.
description: Featuring fortified wine, Lillet, and the aperitif Suze, the white Negroni is a floral, complex spin on the classic cocktail.

name: Last Word Cocktail
ingredients: Luxardo cherries and a lime wedge or wheel, for serving
instructions: Fill a shaker with ice. Add lime juice, gin, chartreuse, and maraschino liqueur. Cover and vigorously shake until outside of shaker is very frosty, about 30 seconds.
Strain into a chilled coupe glass. Garnish with cherries and a lime wheel.
description: A pretty pale green shaken cocktail with gin, green chartreuse, maraschino liqueur, and fresh lime.

name: Peperoncini Martini ('Cini 'Tini)
instructions: In a medium glass pitcher, combine gin, peperoncini brine, and vermouth. Fill pitcher with ice and stir until outside of pitcher turns frosty.
Strain into a martini glass. Skewer peperoncini and feta cube and garnish glass.
description: Use peperoncini brine in place of olive juice to add a spicy-sour, antipasti-inspired kick that pairs well with crisp gin and vermouth.

name: Ina Garten’s Classic Cosmopolitans
ingredients: 1 c. (8 oz.) Cointreau or triple sec
1 c. (8 oz.) Ocean Spray cranberry juice cocktail
instructions: Place martini glasses in the freezer for at least 15 minutes.

In a pitcher, stir vodka, Cointreau, cranberry juice cocktail, and lime juice. Fill a cocktail shaker halfway with ice. Pour vodka mixture into shaker until it’s three-quarters full, cover, and shake for a full 30 seconds. (It’s longer than you think!)
Strain mixture into prepared glasses and serve ice cold. Repeat with remaining vodka mixture.
description: Ina Garten reveals her recipe for the perfect, classic cosmopolitan.

name: Golfing Grape Soda
instructions: In a Collins glass, stir vodka, grape juice, and lime juice.
Fill glass with ice. Top off with ginger ale. Garnish with frozen grapes.
description: Long considered the best-kept secret among golfers, the transfusion is a boozy grape soda that has fueled back nines and victory putts for years

name: Drunken Peanut Butter Cups
ingredients: 3 tbsp. creamy peanut butter, divided, plus more
1/4 oz. peanut butter whiskey (such as Skrewball)
instructions: In a blender, blend vodka and 2 Tbsp. peanut butter until well combined and smooth. Transfer to an airtight container. Freeze until very cold, at least 8 hours and up to 24.
Strain vodka mixture through cheesecloth or a very fine-mesh sieve into another container; discard solids.

Spread remaining 1 Tbsp. peanut butter on a plate; pour crushed M&M's onto another plate. Dip rim of a rocks glass into peanut butter to coat in a thin layer, then dip into candies, shaking off excess.

In a cocktail shaker, combine cream, chocolate liqueur, crème de cacao, whiskey, and 1 1/2 oz. peanut butter-infused vodka. Fill shaker with ice, cover, and vigorously shake until outside of shaker is very frosty, about 20 seconds.
Strain cocktail into prepared glass. Carefully adhere mini Reese's cup onto rim of glass.
description: This peanut butter cup-inspired cocktail is a treat disguised as a boozy drink that’s guaranteed to satisfy your sweet tooth.

name: Yacht Club Cocktail
ingredients: 1 oz. John D. Taylor’s Velvet Falernum
Lemon peel cut into a sail shape, for garnish
instructions: Freeze a coupe glass until ready to use.
In a cocktail shaker, combine rum, Falernum, Curaçao, lemon juice, and lime juice. Fill shaker with ice, cover, and vigorously shake until outside of shaker is very frosty, about 20 seconds.
Strain cocktail into prepared glass. Garnish with lemon peel.
description: The Yacht Club cocktail is a timeless libation, heavy on the alcohol with rum at the helm, designed to set you up for success—whether that be sailing the open sea, basking in the sun at the club, or simply sipping from your deck.

name: Spiked Chips Ahoy "Egg" Cream
ingredients: Maraschino cherries, whipped cream, and Chips Ahoy cookies (optional), for garnish
instructions: Squeeze chocolate syrup along the inside of a tall glass to create a drip effect. Fill glass with ice.
In a cocktail shaker, combine chocolate milk, rum, and amaretto. Fill shaker with ice, cover, and vigorously shake until outside of shaker is very frosty, about 20 seconds.
Strain into prepared glass. Top off with seltzer. Garnish with a cherry, whipped cream, and cookies (if using).
description: This spiked Chips Ahoy inspired cocktail combines chocolate syrup, milk, and seltzer with amaretto and rum for a deliciously drinkable dessert in a glass.

name: Tiramisu White Russians
instructions: In a pint-sized glass jar, combine cream and sugar. Seal and vigorously shake until cream thickens enough to hold a soft peak, about 3 minutes. (Alternatively, use a whisk or handheld mixer to beat cream until soft peaks form.)
Fill 2 rocks glasses with ice. Divide rum and Kahlúa between glasses and stir to combine.
Using a spoon, divide whipped cream between glasses, using the back of the spoon to smooth into an even layer that covers surface of drink. Dust tops with cocoa powder. Top with a cookie half.
description: Somewhere between cocktail and dessert, this Italian-influenced White Russian﻿ is hard to resist.

name: Bahama Mama
instructions: Fill a glass with ice. Pour over orange juice, pineapple juice, dark rum, coconut rum, lime juice and grenadine.
Garnish with pineapple and maraschino cherries.
description: A Bahama Mama is a classic fruity, tropical cocktail made from orange and pineapple juice, two types of rum, lime juice, and grenadine.

name: Pumpkin Cheesecake Cookies
ingredients: 1/4 c. (52 g) packed light brown sugar
1/2 c. plus 3 Tbsp. (100 g plus 37 g) granulated sugar, divided
1/3 cup homemade or store-bought cinnamon sugar
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk flour, pumpkin pie spice, cream of tartar, baking soda, and salt until combined.

In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium-high speed, beat butter, brown sugar, and 1/2 cup granulated sugar until light and fluffy, about 1 minute. Add egg yolk and vanilla and beat until well combined. Add pumpkin puree and dry ingredients and beat on medium-low speed until just combined. Wrap bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate until cold, at least 1 hour or up to overnight.
Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, stir cream cheese and remaining 3 tablespoons granulated sugar until smooth. Wrap bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate until cold, at least 1 hour or up to overnight.
Place racks in upper and lower thirds of oven; preheat to 350°. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment.

Roll dough into level tablespoon-sized balls. Flatten 2 balls into disks. Using a spoon or a piping bag, place 2 level teaspoons cheesecake filling in the center of one disk. Close with second disk. Using your fingers, pinch around edges to seal, then gently roll into a ball.
Pour cinnamon sugar into a wide, shallow dish. Roll ball in cinnamon sugar and arrange on prepared sheets. Repeat with remaining dough.

Bake cookies, rotating sheets halfway through, until golden brown and beginning to crack, 12 to 14 minutes. Firmly bang pan a few times on the countertop or stove to slightly flatten cookies. Transfer cookies to a wire rack and let cool.
description: Get your pumpkin and cheesecake fix in one with these pumpkin spiced cookies stuffed with a little surprise: cream cheese filling!

name: Mini Pillsbury Cookie Cheesecakes
ingredients: 1 (9-oz.) pkg. Pillsbury Pumpkin Shape Cookie Dough (20 pre-cut cookies)
instructions: Arrange racks in upper and lower thirds of oven; preheat to 350°. Line a standard 12-cup muffin tin with 10 liners. Place 1 pre-cut round of dough in bottom of each prepared cup. Arrange remaining 10 rounds on a parchment-lined baking sheet, spacing 2" apart.

Bake both batches of cookies, rotating pans top to bottom and front to back halfway through, until just golden and set, 12 to 14 minutes. Let cookies cool in tin/on sheet. Set cookies on sheet aside for serving.

In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium-high speed, beat cream cheese and granulated sugar until fluffy and smooth, 2 to 3 minutes. Add egg, sour cream, and vanilla and beat until combined, about 1 minute more. Divide cream cheese mixture among muffin cups.
Bake cheesecakes until edges are just set, 16 to 18 minutes. Transfer tin to a wire rack and let cool to room temperature, about 30 minutes.
Refrigerate cheesecakes until fully set, at least 2 hours.
In a large bowl, whisk cream and confectioners’ sugar until thickened and stiff peaks form.
Transfer cheesecakes to a platter. Dollop or pipe whipped cream over cheesecakes. Insert a reserved cookie into the top.
Make Ahead: Cheesecakes, without whipped cream, can be baked 3 days ahead. Keep refrigerated.
description: These adorable and delicious mini Pillsbury cookie cheesecakes combine the rich creaminess of cheesecake with the sweet, buttery taste of Pillsbury sugar cookies.

name: Guava Cheesecake Tres Leches
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°. Grease a 13″ x 9″ baking dish with cooking spray. In a large bowl, whisk cake mix, eggs, nectar, and butter until combined. Add 1 drop pink food coloring (if using), adding more if needed, until desired color is reached. Pour into prepared pan.
Bake cake until a tester inserted in the center comes out clean, 20 to 25 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool for 15 minutes, then poke all over with a fork.
While cake cools, in a medium bowl, whisk condensed milk, evaporated milk, and whole milk. Slowly pour over warm cake. Refrigerate at least 2 hours and up to overnight.

In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium speed, beat cream cheese and yogurt until smooth, about 2 minutes. Add confectioners’ sugar, vanilla, and salt and beat until smooth and creamy, about 2 minutes more.
Add cream and beat again until stiffened, about 2 minutes. Spoon over cake and spread into an even layer. Continue to refrigerate until cold, about 1 hour.
Meanwhile, in a small pot over medium heat, bring nectar to a slow boil.
In a small bowl, whisk cornstarch and water. Slowly pour into nectar and continue to boil, whisking continuously, until slightly thicker, 1 to 2 minutes.
Pour mixture into a large heatproof bowl. Let cool to room temperature, about 20 minutes.
Spoon cooled guava topping over cheesecake and spread into an even layer. Refrigerate until set, at least 2 hours and up to overnight.
description: A classic tres leches cake and a Hawaiian guava cake meet in this beautiful guava cheesecake tres leches.

name: Ghost S'mores Dip
ingredients: 1 bag ghost marshmallows (or 4 packages ghost Peeps)
Mini chocolate chips, for ghost eyes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°. In the bottom of a 9" oven-proof skillet, baking dish, or pie dish, spread out chocolate chips and pour cream on top. Cover completely with a single layer of ghost marshmallows.
Place mini chocolate chips over eyes and mouth. (The already-drawn faces will fade in the oven.)
Bake until the chocolate has melted and the ghosts are golden, 8 to 10 minutes.
Serve warm with graham crackers for dipping.
description: Our ghost s'mores dip—topped with marshmallows in the shape of ghosts—is a scary easy Halloween treat that everyone will reach for.

name: Foil Pack Cinnamon Apples
instructions: Tear 2 pieces of foil that are about 12-inch by 18-inch and stack them on top of each other.
In small bowl, combine brown sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg, set aside.
Place apples on center of foil and sprinkle on mixture using only enough to lightly coat apples. Break up butter over apples.  Fold up packet ensuring a tight seal.
When ready to cook, place sealed packet on hot grill or over fire for about 30 minutes flipping 2 to 3 times throughout.
Remove packet from grill and pierce with knife or fork to allow steam to escape.  Unfold packet and enjoy.
description: Foil pack cinnamon apples are the easiest way to get apple pie flavors in half the time. Bake apples in foil with cinnamon and butter for a camping treat.

name: Banana Pudding
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk condensed milk, whole milk, and pudding mix, breaking up any lumps. Refrigerate until set, about 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, in another large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium-high speed, beat cream and vanilla until stiff peaks form, 2 to 3 minutes. Set aside half of whipped cream for serving. Fold remaining whipped cream into milk mixture.

Cover bottom of 3-quart trifle dish with wafers. Top with one-third of pudding mixture. Cover with another layer of wafers. Top with an even layer of banana slices. Continue to layer pudding, wafers, and bananas until you reach the top, ending with a final layer of pudding. Set aside remaining wafers for serving.
Refrigerate at least 3 hours or up to overnight.
Add granulated sugar to reserved whipped cream and stir to combine. Dollop on top of banana pudding. Crumble reserved wafers, then sprinkle over pudding.
description: This best homemade banana pudding recipe also happens to be the easiest, with under 30 minutes of prep time. For ultimate results, patience is key!

name: Easy Homemade Churros
instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, bring butter, 2 tablespoons sugar, and 1 cup water to a boil, then stir in vanilla. Remove from heat and add flour and salt. Stir with a wooden spoon until thickened, about 30 seconds. Let cool 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, on a rimmed baking sheet or large plate, mix cinnamon and remaining 1 cup sugar.
Using a handheld mixer on medium speed, add eggs one at a time, beating to blend after each addition. Transfer mixture to a piping bag fitted with a large open star tip.

Into a large pot fitted with a deep-fry thermometer, pour oil to come halfway up sides. Heat over medium-high heat until thermometer registers 375°. Holding piping bag a few inches above oil, carefully pipe churros into 6"-long ropes. Using kitchen scissors, cut off dough from piping bag.

Working in batches, fry churros, turning as needed, until golden brown, 4 to 5 minutes; make sure oil registers 375° between batches. Using a slotted spoon or tongs, immediately roll churros in cinnamon sugar, then transfer to a wire rack.

Place chocolate chips in a medium heatproof bowl. In a small saucepan over medium heat, bring cream to a simmer. Pour hot cream over chips and let sit 2 minutes. Add cinnamon and salt and whisk until combined and smooth.
Arrange churros on a platter. Serve with dipping sauce alongside.
description: You can make these easy homemade churros at home with just nine ingredients, perfectly coated in cinnamon sugar or dipped in melted chocolate ganache.

name: Chocolate Guinness Cake
ingredients: 3/4 c. unsweetened cocoa powder, plus more for pan
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°. Grease a 9" springform pan with cooking spray. Dust with cocoa powder, tapping out excess.
In a medium saucepan over medium-high heat, bring stout to a boil. Cook, stirring occasionally, until reduced to about 1 cup, 15 to 20 minutes. Let cool until room temperature.

Meanwhile, in a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium-high speed, beat eggs and granulated sugar until pale and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Add sour cream, oil, and vanilla and beat until combined.
Add Guinness to egg mixture and whisk until well incorporated and smooth.
In a medium bowl, whisk flour, baking soda, cocoa powder, and salt. Add to bowl with egg mixture and fold until just combined; do not overmix. Pour batter into prepared pan.

Bake cake until a tester inserted into the center comes out mostly clean, 50 to 60 minutes. (It’s important for it to not come out completely clean, as you don’t want this to be a dry cake.) Transfer pan to a wire rack and let cool.

In a large bowl, using handheld mixer on medium-high speed, beat cream cheese until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Add confectioners’ sugar and vanilla and gently mix with a spatula until just incorporated. Using handheld mixer on medium-high speed, continue to beat until frosting is very light and fluffy.
Spread frosting in the center of top of cake. This ensures you can control how much you want it spread. Using the back of a spoon or an offset spatula, spread frosting as desired.
description: Celebrate St. Patrick's Day with this perfect fudgy chocolate cake with a special ingredient—Guinness!—and a dreamy cream cheese frosting.

name: Best Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1 c. (120 g.) coarsely chopped chocolate wafers or discs (or from a bar), preferably 70% cacao or higher
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk flour, baking soda, and salt until combined.

In a large bowl, whisk butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar until combined and creamy. Add eggs and vanilla and whisk to combine. Add dry ingredients and stir with a rubber spatula until about halfway mixed in. Add chips and wafers and fold until just combined. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 4 hours and up to 24.

Let dough come to room temperature. Arrange racks in upper and lower thirds of oven; preheat to 350°. Using a large cookie scoop (about 3 Tbsp.), scoop dough onto 2-parchment lined baking sheets, spacing about 3" apart.
Bake cookies, rotating trays to top bottom halfway through, until edges are golden brown and just set and centers are almost set, 12 to 14 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool slightly.
description: Why is this easy recipe our perfect chocolate chip cookie? It isn't fussy to make, and has a soft chewy center with crispy edges and plenty of chocolate.

name: Pecan Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Place a baking sheet in oven. Lightly grease a 9"x1.5" pie dish with cooking spray.

On a lightly floured surface, roll dough to a 12" circle. Drape over pie dish and gently press to fit, making sure there are no air bubbles. Trim overhang to 1" and tuck under itself. Crimp edges as desired.

Line dough with foil or parchment and fill with dried beans or pie weights. Bake crust until top and sides are dry and set, 20 to 25 minutes. Remove foil and weights. Continue to bake until bottom is dry to the touch, about 5 minutes more. Let cool.
In a small saucepan over low heat, melt butter. Whisk in brown sugar until smooth. Remove from heat. Whisk in eggs, corn syrup, vanilla, and salt.
Scatter pecan halves into crust. Pour egg mixture over. Gently mix with a spoon to coat pecans. Lightly place foil over top. Carefully place pie dish on heated baking sheet.

Bake pie 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 350° and continue to bake until filling is puffed, center is slightly jiggly, and edges are set, 30 to 35 minutes more. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool.
Serve topped with ice cream.
description: With a flaky butter crust, crunchy nuts, and a rich, chewy filling, it's no wonder why pecan pie is a staple holiday pie on our menu every year.

name: Pumpkin Cheesecake Roll
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. (145 g.) confectioners' sugar, plus more for dusting
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Line a 15" x 10" jelly roll pan with parchment and grease with cooking spray.

In a medium bowl, whisk flour, baking soda, salt, and pumpkin spice. In a large bowl, whisk eggs, granulated sugar, and pumpkin puree until smooth. Add dry ingredients to egg mixture and whisk just to combine. Spread into prepared pan.
Bake cake until a tester inserted into the center comes out clean, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, lay out a large kitchen towel on your counter (try to use one with little to no texture) and dust with confectioners' sugar. When cake is done baking, flip onto kitchen towel and gently peel off parchment.
Starting at a short end, gently but tightly roll cake into a log. Let cool completely.
In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium-high speed, beat cream cheese, butter, and salt until light and fluffy. Add confectioners' sugar and vanilla and continue to beat until smooth.
When cake is cooled, gently unroll (it’s okay if it remains slightly curled) and spread with cream cheese filling. Using towel if needed, roll back up and dust with more confectioners' sugar.
description: The pumpkin roll's iconic swirls make it a staple stunning dessert during the fall season—learn how to perfect it with our easy recipe.

name: Apple Crisp
ingredients: 5 Honeycrisp, Granny Smith, and/or Cripp’s Pink apples, peeled, cored, sliced 1/4" to 1/2" thick
3/4 c. (160 g.) packed light brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. In a medium bowl, toss apples, cornstarch, lemon juice, granulated sugar, nutmeg, and 1 teaspoon cinnamon.
In a small bowl, toss oats, brown sugar, flour, salt, and remaining 1 teaspoon cinnamon. Add butter and stir until a crumbly mixture forms resembling wet sand.
Arrange apple mixture in a 2-quart ceramic baking dish. Top with oat mixture.
Bake until apples are soft, topping is crisp and golden brown, and juices are bubbling around edges of dish, 55 to 70 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream (if using).
description: If you're looking for the perfect balance between jammy apples and a melt-in-your-mouth oat topping, then our classic apple crisp will be your fall go-to.

name: Strawberry Pop-Tart Blondies
ingredients: 1 1/4 c. (270 g.) packed light brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350º. Grease an 8"-by-8" baking pan with cooking spray and line with parchment, leaving an overhang on 2 opposite sides.
In a large bowl, whisk brown sugar, butter, and granulated sugar until well combined. Whisk in eggs, vanilla, and salt to blend. Stir in flour until just combined.
Spread 1 1/2 cups batter in bottom of prepared pan. Top with dollops of jam, then gently spread jam over batter with an offset spatula or the back of a spoon.

Dollop remaining batter over jam. Using offset spatula or the back of a spoon, gently smooth batter in an even layer, being careful not to disturb jam layer. (The goal is to trap the jam in the middle, like a Pop-Tart.)

Bake blondies, tenting with foil if darkening too quickly, until golden around the edges and a tester inserted into the center comes out with a few moist crumbs attached, 45 to 50 minutes. Let cool in pan 15 minutes, then lift out of pan using parchment overhang and transfer blondies to a wire rack. Let cool completely.
In a medium bowl, whisk powdered sugar and 1 tablespoon milk until smooth, adding more milk by the 1/2 teaspoonful until glaze is thick yet pourable.
Pour glaze over cooled blondies and spread with offset spatula. Top with sprinkles. Let glaze rest until set, about 1 hour.
description: Buttery, chewy, and filled with strawberry jam, this dessert combines the nostalgia of Pop-Tarts and the classic comfort of blondies in one adorable bar cookie.

name: Magic Cheesecake Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Line an 8" x 8" baking pan with parchment.

In a food processor, pulse graham crackers until finely ground. Add butter and sugar and pulse until mixture starts to come together and resembles wet sand. Pour mixture into prepared pan, pressing to ensure all sides and edges are even and firm.

In the large bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment (or in a large bowl using a handheld mixer), beat cream cheese until soft and pliable. Add eggs one at a time, beating to blend after each addition. Scape down sides of bowl. Add milk, vanilla, and salt and beat until combined and smooth.
Pour cream cheese mixture over crust. Sprinkle with chips, coconut, and walnuts.

Bake cheesecake until firm to the touch and coconut begins to turn golden brown, 35 to 40 minutes. Let cool to room temperature, about 1 hour. Refrigerate until cold, at least 2 hours or up to overnight.
description: These magic cheesecake bars have a buttery graham cracker bottom, chocolate chip bits intertwined in rich cheesecake, and topped with toasted coconut and walnut bits.

name: Best Brownies
ingredients: 1/2 c. (105 g.) packed light brown sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 13"-x-9" metal baking pan with cooking spray. Line pan with foil, leaving an overhang on 2 opposite sides. Grease foil with cooking spray.
In a small pot over medium heat, melt butter. Remove from heat, add chocolate, and stir with a rubber spatula until melted and smooth. Stir in vanilla, espresso powder, and salt.

In a large bowl, whisk granulated sugar and brown sugar. Whisk in chocolate mixture until smooth. Add eggs, one at a time, whisking to blend after each addition, then continue to whisk until batter is well combined, about 30 seconds more. Fold in flour and cocoa powder with a spatula just until combined.
Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake brownie until puffed and set and a tester inserted into the center comes out clean, 22 to 28 minutes.
Let cool completely in pan. Using foil overhang, remove brownie from pan and cut into squares with a sharp knife.
description: Our perfect homemade brownie recipe is not only ready in under an hour, but results in extremely fudgy, and deliver on intense chocolate flavor.

name: Peanut Butter Cup Chess Pie
ingredients: 1/4 c. (30 g.) plus 2 Tbsp. confectioners' sugar
1/2 c. (1 stick) unsalted butter, melted, cooled
1/3 c. (72 g.) lightly packed dark brown sugar
6 oz. bittersweet or semisweet chocolate, finely chopped
instructions: Place a 9" tart pan with a removable bottom on a baking sheet. In a medium bowl, whisk flour, confectioners’ sugar, cocoa powder, and salt. Add butter and mix until combined. Press dough into bottom and all the way up sides of prepared pan. Dock bottom of dough with a fork. Freeze until just firm, about 10 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°. Bake crust until firm to the touch but still shiny, about 12 minutes. Let cool.
Make Ahead: Crust can be made 2 days ahead. Tightly wrap pan in plastic wrap and store at room temperature.

Place a rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°. In a large bowl, whisk eggs until combined. Add granulated sugar, peanut butter, brown sugar, butter, milk, cornmeal, vinegar, vanilla, and salt and whisk to combine.
Pour filling into crust and carefully transfer to oven. Bake pie until filling is set, 25 to 30 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool.
Place chopped chocolate in a medium heatproof bowl. In a small saucepan over low heat, bring cream to a simmer. Pour cream over chocolate and let sit 2 minutes. Whisk until smooth.
Pour ganache over top of cool pie. Refrigerate until ganache is set and firm, about 1 hour. Remove sides of tart pan, then cut into slices.
Make Ahead: Pie can be made 1 day ahead. Tightly wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate.
description: This peanut butter–chocolate dream takes two famous desserts—Reese’s peanut butter cup and the South’s chess pie—and makes something uniquely delicious.

name: Cinnamon Roll Poke Cake
ingredients: 1 box white cake mix, plus ingredients called for on box
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease a 9"-x-13" baking pan with cooking spray.
In a large bowl, prepare cake according to package directions. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake until a toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean, 20 minutes. Let cool.
In a medium bowl, whisk together sweetened condensed milk, butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt.
In a large bowl using a hand mixer, beat heavy cream until stiff peaks form.

In another large bowl, beat cream cheese and butter together until no lumps remain. Add powdered sugar and beat until smooth, then add in vanilla and a pinch of salt. Fold in whipped cream until just combined.
Using the bottom of a wooden spoon, poke holes all over cake. Pour filling over and use a rubber spatula to push into holes. Frost with cream cheese frosting. Refrigerate 20 minutes before serving.
description: This cinnamon roll poke cake can help you skip all the finicky rolling and proofing, but still get all that delicious cinnamon roll flavor.

name: Everything But The Lunchbox Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. (107 g.) packed light brown sugar
3/4 c. (42 g.) crushed ridged potato chips, divided
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk flour, baking soda, and salt. In a medium bowl, stir butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar. Whisk in egg and egg yolk until just combined. Pour butter mixture into dry ingredients and mix to combine. Fold in chocolate chips, 1/2 cup pretzels, and 1/2 cup potato chips. Refrigerate until firm, about 45 minutes.

Using a large cookie scoop (about 1/4 cup), portion into 16 balls and divide between 2 parchment-lined baking sheets, spacing about 2" apart. Flatten balls slightly. Dollop 1 tsp. peanut butter and 1/2 tsp. jelly over each. Top with remaining 1/4 cup potato chips and 1/4 cup pretzels. Freeze 15 minutes, if desired (to help cookies hold their shape).
Arrange racks in upper and lower thirds of oven; preheat to 350°.
Bake cookies, rotating sheets top to bottom halfway through, until golden around the edges, raised, and wrinkled in the middle, 15 to 18 minutes. Let cool slightly.
description: These everything but the lunchbox cookies have it all: salty potato chips, crunchy pretzels, creamy peanut butter,  sweet jam, and classic chocolate chips.

name: Espresso Martini Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 c. (107 g) packed light brown sugar
instructions: In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium-high speed (or using a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment), beat butter, brown sugar, granulated sugar, espresso powder, and salt until creamy and combined. Add baking powder and beat until incorporated, about 1 minute more.

Add flour and cocoa powder and beat until dough begins to form clumps. Turn out onto a large square of plastic wrap. Using plastic wrap, form dough into a 2"-diameter log. Refrigerate until chilled, about 2 hours.
Arrange racks in upper and lower thirds of oven; preheat to 325°. Unwrap dough and, using a sharp knife, slice into 14 (1/2"-thick) discs. Arrange on 2 parchment-lined baking sheets.
Bake cookies, rotating sheets top to bottom halfway through, until edges are just firm, 11 to 13 minutes.
While cookies are still warm, using a spatula or the inside of a cookie cutter, nudge edges and encourage cookies to be as circular as possible.
Let cool on sheets until firm, then transfer to a wire rack and let cool completely.

In a medium heatproof bowl, whisk espresso powder and 2 Tbsp. boiling water until dissolved. Whisk in Kahlúa, then add confectioners’ sugar and whisk until combined. Add remaining water, 1 tsp. at a time, until glaze is a dipping consistency.
Working one at a time, dip 4 cookies face down into glaze, letting excess drip off. Return to wire rack, glaze side up.
Fill a small sieve with cocoa powder. Using a piece of paper to cover one side of each cookie, shake cocoa powder onto the other half. Press 3 espresso beans into the center of each cookie.
Repeat with remaining cookies, then let cookies sit until totally dry, about 10 minutes.
description: These fudgy espresso martini cookies are infused with espresso powder and topped with a shiny Kahlúa glaze.

name: Hot Honey Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: 3/4 c. (150 g) packed light brown sugar
1/4 c. hot honey, plus more for drizzling
1/2 c. honey-roasted peanuts, plus more for topping
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°. In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium speed (or in the large bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment), beat brown sugar, butter, salt, and cayenne until creamy and combined. Add egg, peanut butter, hot honey, and baking soda and beat until well combined, about 45 seconds.
Add flour and peanuts and beat on low speed just until combined.

Using a 3-Tbsp. cookie scoop, scoop 18 balls onto 3 parchment-lined baking sheets (6 each). (If you only have 2 sheets, cover dough in bowl while the others bake.) Press 3 to 5 peanut halves into top of each ball.

Bake cookies, preferably one sheet at a time, until set on the edges but still very soft in the center, 11 to 13 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool for 2 minutes, then transfer to wire racks and let cool completely.
Just before serving, drizzle with more hot honey.
description: Our hot honey peanut butter cookies are bringing a spicy glow-up that will win the cookie swap.

name: Cool Whip Cookies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350° with racks in the upper and lower thirds. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, using a hand mixer, beat cake mix with Cool Whip and egg until smooth and dough has a taffy-like consistency, about 1 minute.
Place powdered sugar in a shallow bowl. Using a medium cookie scoop, scoop dough into the powdered sugar and roll to coat completely.
Arrange each ball 2" apart on prepared baking sheets and bake, rotating the trays halfway through, until cookies crackle and are set but still slightly soft in the center, 13 to 15 minutes.
Transfer to a cooling rack and let cool completely.
description: If you love chocolate crinkle cookies but don't have the time (or ingredients), then these chocolate Cool Whip are the dessert you should reach for.

name: Better Than Magnolia Bakery Banana Pudding
ingredients: 2 tsp. vanilla paste or pure vanilla extract
1 tsp. banana or pure vanilla extract
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, heat whole milk and vanilla paste until milk is just about to simmer.
Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, whisk egg yolks and sugar until pale, thick, and creamy, about 1 minute. Add cornstarch and whisk until smooth and lump-free.
Whisking constantly, slowly pour about one-third of hot milk mixture into egg yolk mixture.
Return egg mixture to saucepan with remaining milk mixture. Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until bubbles burst on the surface and the mixture is glossy and thickened, about 1 minute.
Strain through a fine-mesh sieve into a medium bowl. Cover with plastic wrap, pressing directly onto the surface to prevent a skin from forming. Refrigerate until cold, about 1 hour.

In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium-high speed, beat heavy cream until stiff peaks form, about 3 minutes. Add cooled pastry cream, condensed milk, and banana extract. Continue to beat until medium peaks form, about 1 minute more. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use.

In a small, high-sided saucepan fitted with a candy thermometer, cook sugar and water over medium heat, stirring gently, until sugar dissolves, about 3 minutes. Stop stirring and bring syrup to boil. Heat syrup until thermometer registers 240°.

Meanwhile, in a large bowl, using handheld mixer on medium-high speed (or in the large bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment), beat egg whites and cream of tartar until soft peaks form. You want to get this step done at the same time the syrup registers 240°.

Reduce mixer speed to low and carefully pour hot syrup into whipped egg whites in a thin, steady stream. Be sure to aim for side of bowl rather than directly onto the beaters to prevent splattering. Increase mixer speed to high and continue to beat until meringue cools to room temperature and is stiff and glossy, 8 to 10 minutes.
In a 3-qt. trifle dish, arrange about 10 Nilla wafers in a single layer. Top with a layer of banana slices.

Transfer pastry cream and meringue to 2 separate pastry bags. Snip off a corner of each bag. Pipe about 1/2 cup pastry cream over banana slices (just enough to cover). Pipe about 1/3 cup meringue over pastry cream. Repeat until you get 6 to 7 layers. Pipe remaining meringue on top into desired shapes. Toast top with a kitchen torch until toasted, if desired.
Refrigerate pudding until set, at least 5 hours and up to 12.
description: With a from-scratch pudding, perfectly ripe bananas, and an luxurious Italian meringue, this banana pudding does circles around Magnolia Bakery's.

name: Mini Salted Maple Pies
ingredients: 1 (14.1-oz.) pkg. store-bought pie dough or 2 batches homemade pie dough (for 2 crusts)
1/3 c. (71 g) packed dark brown sugar
instructions: On a lightly floured surface, roll out one round of pie dough to 1/8" thick. Using a 3 1/4" fluted cutter or drinking glass, cut out 6 rounds. Repeat with remaining dough.
Press rounds into cups of a standard 12-cup muffin tin, making sure dough is tucked into corners of each cup. Freeze 15 minutes.
Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 400°. Prick dough in bottom of each cup a few times with a fork.
Bake crusts until bottoms are dry and edges are lightly golden, 5 to 7 minutes. Let sit until cool to the touch. Reduce oven temperature to 350°

Meanwhile, in a small saucepan over medium heat, melt butter. Reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until butter is golden and smells nutty, about 4 minutes. Let cool 5 to 10 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl.
To bowl with browned butter, add egg, brown sugar, maple syrup, cream, cornmeal, kosher salt, and vanilla. Whisk until thoroughly combined. Spoon 4 tsp. maple filling into each crust.
Bake mini pies until filling is bubbly and golden around the edges, 12 to 15 minutes. Sprinkle with sea salt. Let cool completely.
Make Ahead: Filling can be made 1 day ahead. Store in an airtight container and refrigerate.
description: These salted maple mini pies capture the same coziness as a stack of pancakes in the form of an adorable bite-sized treat.

name: Biscoff Tres Leches
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°. Grease a 13" x 9" cake pan with cooking spray. In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium-high speed, beat cake mix, eggs, milk, butter, and vanilla until smooth, about 1 minute. Transfer batter to prepared pan.
Bake cake until a tester inserted into the center comes out clean, 35 to 40 minutes. Let cool.
Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, stir condensed milk, evaporated milk, and whole milk.

In a small heatproof bowl, microwave cookie butter until melted and smooth, about 20 seconds. Add to bowl with milk mixture. Using handheld mixer on medium-high speed, beat until smooth and combined, about 1 minute.
Using a skewer or fork, poke holes all over cake. Slowly add milk mixture, ensuring it absorbs before adding more. Refrigerate until cold, at least 1 hour and up to 1 day (1 day is best).
In a large bowl, using handheld mixer on medium-high speed, beat cream and confectioners’ sugar until stiff peaks form, 2 to 3 minutes.
In a medium heatproof bowl, microwave cookie butter until melted and smooth, about 20 seconds. Gently spread about half of cookie butter over cake.

Using a spatula, transfer cream to a piping bag fitted with a round tip (or transfer to a zip-top plastic bag and cut off a small corner).Tip: Use a tall deli container or something similar to place the bag in, tip first. Fold it over the container. This will make it easier to transfer the whipped cream to the bag with minimal mess.
Dollop cake with whipped cream. Drizzle remaining cookie butter over cake. Top with cookies.
description: This Biscoff tres leches recipe combines a delicious tres leches cake with caramelized Biscoff cookies and cookie butter for a perfect layered dessert!

name: Gingersnap Apple Icebox Cake
ingredients: 3 medium Granny Smith apples, peeled, finely chopped
1/4 c. (50 g.) packed light brown sugar
1/2 c. store-bought or homemade caramel sauce, plus more for serving
instructions: In a medium pot over medium heat, cook apples, brown sugar, lemon juice, and cinnamon, stirring often, until apples are softened and juices have thickened into a syrup, 8 to 10 minutes. Let cool.

In a large bowl, using a handheld mixer on medium-high speed (or in the large bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment), beat cream cheese and caramel until smooth. Slowly add cream and beat until stiff peaks form.

Line a 9" x 5" loaf pan with plastic wrap, leaving an overhang on all sides. Spread about one-quarter of whipped cream mixture in bottom of prepared pan. Top with a layer of cookies, then one-third of apple mixture. Repeat twice more. Top with a final layer of whipped cream, then finish with cookies. Fold plastic wrap overhang over top. Freeze until completely chilled, at least 5 hours and up to overnight.
Unwrap loaf pan and invert onto a cutting board or platter. Remove loaf pan and plastic wrap. Drizzle with more caramel sauce.
description: For a fall version of our favorite icebox cake, we use crunchy gingersnap cookies to hold layers of caramel whipped cream and cinnamon apples together.

name: Watermelon-Feta Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. coarsely chopped fresh mint, plus more for serving
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk oil, vinegar, and kosher salt. Add watermelon, feta, cucumber, mint, and onion and toss to coat.
Top with more mint and sea salt (if using).
description: One of the most refreshing summer salads, this watermelon feta salad aces the sweet and salty combo with the addition of mint, cucumbers, and red onion.

name: Grilled Zucchini
ingredients: 1 tbsp. extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for grill
1/4 tsp. crushed red pepper flakes, plus more for serving
instructions: Prepare a grill for medium-high heat; preheat 5 minutes (or heat a grill pan over medium-high heat). Clean and oil grates. In a large bowl, toss zucchini with oil, lemon zest, and red pepper flakes; season with salt and black pepper.

Using tongs, place zucchini on grill. Cover and grill for 3 minutes. Flip, cover, and continue to grill until char marks form, skin is slightly wrinkled, and zucchini is fork-tender, 2 to 3 minutes more.
Transfer zucchini to a platter. Top with basil and more red pepper flakes.
description: Looking for a quick and easy zucchini recipe? Grilled zucchini is the way to go: perfect for those summer gatherings, and ready in just 10 minutes.

name: Mexican Corn Salad
ingredients: 4 c. fresh or canned corn kernels (from about 4 large ears)
1 bunch of scallions, green and light green parts only, thinly sliced
1/2 c. fresh cilantro, finely chopped, plus whole leaves for serving
2 tbsp. Mexican crema or sour cream
1/2 tsp. smoked paprika or chili powder, plus more for serving
instructions: In a large cast-iron or nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil until shimmering. Add corn; season with 1 tsp. salt and toss to coat. Cook, undisturbed, until charred on one side, about 2 minutes. Continue to cook, tossing occasionally, until kernels are charred and blistered, 8 to 10 minutes. A few kernels should begin to “pop” and leap as they get hotter, but reduce heat to medium if they start to smoke. Transfer to a medium bowl.
Add scallions, jalapeño, cilantro, cotija, crema, mayonnaise, lime juice, and paprika and mix well to combine; adjust seasonings, if needed.
Top salad with a few cilantro leaves. Sprinkle with paprika.
description: This eloté-inspired Mexican corn salad is the easiest summer side that hits all the right notes: creamy, spicy, salty, and citrusy.

name: Panzanella Salad
ingredients: 2 lb. ripe tomatoes, sliced into wedges
1/2 shallot or red onion, thinly sliced
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 400°. Cut bread into 1"-thick slices, then tear into about 1" pieces and transfer to a large bowl. Drizzle bread with 1/4 cup oil; season with 1/2 tsp. salt and 1/4 tsp. pepper. Toss to coat. Spread bread on a large unlined baking sheet.
Bake croutons until crisp and golden brown, about 15 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool completely.
Meanwhile, in a large colander or fine-mesh sieve set over a large bowl, toss tomatoes and 1 1/2 tsp. salt. Let sit for 15 minutes.

In a medium bowl or large glass measuring cup, whisk vinegar, mustard, and remaining 1/2 tsp. salt. Add 3 Tbsp. tomato juice from bottom of bowl and whisk to combine. While whisking, slowly stream in remaining 6 Tbsp. oil.

Remove colander from bowl; discard remaining tomato juice (or reserve for another use). In bowl, toss croutons with dressing. Add drained tomatoes on top. Let sit until croutons have absorbed dressing, about 10 minutes.
Add shallot and basil and lightly toss to combine.
description: Our panzanella salad recipe features generous golden-brown croutons, chunks of juicy tomato, shallots, and torn basil in a bright vinaigrette.

name: Best Pasta Salad
ingredients: Pinch of crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In a large bowl, toss pasta, mozzarella, salami, artichokes, tomatoes, and olives.
In a jar, combine oil, garlic, vinegar, parsley, Italian seasoning, and red pepper flakes. Secure with a lid, then shake to combine; season with salt and black pepper.
Pour dressing over pasta salad and toss to combine.
description: This Italian-inspired pasta salad is the perfect dish to bring to your summer potluck.

name: Grilled Corn On The Cob
instructions: Prepare a grill for high heat; preheat 5 minutes (or heat a grill pan over high heat).
Grill corn, turning often, until charred all over, about 10 minutes.
Spread butter over warm corn; season with salt.
description: Sweet and crunchy with a smoky char, this is the easiest and best way to grill corn on the cob (with or without the husk!).

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, seeds and ribs removed, finely chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, toss chickpeas, cucumber, bell pepper, onion, feta, and olives; season with salt and black pepper.
In a jar with a lid, combine oil, vinegar, parsley, lemon juice, and red pepper flakes. Seal jar and shake until emulsified; season with salt and black pepper.
Pour dressing over salad and toss to coat just before serving.
description: Thanks to chickpeas, this easy make-ahead salad will keep you full for hours. It's satisfying in a way that leafy greens could never be.

name: Broccoli Caesar Pasta Salad
ingredients: 3 anchovy fillets, preferably packed in oil
4 oz. white country-style bread, torn into 3/4" pieces
instructions: In a small bowl, combine garlic and lemon juice. Let sit 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, on a cutting board, finely chop anchovies. Sprinkle 1/8 tsp. salt on top and continue to chop, smashing anchovies with the flat edge of the blade, until a paste forms.
To bowl with garlic mixture, add mayonnaise, Worcestershire, pepper, and anchovy paste. Whisk until combined. Taste and season with salt or more lemon juice, if needed.
Cover bowl and refrigerate until ready to use.
Make Ahead: Dressing can be made 1 day ahead. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate.
Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 400°. In a large bowl, toss bread, 2 Tbsp. oil, and 1/8 tsp. salt. Spread on a large metal baking sheet; reserve bowl.
Bake croutons until golden brown and crisp, 8 to 10 minutes. Let cool.

Meanwhile, bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Add broccoli and cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Transfer broccoli to a fine-mesh sieve; reserve water in pot. Transfer broccoli to reserved bowl.

Return water to a boil. Add pasta and cook, stirring occasionally, until al dente according to package instructions. Drain pasta in fine-mesh sieve, then run cold water over pasta to wash starch off and stop the cooking; transfer to bowl with broccoli. Add remaining 1 Tbsp. oil and toss to coat. Refrigerate until chilled, at least 1 hour and up to 1 day.
Drizzle pasta and broccoli with about three-quarters of dressing and toss to coat. Coarsely crush half of croutons and add to pasta salad along with three-quarters of cheese; toss until combined.
Transfer to a serving bowl. Top with remaining whole croutons and Parmesan. Serve with remaining dressing alongside.
description: This broccoli Caesar pasta salad features crisp-tender broccoli tossed with cavatappi, shredded Parm, and crispy croutons in a homemade Caesar dressing.

name: Cacio E Pepe Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 lb. Brussels sprouts, trimmed, halved lengthwise
1 tsp. (or more) freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. On a baking sheet, toss Brussels sprouts with oil, salt, and pepper. Spread in an even layer.
Bake sprouts until golden brown and fork-tender, 20 to 25 minutes.
Immediately top with pecorino and Parmesan; season with more pepper, if needed. Transfer to a platter and serve warm.
description: This cacio e pepe Brussels sprouts recipe is an easy upgrade of the classic roasted veggie and ideal for your Thanksgiving or holiday table.

name: Cowboy Beans
ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped jarred roasted red bell peppers
1 (14-oz.) can small red beans or dark red kidney beans, drained, rinsed
1 1/2 c. low-sodium beef broth or water
1 c. store-bought or homemade BBQ sauce
2 tbsp. Dijon or spicy brown mustard
instructions: In a cold large Dutch oven or heavy pot, cook bacon over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until crisp, 9 to 11 minutes. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until translucent, about 5 minutes. Add garlic, roasted peppers, and jalapeños and cook, stirring, until garlic is fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes.

Push onion mixture to one side of pot. To the other side of the pot, add ground beef and taco seasoning; season with salt. Break up beef with a wooden spoon and cook, stirring occasionally, until no longer pink, 5 to 6 minutes. Stir to combine with onion mixture.

Add pinto beans, black beans, red beans, broth, BBQ sauce, ketchup, vinegar, mustard, molasses, and hot sauce. Stir to combine, cover, and cook 15 minutes. Uncover and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until flavors have melded and sauce is thickened, about 15 minutes more; season with more taco seasoning and salt, if needed.
description: Hearty, creamy beans are cooked with bacon, ground beef, aromatics, and pickled jalapeños in a sweet, slightly spicy, and tangy sauce.

name: Broccoli Caesar Salad
ingredients: 3 anchovy fillets, preferably packed in oil, drained
4 oz. white country-style bread, torn into 3/4" pieces
instructions: In a small bowl, combine garlic and lemon juice. Let sit 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, on a cutting board, finely chop anchovies. Sprinkle 1/8 tsp. salt on top and continue to chop, smashing anchovies with the flat edge of the blade, until a paste forms.
To bowl with garlic mixture, add mayonnaise, Worcestershire, pepper, and anchovy paste. Whisk until combined. Add more salt or lemon juice, if needed.
Cover bowl and refrigerate until ready to use.
Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 400°. In a large bowl, toss bread, 2 Tbsp. oil, and 1/4 tsp. salt. Spread on a large metal baking sheet; reserve bowl.
Bake croutons until golden brown and crisp, 8 to 10 minutes. Let cool. Increase oven temperature to 450°.
Meanwhile, cut broccoli into florets about 3" long and 1 1/2" wide (save the bottom ends of the stems for another use). The broccoli may seem large, but it will shrink significantly in the oven.

In reserved bowl, toss broccoli and remaining 4 Tbsp. oil and 1 1/2 tsp. salt. Transfer to a large metal baking sheet, spacing evenly as possible and making sure all cut sides are in contact with sheet.
Roast broccoli until tender but still slightly crisp, 18 to 20 minutes. Let cool slightly.
Drizzle broccoli with about half of dressing and toss to coat. Add half of croutons and half of Parmesan and toss again.
Transfer to a platter. Top with remaining croutons and Parmesan. Serve with remaining dressing alongside.
description: Roasted broccoli is tossed in a homemade Caesar dressing with croutons and shaved Parmesan for a new take on this classic salad.

name: Air Fryer Broccoli
ingredients: 1 medium head of broccoli, cut into florets
Pinch of crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: In a large bowl, toss broccoli with garlic and oil; season with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Working in batches if necessary, in an air-fryer basket, arrange broccoli in a single layer. Cook at 370° until tender and crispy, about 10 minutes.
description: Your Air Fryer is the best way to cook up that head of broccoli.

name: Grilled Broccoli
ingredients: 1/2 tsp. kosher salt, plus more for sprinkling
1/4 tsp. crushed red pepper flakes, plus more for serving
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat. Trim off fibrous bottom half of broccoli stem, then quarter broccoli head into small trees.
In a large bowl, whisk together oil, Worcestershire, soy sauce, ketchup, honey, and garlic. Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Add in broccoli and toss to coat. Let sit for 10 minutes.
Place broccoli on grill and sprinkle lightly with more salt. Grill broccoli until knife-tender and slightly charred, flipping every 2 minutes and basting with any remaining sauce, 8 to 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with Parmesan and more red pepper flakes, and serve with lemon wedges.
description: This easy and simple grilled Broccoli recipe features a sweet and salty smokiness that's sure to please the summer crowds.

name: Broccoli Slaw
ingredients: 1 c. loosely packed fresh parsley leaves
instructions: Trim end of broccoli stalks and cut off crowns. Peel stalks, halve crosswise, and thinly slice each half lengthwise to create rectangular slices. Cut slices into matchsticks and transfer to a large bowl. Cut florets from broccoli crowns into thin 1" pieces and add to bowl. Add cabbage, scallions, carrot, and parsley and toss to combine.

In a small bowl or measuring cup, whisk mayonnaise, lemon juice, maple syrup, mustard, and garlic. Pour over broccoli mixture and toss until coated. Fold in walnuts and cranberries; season with salt. Chill until ready to serve.
description: Fresh broccoli slaw gets tossed with cabbage, carrots, scallions, toasted walnuts, dried cranberries, and maple-Dijon dressing in this easy, fresh side.

name: Kung Pao Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: Green onions, thinly sliced, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°. On a large rimmed baking sheet, toss Brussels with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Bake until Brussels sprouts are tender and slightly crispy, about 20 minutes. Transfer Brussels sprouts to a large bowl (but keep the baking sheet close by). Preheat broiler.

In a small skillet over medium heat, heat sesame oil. Add garlic and cook, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in cornstarch. Add soy sauce, water, apple cider vinegar, hoisin sauce, brown sugar, and garlic chili paste. Season with salt, pepper and red pepper flakes. Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until thickened, about 3 minutes.
Pour sauce over Brussels sprouts and toss to combine. Return Brussels sprouts to baking sheet and broil until Brussels sprouts are glazed and sticky.
Garnish with peanuts, sesame seeds, and green onions before serving.
description: These Kung Pao Brussels sprouts are slightly spicy, tangy, and smoky with a vegetal, nearly nutty base of roasted Brussels sprouts.

name: Smashed Brussels Sprouts
instructions: Preheat oven to 425° and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Prepare an ice bath in a large bowl.

Blanch Brussels sprouts: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add Brussels sprouts and cook until bright green and very tender, 8 to 10 minutes. Add Brussels sprouts to ice bath to cool then drain.

On a large baking sheet, toss blanched Brussels sprouts with oil, garlic, and thyme. Using the end of a small glass or mason jar, press down on Brussels sprouts to smash them into a flat patty. Season each smashed Brussels sprout with salt and pepper, then sprinkle mozzarella and Parmesan on top.
Bake until bottoms of sprouts are crispy and cheese is melty and golden, 20 to 25 minutes.
Garnish with parsley and serve warm.
description: These easy smashed Brussels sprouts will be your new favorite Thanksgiving side dish. Cheesy and roasted, these are an ideal side all year round.

name: Chimichurri Green Bean Salad
ingredients: 16 oz. (1 lb.) fresh or frozen green beans
instructions: In a large pot of boiling, generously salted water, cook green beans, stirring occasionally, until bright green and crunchy, 2 to 3 minutes. Using tongs or a slotted spoon, transfer beans to a large bowl of ice water. Drain and pat dry.
Meanwhile, cut kernels off cobs and transfer kernels to a medium microwave-safe bowl. Microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each, until slightly softened, about 90 seconds total.
In a food processor, pulse parsley, oil, cilantro, oregano, garlic, lemon zest, lemon juice, vinegar, red pepper flakes, and 1 tsp. salt until smooth.
Transfer chimichurri to a large bowl. Add green beans, shallot, corn, and feta and toss to combine.
description: This chimichurri green bean salad is so good, you’ll want to replace all your side salads with it.

name: Air Fryer Green Beans
ingredients: 1 lb. green beans, ends trimmed, cut into 3" segments
1 tbsp. reduced-sodium soy sauce or tamari
instructions: In a large bowl, toss green beans, garlic, cornstarch, oil, soy sauce, ginger, white pepper, MSG (if using), 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper until evenly coated.
In an air-fryer basket, arrange beans mixture in an even layer. Cook at 400° until golden and tips are crispy, 10 to 12 minutes.
description: You need 10 minutes of hands-on time to make this air fryer green bean with roasted garlic recipe: tossed in cornstarch and soy sauce, this is umami central!

name: Green Bean Salad
ingredients: 1 lb. fresh green beans, rinsed, trimmed
1/4 c. plus 1/2 tsp. kosher salt, divided
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with water and bring to a boil. Stir in 1/4 cup salt, then add green beans. Cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, 3 to 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, fill a large bowl halfway with ice. Pour in water so bowl is three-quarters full.
Using a slotted spoon or tongs, transfer green beans to ice water. Let sit until chilled, about 10 minutes. Drain and dry in a salad spinner or pat dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk garlic, lemon juice, vinegar, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt until combined. Let sit 5 minutes. Whisk in pepper. While whisking, slowly add oil until emulsified.
Add beans, onion, tomatoes, olives, and 2 ounces feta to dressing. Using tongs, lightly toss to combine. Top with remaining 1 ounce feta.
description: Fresh green beans are tossed with cherry tomatoes, olives, and feta in a simple red wine vinaigrette for a Greek-inspired side that’s light and fresh.

name: Roasted Green Beans
instructions: Arrange racks in center and upper third of oven; preheat to 500°. In a large bowl, toss green beans, shallots, and oil until combined; season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Spread green beans on 2 rimmed baking sheets.
Roast beans on center rack until starting to wilt and soften, 7 to 8 minutes.
Heat broiler on high. Move sheet trays to top rack and broil, watching closely, until lightly blistered, 5 to 7 minutes more; season with salt, if needed.
Transfer beans to a platter. Serve with lemon wedges alongside.
description: In this roasted beans recipe, fresh green beans are tossed with olive oil and shallots, then roasted until tender and lightly blistered.

name: Melting Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lb. Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled, cut into 1" slices
1 tbsp. fresh rosemary, chopped, plus more for serving
1 tsp. fresh thyme, chopped, plus more for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°. In a medium bowl, season potatoes with salt and pepper and toss to combine.

In a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat, cook butter and oil until butter is melted and starting to bubble. Add potatoes and cook, undisturbed, until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Flip potatoes and cook until second side is golden brown, about 5 minutes more. Stir in broth, garlic, rosemary, and thyme.
Transfer skillet to oven and bake until potatoes are tender and liquid slightly reduces, 20 to 25 minutes.
Transfer potatoes to a platter. Drizzle with pan juices and top with rosemary and/or thyme.
description: Smothered in butter, garlic, and fresh herbs, these melt-in-your-mouth potatoes are the perfect side dish for any and every meal you can think of.

name: Loaded Potato Skins
instructions: Preheat oven to 425º. Place potatoes in a dish and prick all over with a fork. Microwave on high for 5 minutes. Transfer potatoes to a rimmed sheet pan lined with parchment paper. Brush potatoes with olive oil and season with salt. Bake until tender, 20 to 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook bacon until crisp. Transfer bacon to a plate and reserve fat.

When potatoes are cool, cut in half lengthwise. Using an ice cream scooper or spoon, remove middle, leaving a 1/4" thick shell. Add skins back to the sheet pan and brush with bacon fat all over top and bottom. Bake until golden and crisp, about 20 minutes, or until desired consistency.
Reduce oven temperature to 375º. Sprinkle cheddar over potatoes and bake until cheese is melty. Top with bacon, a spoonful of sour cream, and green onions. Serve immediately.
description: Looking for an easy potato skins recipe? These loaded potato skins are the perfect way to complete your party spread.

name: Best Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 3 lb. mixed potatoes, such as russets and Yukon Golds, peeled, cut into 1" pieces
instructions: In a large pot, cover potatoes with water and add a generous pinch of salt. Bring to a boil and cook until softened, 15 to 20 minutes.
Drain and return potatoes to pot. Using a potato masher or ricer, mash potatoes until smooth.
While potatoes cook, in a small saucepan over medium-low heat, cook milk and 3/4 c. butter, stirring occasionally, until butter is melted and mixture is warmed through, about 3 minutes.
Pour milk mixture over potatoes and stir until combined and creamy. Add sour cream and stir until combined; generously season with salt and pepper.
Transfer potatoes to a serving bowl. Top with remaining 2 Tbsp. butter; season with more pepper. Top with parsley.
description: These ultra-creamy, buttery, foolproof mashed potatoes are the perfect accompaniment to any holiday meal (or weeknight dinner all year long).

name: Oven-Roasted Asparagus
instructions: Preheat oven to 450º. On a large baking sheet, toss asparagus with olive oil and season generously with salt and pepper.
Roast until tender and slightly charred, 12-15 minutes.
description: There are many ways you can cook asparagus﻿, but roasting is our absolute favorite. Follow our easy, simple recipe to ace this easy side every time.

name: Balsamic Glazed Carrots
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. On a large baking sheet, drizzle carrots with oil, then season with salt, pepper, and thyme. Toss until combined and bake until carrots are tender, 38 to 40 minutes.

Meanwhile, make balsamic glaze: In a small saucepan, combine balsamic vinegar and honey. Simmer until reduced by half, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes (the mixture should coat the back of a spoon). Let cool slightly.
Drizzle carrots with balsamic glaze and garnish with parsley. Serve warm.
description: Roasted carrots are the ultimate easy side dish, but the best way to upgrade them is to add a homemade balsamic glaze.

name: Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Soup
ingredients: 3/4 c. thinly sliced sun-dried tomatoes, plus 2 Tbsp. tomato oil, divided
