1 oz. Parmesan, finely grated (about 1/2 cup), plus 1 Parmesan rind
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, heat tomato oil. Add shallot and garlic; season with 1/2 tsp. salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shallot is translucent, 2 to 3 minutes. Add tomato paste and cook, stirring, until darkened and beginning to stick to bottom of pot, 1 to 2 minutes. Add thyme and sun-dried tomatoes and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 2 minutes.

Stir in broth, red pepper flakes, and Parmesan rind. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to medium to maintain a simmer and cook, stirring, until broth is slightly reduced, about 10 minutes. Remove thyme sprigs and Parmesan rind.

Add gnocchi, chicken, and 1/2 tsp. salt. Return to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi is cooked through according to package directions. Stir in cream and grated Parmesan until melted; season with salt, if needed, and black pepper.
Divide soup among bowls. Top with basil.
description: Our Marry Me chicken gnocchi soup is a combination of Delish fan-favorites Marry Me Chicken and creamy chicken & gnocchi soup.

name: Slow-Cooker Gochujang Meatballs
ingredients: Toasted sesame seeds and thinly sliced scallions, for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk garlic, gochujang, soy sauce, ketchup, vinegar, oil, and honey.
In a slow cooker, arrange meatballs in an even layer and pour sauce over. Stir to coat.
Cook on Low, stirring halfway through, until meatballs are heated through, 3 to 4 hours.
Top with sesame seeds and scallions.
description: No matter how you serve our slow-cooker gochujang meatballs, they’re always a guaranteed easy win.

name: Creamy Spinach  Artichoke Baked Tilapia
instructions: Arrange a rack in upper third of oven; preheat to 375°. Pour flour into a shallow bowl. Pat tilapia dry with paper towels; season all over with 1 1/2 tsp. salt and 1/2 tsp. pepper. Dredge in flour, shaking off excess.

In a large skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil. Working in batches if needed, cook tilapia, turning halfway through, until golden brown on both sides, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Transfer fish to a 13″ x 9″ baking dish.
In same skillet over medium heat, melt butter. Add shallot and cook, stirring, until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute more.
Pour in wine and cook, scraping any browned bits from bottom of skillet, until slightly reduced, about 1 minute.
Stir in artichokes, cream, mustard, and herbs de Provence; season with remaining 1/4 tsp. salt. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in spinach until wilted. Pour sauce over fish.
Bake tilapia until opaque and flesh easily flakes with a fork, about 10 minutes.
description: Spinach and artichoke are a match made in heaven, and in our creamy spinach & artichoke baked tilapia proves it definitively.

name: Ranch Chicken Potato Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. small red potatoes, halved or quartered if large
2 c. small fresh broccoli florets (about 4 oz.; from 1 small broccoli head)
2 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 3), cut into 1" pieces
6 oz. cheddar, shredded on the large holes of a box grater (about 2 c.)
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ᵒ. Place potatoes in a medium saucepan, cover with cold water by 1", and stir in 1 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and bring to a simmer. Cook potatoes until easily pierced with a fork but not falling apart, 7 to 8 minutes. Place broccoli in a colander and drain potatoes over top.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix onion powder, garlic powder, dill, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. In a large bowl, toss chicken, 1 tablespoon spice mix, and 1 teaspoon salt until coated.

In a large wide saucepan or large Dutch oven over medium-high heat, melt 1 tablespoon butter. Add panko and 1 teaspoon spice mix and cook, stirring, until lightly browned and toasted, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

In same pot over medium-high heat, melt remaining 3 tablespoons butter. Add onion and cook, stirring, until softened, about 7 minutes. Add chicken and garlic and cook, stirring, until chicken is no longer pink but not fully cooked through, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle flour over and stir to coat chicken. Slowly pour in broth, stirring, and bring to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened, 3 to 5 minutes.

Reduce heat to low. Stir in cream cheese and 1 teaspoon spice mix until cream cheese is melted and smooth. Add potatoes and broccoli, tossing until combined and coated in sauce. Remove pot from heat. Stir in 1/4 cup sour cream and 1 teaspoon vinegar; season with salt and pepper. Transfer to a 13" x 9" baking dish. Sprinkle cheddar and bread crumbs over.
Bake casserole until edges are bubbling and the cheese is melted, 15 to 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, in a small bowl, mix remaining 1/2 cup sour cream, 1 1/2 teaspoons spice blend, and 1 teaspoon vinegar. Thin with 2 to 3 teaspoons of water until loose enough to drizzle; season with salt and pepper. Drizzle some sauce over casserole. Serve remaining sauce alongside.
description: With chicken breasts, potatoes, broccoli, melty cheese, and an easy ranch dressing, this ranch chicken & potato casserole is a guaranteed crowd-pleaser.

name: Creamy Spinach Garlic Chicken
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, heat 1 Tbsp. oil. Season chicken with paprika, salt, and pepper and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part registers 165°, about 8 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.

In same skillet over medium-high heat, heat remaining 1 Tbsp. oil. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 7 minutes. Add garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute more. Working in batches, add spinach and cook, stirring, until wilted, about 5 minutes total.

Add cream and broth and bring to a simmer. Cook, stirring, until liquid is slightly reduced, about 3 minutes. Add mozzarella and Parmesan and stir until melted, then return chicken to skillet and cook, stirring, until warmed through, about 5 minutes more.
Divide chicken among plates. Spoon spinach mixture over. Serve with bread alongside (if using).
description: Chicken breasts are coated in a creamy spinach and garlic sauce in this one-pan dinner ready in 30 minutes.

name: Grilled Coca-Cola Chicken
ingredients: 1 lime, juiced and zested, plus wedges for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, mix salt, paprika, cayenne, and a few grinds of black pepper. Rub chicken in spice mix until coated.
Cover bowl with plastic wrap. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes and up to overnight.

In a medium pot over medium-high heat, bring soda to a boil. Boil, stirring occasionally and watching closely, until reduced to about 3/4 cup, 20 to 25 minutes. Whisk in soy sauce, Worcestershire, ketchup, brown sugar, lime zest and juice, and salt to create a thin glaze.

Prepare a grill for medium-high heat; preheat 5 minutes (or heat a grill pan over medium-high heat). Brush grates or pan with oil. Using tongs, arrange chicken on grill. Brush exposed side of chicken with glaze.

Grill chicken for 4 minutes. Flip, brush with glaze, and continue to grill for 4 minutes. Flip and brush one more time. Continue to grill until an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of chicken registers 165°, about 4 minutes more.
Transfer to a platter and let cool 5 minutes. Serve with lime wedges alongside.
Make Ahead: Glaze can be made 5 days ahead. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate.
description: Tangy, sweet, and savory, this grilled Coca-Cola glazed chicken is the perfect easy summer dinner that will hit every one of your taste buds.

name: Sheet-Pan Miso Honey Salmon  Snap Peas
ingredients: 2 scallions, thinly sliced, green and white parts separated
instructions: Arrange racks in center and top third of oven; preheat to 425°. In a large bowl, toss white scallion parts, snap peas, 2 tsp. oil, and 1/4 tsp. salt.
Drizzle a baking sheet with remaining 2 tsp. oil. Spread snap pea mixture on prepared sheet in an even layer.
Roast pea mixture on center rack for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine honey, miso, and chili-garlic sauce. Season both sides of salmon with a generous pinch of salt.

Remove snap peas from oven and create a space in the center of baking sheet. Add salmon to sheet and brush with miso glaze. Return to oven and continue to roast until snap peas are tender and salmon is cooked through, 7 to 8 minutes more.
Turn on broiler. Transfer sheet to top rack and broil, watching closely, until glaze and peas are lightly charred, 1 to 2 minutes. Top with green scallion parts and cilantro.
description: This sheet-pan miso honey salmon & snap peas delivers the perfect balance of sweet, savory, and spicy thanks to a simple three-ingredient glaze.

name: One-Pot Pepperoncini Chicken & Rice
ingredients: 1/2 c. liquid from jar of sliced pepperoncini, plus 1/2 cup sliced pepperoncini
instructions: Season chicken all over with oregano, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add chicken and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown, about 6 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.

Reduce heat to medium. Add onion and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is softened, about 7 minutes. Add butter and stir until melted. Add rice and cook, stirring, until warmed through, about 1 minute. Pour in liquid from pepperoncini jar. Cook, stirring occasionally, until most of the liquid is evaporated, 1 to 2 minutes.

Add broth, half-and-half, and red pepper flakes. Return chicken and any accumulated juices to skillet. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low. Cover and simmer, stirring often, until rice is tender and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of chicken registers 165°, about 15 minutes.
Transfer chicken to a plate. Add mozzarella and pepperoncini to skillet and stir until cheese is melted. Return chicken to skillet to serve.
description: This easy one-pot pepperoncini chicken and rice recipe is a complete meal that's ready in under an hour and makes cleanup a breeze.

name: Crispy Sheet-Pan Caprese Tacos
ingredients: 1/2 c. packed fresh basil leaves, thinly sliced
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 375°. On a baking sheet, drizzle 2 Tbsp. oil.

On a clean cutting board, spread each tortilla with 1 tsp. pesto. Sprinkle one-half of each tortilla with cheese. Top cheese with tomatoes and basil. Close tortillas in half. Brush tops with remaining 1 Tbsp. oil. Place another baking sheet on top of tortillas to keep them closed.
Bake tacos for 15 minutes (some liquid may be seeping out, that’s okay). Uncover and continue to bake until crispy on top, 10 to 15 minutes more.
Transfer tacos to a platter. Drizzle with balsamic glaze.
description: With less than 10 ingredients, these simple and easy crispy sheet-pan caprese tacos will become your summer dinnertime hero

name: Sheet-Pan BBQ Pineapple Chicken
ingredients: 1 (20-oz.) can pineapple rings, plus 1/2 cup pineapple juice from can
2 lb. mix of bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs and drumsticks
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk pineapple juice, ketchup, brown sugar, Worcestershire, garlic powder, ground mustard, and cayenne to taste until combined. Transfer 3/4 cup sauce to a small bowl; set aside for glazing.
Season chicken all over with salt and black pepper. Add to bowl with remaining sauce and toss to coat. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 30 minutes and up to 2 hours.
Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 425°. Arrange chicken skin side up on a foil-lined baking sheet. Scatter pineapple rings around chicken.

Roast chicken for 30 minutes. Brush with half of reserved sauce. Continue to roast until skin is crispy and caramelized, and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of chicken registers 165°, about 10 minutes more. Turn on broiler and broil, watching closely, until skin is starting to blacken, 3 to 4 minutes.
Transfer chicken to a platter. Brush with remaining sauce. Sprinkle with scallions and jalapeños.
Make Ahead: BBQ sauce can be made 2 weeks ahead. Store in an airtight container and refrigerate.
description: Sweet and tangy with just a hint of spice, this BBQ pineapple chicken is the perfect summer sheet-pan dinner.

name: Creamy Mexican Street Corn Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp. smoked paprika, plus more for serving
2 tbsp. coarsely chopped fresh cilantro leaves
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook spaghetti, stirring occasionally, until nearly al dente, 8 to 9 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.

Meanwhile, in a large, high-sided skillet over medium heat, heat oil. Cook corn, stirring, until bright yellow if fresh and warmed through if frozen, 2 to 3 minutes. Add garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds; season with 1 tsp. salt. Stir in paprika and cayenne.
Reduce heat to medium and add heavy cream and sour cream. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until cream thickens, about 3 minutes.
Transfer pasta to skillet with sauce. Cook, tossing and adding pasta water as needed, until sauce is slightly thickened and glossy.
Top with scallions, cotija, cilantro, and more paprika. Serve with lime wedges alongside.
description: This Mexican street corn pasta is perfect for any summer meal.

name: 'Cini 'Tini Chicken Piccata
ingredients: 1 tbsp. peperoncini brine, plus 2/3 cup thinly sliced peperoncini
instructions: Pour flour onto a plate. Season chicken all over with salt, then coat both sides with flour, letting excess drip off.
In a large skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil. Cook chicken, turning halfway through, until golden brown on both sides, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
In same skillet over medium-high heat, bring broth, brine, and vodka to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium. Add butter, capers, and sliced peperoncini. Cook, stirring frequently, until butter is melted, about 2 minutes.

Nestle chicken back into sauce, coating each side in sauce. Continue to cook until an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of chicken registers 165°, 1 to 2 minutes. Sprinkle with feta.
description: Our ‘cini ‘tini chicken piccata combines the flavors of our peperoncini martini with our classic chicken piccata.

name: Grilled Steak Salad
ingredients: 1 medium red onion, cut into 1/2" slices
5 oz. baby arugula and/or baby spinach
Torn fresh basil leaves, for serving
instructions: In a small saucepan over medium heat, cook garlic and oil, stirring occasionally, until garlic is fragrant and softened, 5 to 7 minutes. Let cool slightly.
Transfer garlic and oil to a blender. Add vinegar, granulated sugar, salt, and pepper and blend until very smooth. Pour into a jar and refrigerate until ready to use.
Make Ahead: Dressing can be made 1 week ahead. Keep refrigerated.
Prepare a grill for medium-high heat; preheat 5 minutes and clean grates. Drizzle onion with oil; season with salt. Generously season steak with salt and pepper.

Grill onions, turning once, until char marks appear, 2 to 3 minutes per side, and grill steak, turning occasionally, until an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part registers 130° for medium-rare, about 6 minutes per side. Transfer onions and steak to a cutting board. Let cool slightly. Thinly slice steak against the grain.
On a large platter, arrange arugula. Top with steak, onions, avocado, tomatoes, blue cheese, and basil. Drizzle with dressing before serving.
description: Thanks to an all-star ingredient—ribeye steak—this grilled steak salad is not only a perfect weeknight staple, but is fancy enough for date night.

name: Chili Crisp Fried Tofu
ingredients: 1/4 c. chili crisp (mostly the crisp solids)
instructions: Remove tofu from package; discard excess moisture. On a cutting board, holding knife parallel to board, slice tofu block in half to yield 2 thinner blocks. Cut each block into 12 cubes about 1" x 1" each. Arrange in an 8" x 8" baking dish in a single layer.
In a kettle or medium pot, bring 6 cups water to a boil. Pour water over tofu; sprinkle with 2 Tbsp. salt. Let sit 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk chili crisp, honey, soy sauce, and 2 tsp. cornstarch. Place remaining 1/3 cup cornstarch in another small bowl.
Line half of a baking sheet with 2 layers of paper towels or a clean kitchen towel.

Working one or two at a time, remove tofu cubes from water and blot dry on all sides with more paper towels. Arrange on paper towels on prepared sheet. Cover with more paper towels or another clean kitchen towel and lightly pat dry again (do not apply too much pressure).

Working one or two at a time, transfer tofu cubes to cornstarch and toss to coat. Shake of excess and transfer to unlined part of baking sheet. Remove wet paper towels from baking sheet and line with fresh paper towels.

In a large, heavy, high-sided stainless steel or cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil until shimmering. Fry tofu in a single layer, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides, 5 to 6 minutes. Transfer to prepared sheet; season with salt, if desired.
Pour off remaining oil into a heatproof bowl (discard once cool). Return skillet to medium heat.
Whisk chili crisp sauce to reincorporate and pour into skillet. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring, until thickened, 30 to 60 seconds. Add tofu and toss in sauce until coated and warmed through.
Divide rice among bowls. Top with tofu mixture and scallions.
description: Featuring a vibrant sauce made with just four pantry ingredients, this crunchy chili crisp fried tofu promises to spice up your weeknight dinner.

name: Cheesy Bacon Ranch Chicken
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat, cook bacon, flipping once, until crispy, about 8 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel–lined plate. Drain all but 2 tablespoons of bacon fat from the skillet.
Season chicken with salt and pepper. Return skillet to medium-high heat, add chicken and cook until golden and just cooked through, about 6 minutes per side.
Reduce heat to medium and sprinkle chicken with ranch seasoning and top with mozzarella. Cover the skillet and cook, until cheese is melted and bubbly, about 5 minutes.
Crumble and sprinkle bacon and chives on top before serving.
description: If you're trying a keto diet (or just need a new weeknight chicken recipe), then these cheesy bacon ranch chicken breasts are the perfect thing.

name: Greek Chicken
instructions: In a large bowl, combine 2 tablespoons olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano. Whisk until combined then add chicken thighs and toss to coat. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and let marinate in the refrigerator for at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours.

When you’re ready to cook the chicken, preheat oven to 425°. In a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat, heat remaining tablespoon olive oil. Season both sides of marinated chicken with salt and pepper, then add chicken skin-side down and pour in the remaining marinade.
Sear until the skin becomes golden and crispy, about 10 minutes. Flip chicken and add asparagus, zucchini and lemon to the skillet.
Transfer pan to oven and cook until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.
description: This easy Greek chicken recipe is a garlic lover's dream. Tender chicken thighs are matched up with zucchini and asparagus.

name: Lasagnchiladas
ingredients: 8 oz. hot Italian sausage, casings removed, crumbled
2 1/2 c. homemade or store-bought marinara sauce, divided
1 tbsp. chopped fresh basil, plus more for serving
2 oz. Parmesan, finely grated (about 1 cup), divided
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 375°. In a large skillet over medium heat, heat oil and swirl pan to coat. Add onions and carrots; season with 1/2 tsp. salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 7 minutes. Add garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute more. Add beef and sausage and cook, breaking meat into small pieces with a wooden spoon, until no pink remains, about 7 minutes.

Add taco seasoning and tomato paste and cook, stirring, until paste darkens in color, about 2 minutes. Add broth and 2 cups marinara. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 10 to 12 minutes; season with salt.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine egg, ricotta, basil, oregano, and 3/4 cup Parmesan.

Spread remaining 1/2 cup marinara in the bottom of a 13" x 9" baking dish. Place a tortilla on a work surface or large plate next to dish. Spoon 1/2 cup meat sauce in center of tortilla. Top with a scant 1/4 cup egg mixture. Roll tortilla to close and transfer to baking dish. Repeat with remaining tortillas. Top tortillas with remaining meat sauce. Sprinkle with mozzarella and remaining 1/4 cup Parmesan. Spray a sheet of foil with cooking spray and cover baking dish with foil greased side down.
Bake lasagnchiladas until warmed through and cheese is melted, about 25 minutes. Uncover and move a rack to position closest to broiler. Turn on broiler.
Broil, watching closely, until cheese is bubbling and brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Top with more basil.
description: In this lasagna and enchilada mash-up, bolognese and ricotta are rolled into flour tortillas, then topped with more cheese before being baked until perfection.

name: Enchilada Casserole
ingredients: 1 (15.5-oz.) can black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. In a large skillet over medium heat, heat oil. Add onion and pepper and cook until soft, 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 minute more. Add beans, corn, chicken, and green chilis and cook until warmed through, 5 minutes. Reserve ½ cup enchilada sauce then pour remaining sauce into skillet, stirring to combine.

Spread reserved ½ cup enchilada sauce into a 9”-x-13” then layer 6 tortillas in pan, overlapping to cover the entire pan. Pour ⅓ of mixture over tortillas then top with about ⅓ of each cheese. Top with another layer of tortillas and repeat to make 2 more layers, finishing with cheese.
Bake for 30 minutes or until cheese is melty and sauce is bubbling.
Garnish with sour cream, cilantro, and avocado.
description: This chicken enchilada casserole skips all the rolling of the tortillas and makes serving this crowd-pleasing dish easier than ever.

name: One-Pan Creamy Chicken  Gnocchi
ingredients: 8 oz. baby bella mushrooms, thinly sliced
Pinch of crushed red pepper flakes
instructions: Season chicken on both sides with salt and black pepper. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, heat 1 Tbsp. oil. Add chicken and cook, turning halfway through, until golden brown, about 4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.

In same skillet over medium heat, heat remaining 1 Tbsp. oil. Add shallot and mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic, thyme, and oregano and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute more.

Add broth and scrape up any browned bits on bottom of pan, then slowly add half-and-half. Bring to a simmer; season with salt, black pepper, and red pepper flakes. Stir in gnocchi and return chicken to pan. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part registers 165°, 8 to 10 minutes. Transfer chicken to a cutting board.
Add mozzarella and Parmesan and cook, stirring, until melted, about 3 minutes. Add spinach and cook, stirring, until wilted, about 1 minute more.
Thinly slice chicken and return to skillet; season with salt and black pepper, if needed.
description: This chicken and gnocchi dish, with a creamy sauce, comes together in one pan for the easiest weeknight staple.

name: The Original Marry Me Chicken
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 375°. In a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat, heat 1 Tbsp. oil. Generously season chicken with salt and black pepper and cook, turning halfway through, until golden brown, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer chicken to a plate.

In same skillet over medium heat, heat remaining 2 Tbsp. oil. Stir in garlic, thyme, and red pepper flakes. Cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in broth, tomatoes, cream, and Parmesan; season with salt. Bring to a simmer, then return chicken and any accumulated juices to skillet.
Transfer skillet to oven. Bake chicken until cooked through and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part registers 165°, 10 to 12 minutes.
Arrange chicken on a platter. Spoon sauce over. Top with basil.
description: Delish’s original Marry Me Chicken is the perfect chicken recipe for date nights, special occasions, or any weeknight dinners.

name: Oven-Baked Salmon
ingredients: Finely chopped fresh parsley, for serving
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 350°. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil, then line foil with parchment to prevent any interaction of lemon slices with foil. In center of parchment, arrange lemon slices in an even layer.
Season salmon with salt and pepper and arrange on top of lemon slices.
In a small bowl, whisk garlic, butter, honey, oregano, and thyme. Pour over salmon, then fold up parchment and foil around salmon.
Bake salmon until opaque, cooked through, and flesh easily flakes with a fork, about 25 minutes.
Turn on broiler. Broil salmon, watching closely, until browned in spots, 4 to 6 minutes.
Transfer lemons and salmon to a platter. Top with parsley.
description: This simple oven-baked salmon recipe is a must-have, whether you're searching for an easy weeknight dinner or a way to feed a crowd.

name: Chicken Fajitas
ingredients: 2 bell peppers, seeds and ribs removed, thinly sliced
Corn tortillas, warmed, and lime wedges for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk lime juice, chili powder, red pepper flakes, ¼ cup oil, and 1 tsp. cumin. Season chicken with salt and pepper, then add to bowl and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes and up to 2 hours.

In a large skillet over medium heat, heat remaining 1 Tbsp. oil. Add chicken and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part registers 160°, about 8 minutes per side. Transfer to a cutting board. Let rest 10 minutes, then slice into strips.

Meanwhile, in same skillet over medium heat, combine peppers, onion, and remaining 1 tsp. cumin; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 7 minutes. Return sliced chicken to skillet and toss until combined. Serve with tortillas and top with a squeeze of fresh lime juice.
description: Focusing on only 3 key ingredients, our classic chicken fajita recipe requires minimal prep and cook time, meaning dinner on the table FAST.

name: Beef & Broccoli
ingredients: 2 tbsp. dry sherry or shaoxing wine
1/3 c. plus 1/4 c. low-sodium soy sauce, divided
1 1/2 lb. flank or skirt steak, sliced very thin against the grain
Toasted sesame seeds and white rice, for serving
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine sherry, vinegar, salt, pepper, 1/3 cup soy sauce, 1 tablespoon plus 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch, and 1 tablespoon brown sugar. Add steak and toss to coat. Let sit 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, finely chop garlic and ginger. Slice scallions and separate green and white parts. In a small bowl, combine garlic, ginger, and white scallion parts; reserve green parts for serving. Chop broccoli into florets and transfer to another small bowl.

In a large measuring cup, whisk broth, oyster sauce, sriracha (if using), and remaining 1/4 cup soy sauce, 1 tablespoon cornstarch, and 1 tablespoon brown sugar. When ready to cook, arrange bowls of beef, garlic mixture, broccoli, and stir-fry sauce next to stove.

In a large skillet over medium-high heat, heat 1 tablespoon oil. Add half of beef and cook, undisturbed, 1 minute, then stir and cook until cooked through and starting to char in some spots, about 1 minute more. Transfer to a plate. Repeat with 1 tablespoon oil and remaining beef. Discard excess marinade.

Return skillet to medium heat and heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Add garlic mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Add broccoli and cook, stirring frequently, until slightly softened, about 1 minute, then add stir-fry sauce. Cover and cook 3 minutes. Uncover, return beef to skillet, and toss to coat. Cook, tossing frequently, until warmed through and broccoli is crisp-tender, 2 to 3 minutes more.
Divide rice among plates. Top with stir-fry, sesame seeds, and reserved green scallion parts.
description: A classic Chinese-American dish with thinly sliced, velveted flank steak in a rich brown sauce with tender-crisp broccoli.

name: Best Homemade Lasagna
instructions: In a large pot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Cook beef and pork, breaking up with a wooden spoon, until no longer pink, about 6 minutes. Drain excess fat.

Add tomato paste to pot and cook, stirring, until incorporated, about 1 minute. Add marinara sauce and stir to combine. Bring to a boil, then stir in 1 teaspoon salt. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until flavors have melded, about 20 minutes; season with remaining 1 teaspoon salt, if needed.
In a medium pot over medium heat, heat milk until warm to the touch but not boiling.

In a large pot over medium heat, melt butter. Add flour and cook, whisking frequently, until light tan in color and texture resembles wet sand, about 2 minutes. Whisking constantly, very slowly add milk until combined. Increase heat to medium-high and continue to cook, whisking constantly, until sauce is thickened and smooth, 3 to 5 minutes.
Pass spoon through edges of pot to collect any butter-flour mixture that wasn’t fully incorporated and mix to combine. Stir in nutmeg; season with salt and pepper.

Preheat oven to 350°. In a deep 13" x 9" ceramic, glass, or metal baking dish, spread 1 1/2 cups Bolognese, followed by 3 pasta sheets and 3/4 cup béchamel. Sprinkle with about one-fifth of mozzarella and Parmesan. Repeat to make 5 layers, finishing with cheese.
Spray a sheet of foil with cooking spray. Cover dish greased side down.
Bake lasagna 20 minutes, then increase oven temperature to 400°. Uncover and continue to bake until sides are bubbling and darkened and cheese starts to turn golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes.
Turn broiler to medium. Broil lasagna, watching closely, until top is browned in spots, about 1 minute.
Let cool 15 minutes. Top with parsley.
description: Our homemade lasagna recipe is easy enough to be a staple weeknight dinner, but with a few simple (but worthwhile) steps, is fancy enough to win date night.

name: Sweet Potato Chili
ingredients: 1 bell pepper, seeds and ribs removed, finely chopped
4 large sweet potatoes (8 to 12 oz. each), peeled, cut into 1" cubes
Finely chopped fresh parsley, for serving
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, heat oil. Add onion and bell pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 7 minutes. Add garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute more.

Add tomato paste and stir until well coated. Add sausage and cook, breaking up meat with a spoon, until no longer pink, 7 minutes. Add chili powder, oregano, garlic powder, and cayenne; season with salt and black pepper.
Add potatoes, broth, and tomatoes and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium. Cover and let simmer until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes.
Top with parsley and serve with avocado and sour cream, if desired.
description: Sweet potato chili, loaded with Italian sausage, bell peppers, and onion, is about to become your cold-weather favorite.

name: Pumpkin Tomato Soup With Grilled Swiss Cheese Sticks
ingredients: 4 c. low-sodium vegetable or chicken broth
1/3 c. grated Parmesan, plus shavings for serving
3 tbsp. heavy cream, plus more for drizzling
Chopped fresh basil leaves, for serving
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium-high heat, melt butter. Add garlic and red pepper flakes and cook, stirring, until garlic is fragrant and light golden, about 1 minute.

Add tomato paste and cook, stirring, until lightly toasted, about 1 minute more. Add broth, pumpkin puree, Parmesan, and 3/4 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until soup is slightly thickened and flavors are melded, about 5 minutes. Stir in cream.
Using a rolling pin, roll bread into flat, 1/4"-thick squares. Place 1 slice cheese on each piece of bread and tightly roll up.

In a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, melt butter, swirling to coat bottom of pan. Working in batches, add sticks to skillet seam side down and cook, turning often, until bread is golden and cheese is melty, about 3 minutes.
Ladle soup into bowls. Drizzle with cream and sprinkle with basil. Serve with grilled cheese sticks alongside.
description: This pumpkin tomato soup recipe gets a fall upgrade with pumpkin puree and grilled Swiss cheese sticks that couldn't be easier to make.

name: Crock-Pot Potato Soup
ingredients: 2 lb. Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled, cubed
1 1/2 c. shredded cheddar, plus more for serving
instructions: In a large (6- to 8-qt.) slow cooker, combine potatoes, broth, and thyme; season with salt and pepper. Cover and cook until potatoes are tender, 4 to 6 hours on Low or 2 to 3 hours on High.
Using a slotted spoon, transfer about half of potatoes to a medium heatproof bowl or plate. Using a potato masher, mash remaining potatoes in slow cooker. Return potatoes in bowl to slow cooker.

In a medium bowl, whisk milk and flour. Add milk mixture, cheese, cream, and sour cream to slow cooker and stir to combine. Cover and cook on High until cheese is melted and soup is warmed through, about 30 minutes more.
Meanwhile, in a large skillet over medium heat, cook bacon, turning occasionally, until crispy, about 8 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and let cool. Crumble into pieces.
Top soup with bacon, chives, and more cheese.
description: Our Crock-Pot potato soup will warm you up all fall and winter long.

name: Copycat Olive Garden Zuppa Toscana
ingredients: 1 lb. Hot Italian sausage, casings removed
1 bunch curly kale, leaves stripped and chopped
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, cook sausage, breaking up with the back of a wooden spoon, until browned and no longer pink, 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer to a plate to drain.

Add onion to pot and let cook until soft, 5 minutes, then add garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 minute more. Season with salt and pepper. Add chicken broth and potatoes and cook until potatoes are tender, 23 to 25 minutes.
Stir in kale and let cook until leaves are tender and bright green, 3 minutes, then stir in heavy cream, sausage, and bacon and simmer 5 minutes more.
Season with pepper, garnish with Parm, and serve.
description: Looking for an Olive Garden soup recipe? This Copycat Olive Garden Zuppa Toscana Soup from Delish.com is the best.

name: Marry Me Chicken Meatball Soup
ingredients: 3/4 c. thinly sliced sun-dried tomatoes, plus 2 Tbsp. tomato oil from jar, divided
1 oz. Parmesan, finely grated (about 1/2 cup), plus 1 rind, divided
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk egg until homogenous. Add garlic, Parmesan, panko, basil, cream, thyme, salt, and black pepper and stir until combined. Add chicken and fold until tacky to the touch.
Using gloved hands (or wet hands), divide mixture into 18 to 20 portions and roll into balls. Arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
In a large Dutch oven over medium heat, heat olive oil. Add meatballs in a single layer and cook, turning halfway through, until browned on 2 sides, about 5 minutes total.
Meanwhile, remove parchment from baking sheet and discard. Transfer browned meatballs to bare sheet; set aside until ready to use.

In same pot over medium heat, heat tomato oil. Add shallot and garlic; season with 1/2 tsp. salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until shallot is translucent, 2 to 3 minutes. Add tomato paste and cook, stirring, until darkened and beginning to stick to pot, 1 to 2 minutes. Add thyme and sundried tomatoes and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 2 minutes.

Stir in broth, red pepper flakes, and Parmesan rind. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat and cook, reducing heat to maintain a simmer, until slightly reduced, about 10 minutes. Remove thyme and Parmesan rind. Add meatballs; return to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until meatballs are heated and cooked through, about 5 minutes more. Stir in cream and grated Parmesan; season with pepper, then taste and season with more salt, if needed.
Divide soup among bowls. Top with basil.
description: Featuring juicy chicken meatballs flecked with fresh herbs and cheese, a bowl of this savory, comforting soup is sure to be anyone’s love language.

name: French Onion Gnocchi Soup
ingredients: 3 large yellow onions (about 2 3/4 lb. total), halved, thinly sliced into half moons
1 tsp. finely chopped fresh thyme, plus more for serving
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, melt butter. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until deeply golden brown and caramelized, about 25 minutes. Add garlic, flour, and thyme and cook, stirring, until garlic is fragrant, about 1 minute; season with salt and pepper.

Add wine and bring to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is almost evaporated, about 5 minutes. Add stock and bring to a boil. Add gnocchi and return to a boil. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi is al dente and floats, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Heat broiler to high. Arrange 4 large heatproof ramekins or serving bowls on a baking sheet. Carefully ladle soup into ramekins. Top with cheese.
Transfer sheet with bowls to oven and broil, watching closely, until cheese is bubbling and golden, 2 to 4 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes.
Top soup with thyme; carefully serve as ramekins will be hot.
description: Forget bread and croutons, this French onion gnocchi soup recipe is our favorite way to enjoy the comforting classic.

name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken Chili
ingredients: 4 c. shredded cooked chicken (from about one rotisserie chicken)
1 poblano chile or green bell pepper, ribs and seeds removed, finely chopped
1 (13.5-oz.) can cannellini beans, drained, not rinsed
instructions: In a large, high-sided skillet over medium heat, heat 4 Tbsp. oil. Add Italian seasoning and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 10 seconds. Add chicken and cook, stirring, until heated through, about 2 minutes; season with 1 tsp. salt. Transfer chicken mixture to a plate.

In same skillet over medium heat, heat remaining 2 Tbsp. oil. Cook onion and chile, scraping up browned bits on bottom of skillet, until onions are soft and translucent, about 7 minutes; season with remaining 1/2 tsp. salt. Add garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add tomato paste and cook, stirring to coat vegetables, until just starting to caramelize, about 1 minute. Add tomatoes and cook, stirring frequently, until softened and skins wilted, about 5 minutes.

Add broth and beans, return chicken and any accumulated juices to skillet, and bring to a simmer. Add cream and spinach and cook, stirring, until spinach is wilted, 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in lemon zest, then serve topped with cheese.
description: This creamy Tuscan chicken chili is inspired by our iconic creamy Tuscan chicken recipe, which is also loaded with tomatoes, heavy cream, and spinach.

name: Slow-Cooker Creamy Chicken & Potato Soup
ingredients: 1 bunch Tuscan kale, center ribs and stems removed, chopped (about 4 c.)
instructions: Season chicken all over with salt and pepper and place in a slow cooker. Add potatoes, cream cheese, onion, carrot, jalapeño, garlic, and thyme and stir to combine. Add broth, milk, bouillon, curry powder, and oregano; season with salt and pepper.

Cover and cook on low until chicken is tender and falling apart, 5 to 6 hours. Transfer chicken to a plate and shred with 2 forks. Return chicken to slow cooker and add kale. Stir until well combined.
Continue to cook on low until kale is wilted, about 10 minutes more; season with salt and pepper, if needed.
description: This easy slow-cooker creamy chicken & potato soup recipe is rich and creamy and warmly spiced by curry powder.

name: Lemony White Bean & Potato Soup
ingredients: 2 tbsp. extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for drizzling
3 large leeks, rinsed, tough outer layer removed, light green and white parts only, sliced into thin half-moons
1 large stalk celery, sliced about 1/4" thick (about 1/2 c.)
2 lb. waxy yellow potatoes, cut into about 3/4" pieces
1/2 c. chopped fresh parsley or dill or 1/4 c. chopped fresh rosemary
Finely grated Parmesan and toasted baguette (optional), for serving
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, heat oil. Add leeks and celery; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 10 minutes. Add garlic and Italian seasoning; cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute more.

Add potatoes, beans, broth, lemon zest, Parmesan rind, bay leaf (if using), and 1 cup water; season with salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, uncovered, until potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes.
Discard Parmesan rind. Blend about one-quarter of soup with an immersion blender or handheld masher. Stir in lemon juice and parsley; season with salt and pepper.
Ladle soup into bowls. Drizzle with oil. Sprinkle with Parmesan and serve with toast alongside (if using).
description: In this one-pot bean and potato soup, a combination of potatoes, leeks, and fresh lemon is transformed into something wholly unique and irresistible.

name: Baked Feta Soup
ingredients: Pinch crushed red pepper flakes, optional
2 slices white bread, crusts removed, cut into 1/2” cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400º. In a medium baking dish, combine tomatoes, shallots, garlic, and all but about 2 teaspoons of oil. Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes then toss to coat.

Place ⅔ of the feta into the center of the tomato mixture and drizzle with a bit of the oil that collected in the baking dish. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, or until tomatoes are bursting and the feta is golden on top.
Meanwhile, on a small baking sheet tray or baking dish, toss bread cubes, ¼ tsp salt, and the remaining olive oil. Set aside.
If using a standard blender: Carefully transfer the tomato and feta mixture, along with chicken stock, into a blender then blend until totally smooth. Transfer to a medium saucepan.
If using an immersion blender: Carefully transfer the tomato and feta mixture to a medium saucepan then blend with an immersion blender until totally smooth. Stir in chicken stock.
Bring soup mixture up to a simmer over medium low and let cook for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, while the soup cooks, transfer bread to the oven and bake until the croutons are golden brown, tossing halfway through.
Serve by ladling soup in bowls and garnishing with some bread crumbs, remaining feta, fresh dill and a drizzle of olive oil.
description: Feta Pasts took off on TikTok and we used that recipe as an inspiration for this Baked feta Pasta soup that will remind you of a creamy tomato bisque.

name: Southwestern Wedding Soup
ingredients: 1/4 c. finely grated cotija or Parmesan
2 tbsp. adobo sauce from a can of chipotle chiles
1/2 c. acini di pepe or other small pasta shape
Crumbled cotija or finely grated Parmesan and lime wedges, for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, mix egg, crushed chips, and cotija. Let sit 5 minutes.
Add pork, garlic, cilantro, chili powder, salt, oregano, pepper, and cumin. Mix until well combined.

Grease a teaspoon with oil, then make heaping scoops of meatball mixture. Gently form into about a 1" ball, then arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Repeat with remaining meatball mixture, greasing teaspoon as needed, until you have 55 to 60 meatballs.

In a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat, heat oil until shimmering. Working in batches, arrange meatballs in a single layer and cook, undisturbed, until one side is browned, 3 to 4 minutes. Carefully turn and continue to cook, turning occasionally, until meatballs are browned on multiple sides, 8 to 10 minutes total. Transfer to a plate.

In same pot over medium heat, cook onion, carrot, and celery, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic, tomato paste, and cumin and continue to cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute more.

Return meatballs to pot. Add green chiles and adobo sauce and stir to combine. Add broth, then bring to a boil. Add pasta, then reduce heat to medium-low and bring to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta is tender, about 10 minutes.
Remove pot from heat. Stir spinach and cilantro until wilted; season with salt and pepper.
Divide soup among bowls. Top with cotija and serve with lime wedges alongside.
description: This Southwestern wedding soup has many of the elements you’d expect from the source material, like meatballs, pasta, and vegetables, with a Tex-Mex spin.

name: Red Curry Shrimp & Noodle Soup
ingredients: 1 stalk lemongrass, tough outer layers removed, finely chopped
2 scallions, green and white parts separated, sliced
8 c. low-sodium chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Peel and devein shrimp; reserve shells. In a large bowl, toss shrimp, 1 tablespoon curry paste, and 3/4 teaspoon salt until coated.

In a large Dutch oven or heavy pot over medium-high heat, heat 2 tablespoons oil until shimmering. Add shrimp mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, until shrimp are opaque and cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer shrimp to a medium bowl.

In same pot over medium heat, heat 1 tablespoon oil. Cook lemongrass and white scallion parts, stirring, until slightly softened and fragrant, about 1 minute. Add garlic, ginger, coriander, and remaining 3 tablespoons curry paste. Cook, stirring, until very fragrant and starting to slightly char, 2 to 3 minutes. Add shrimp shells and cook, stirring, until shells begin to turn pink, about 3 minutes more. Add broth, increase heat to high, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened and flavors have melded, about 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and rinse with cool water. Drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon oil and toss to coat to keep noodles from sticking together.

Using a spider or large slotted spoon, remove shrimp shells from broth; discard. Increase heat to medium and add milk and mushrooms. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms have softened, about 15 minutes. Stir in fish sauce, soy sauce, brown sugar, and lime juice; season with salt.
Divide noodles and shrimp among bowls. Ladle hot broth over noodles. Top with green scallion parts, avocado, bean sprouts, and cilantro.
description: Red curry marinated shrimp and glass noodles are served in a red curry, coconut milk, and mushroom broth with bean sprouts, avocado, scallions, and cilantro.

name: Creamy Tortellini Minestrone
ingredients: 1 (15-oz.) can fire-roasted or plain diced tomatoes
1 (15-oz.) can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
1 medium zucchini, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced
4 oz. green beans, trimmed and cut into 1" pieces (about 1 c. total)
instructions: In a large pot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Cook onion, carrot, celery, and garlic, stirring occasionally, until onion is starting to soften, 4 to 6 minutes. Stir in tomato paste and cook, stirring, until lightly toasted, about 1 minute more.

Add broth, chickpeas, tomatoes and any juices in can, kidney beans, Italian seasoning, and 1 cup water; season with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium and simmer 5 minutes. Add zucchini and green beans and simmer, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender, 8 to 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a large pot of boiling salted water, cook pasta until al dente, usually 2 to 3 minutes less than package instructions. Drain pasta.

Add pasta and spinach to vegetable mixture and cook, tossing, until spinach is wilted and tortellini is warmed through, about 1 minute. Remove pot from heat and stir in half-and-half; season with more salt and pepper, if desired.
Divide soup among bowls. Top with Parmesan.
description: This creamy tortellini minestrone recipe combines the best of Italian minestrone soup with cheesy tortellini pasta.

name: Slow-Cooker Creamy Chicken Gnocchi Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. boneless skinless chicken breasts (about 3 breasts)
instructions: Combine onion, carrots, celery, and garlic in the bowl of your slow cooker. Season chicken on both sides with salt and pepper and place on top of vegetables. Add thyme and rosemary, then pour in chicken broth. Cook on high for 4 to 5 hours or low for 7 to 8 hours.

Remove chicken and rosemary sprigs from slow cooker and discard rosemary. Using 2 forks, shred chicken, then return chicken to soup. Remove about 1/4 cup of hot broth and place in a medium bowl. Add cornstarch to broth and whisk to combine, then pour back into soup. Add cream and gnocchi, cover, and cook 45 minutes more on high.
Stir spinach into soup until wilted. Season to taste and serve with freshly ground black pepper.
description: Slow-Cooker Creamy Gnocchi Soup from Delish.com is the easiest and coziest weeknight dinner.

name: Crock-Pot White Chicken Chili
ingredients: 1 jalapeño, seeded, finely chopped, plus more, thinly sliced, for serving
2 (15.5-oz.) cans white beans (such as Great Northern or cannellini), 1 can drained
1/2 c. sour cream, plus more for serving
Sliced avocado, finely chopped fresh cilantro, and lime wedges, for serving
instructions: In a medium or large slow cooker, combine onion, garlic, chopped jalapeño, chicken, oregano, cumin, salt, black pepper, and cayenne (if using). Cover with beans, including liquid from one can, broth, and chiles and stir to combine.
Cover and cook on High for 3 to 4 hours, or Low for 8 hours, until an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of chicken registers 165°.
Transfer chicken to a cutting board. Let cool slightly, then shred.

Transfer 3/4 cup beans (it’s okay if some veggies come along) and liquid to a large bowl or measuring cup. Using a fork or immersion blender, puree beans. Return shredded chicken and pureed beans to slow cooker. Add corn and sour cream and cook on High until corn is cooked through, about 30 minutes more.
Season with more salt and black pepper, if needed. Top with sour cream, sliced jalapeño, avocado, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime juice.
description: The Crock-Pot makes creamy and flavorful white chicken chili easier (and more delicious) than ever.

name: Slow-Cooker Beef Chili
ingredients: Pinch of cayenne pepper or chipotle chili powder (optional)
1 c. beer, low-sodium beef broth, or water
Fritos, shredded cheddar, thinly sliced scallions, and sour cream, for serving (optional)
instructions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion, season with salt, and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened and translucent, 7 to 9 minutes. Add garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute more. Add tomato paste and cook, stirring, until brick-red, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer onion mixture to a large slow cooker.

In same skillet over medium heat, break up beef; season with salt and black pepper. Cook, undisturbed, until mostly browned, about 5 minutes. (It doesn’t need to be fully cooked through.) Add chili powder, cumin, paprika, oregano, and cayenne (if using) and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Using a slotted spoon, transfer beef mixture to slow cooker. Discard any excess fat.
Add beans, tomatoes, and beer to slow cooker; season with salt and black pepper.
Cover and cook on low, uncovering during the last 20 minutes if needed, until chili has slightly thickened, 4 to 6 hours.
Squeeze lime halves over chili; season with salt and pepper. Top with Fritos, cheddar, scallions, and sour cream (if using).
description: Chili is already one of our favorite make-ahead, big-batch dinners, but it becomes a true hero of any meal plan when made in a slow cooker.

name: Slow-Cooker Chicken Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 2 bell peppers, seeds and ribs removed, chopped
1/4 c. chopped fresh cilantro, plus more for serving
3 small corn tortillas, cut into strips
Sliced avocados, sour cream, and lime wedges, for serving
instructions: In a large slow cooker, spread chicken in the bottom in an even layer. Add onion, bell peppers, garlic, beans, tomatoes, corn, cilantro, chili powder, cumin, and salt. Pour broth over. Cover and cook on low until chicken is cooked through and falling apart, 5 to 6 hours.
Shred chicken with 2 forks, then top with Monterey Jack. Cover and continue to cook on low until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes more.

Meanwhile, in a large skillet over medium heat, heat oil. Add tortilla strips and cook, tossing occasionally, until crispy and golden, about 3 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate; season with salt.
Top soup with tortilla crisps, avocado, sour cream, and cilantro. Serve with lime wedges alongside.
description: This slow cooker chicken tortilla soup recipe combines chicken breasts, fire-roasted tomatoes, and beans for an easy meal. Don't skip the tortilla croutons!

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
ingredients: 2 lb. bone-in, skin-on chicken pieces, preferably a mix of chicken thighs and breasts
1 small yellow onion, coarsely chopped (about 1 1/4 c.)
1 large carrot, peeled, halved lengthwise, sliced 1/8" thick (about 1 cup)
instructions: In a large, deep pot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Season chicken on all sides with 2 tsp. salt, then add to pot skin side down. Cook, undisturbed, until golden brown on one side, about 5 minutes. Turn and cook until golden brown on the other side, about 5 minutes more.

Add stock, water, thyme, and bay leaf. Bring to a bare simmer over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of breast registers 165°, 20 to 30 minutes.

Transfer chicken breasts to a cutting board. Continue to cook dark meat about 40 minutes more. Transfer dark meat to cutting board and let cool at least 10 minutes. Remove skin and bones and discard. Shred chicken into bite-sized pieces.

Meanwhile, discard thyme and bay leaf. Add onion, celery, and carrot and cook over medium-low heat, adjusting heat as needed to maintain a bare simmer and stirring occasionally, until just barely tender, about 5 minutes. Add egg noodles and cook, stirring occasionally, until just al dente, about 5 minutes more.
Stir in chicken and pepper; season with remaining 2 tsp. salt, as needed.
Divide soup among bowls. Top with parsley and more pepper.

Make Ahead: Soup (without noodles) can be made 5 days ahead. Store in an airtight container and refrigerate. To serve, bring soup to a simmer in a large pot, add noodles, and simmer until noodles are al dente, about 5 minutes.
description: Chicken noodle soup is the epitome of comfort food. Our easy, classic recipe packs a flavorful punch that will have you feeling cozy in no time.

name: Best Tomato Soup
ingredients: 1/2 small fennel bulb, thinly sliced (about 1 c.)
1/2 c. heavy cream, plus more for drizzling
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, melt butter. Add celery, onion, fennel, and 1/2 tsp. salt and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and translucent, 7 to 8 minutes. Add tomato paste and cook, stirring frequently, until darkened, about 2 minutes. Add red pepper and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute more.

Add whole tomatoes with their juices, tomato juice, and brown sugar. Bring to a simmer, mashing down on tomatoes with a wooden spoon or rubber spatula to break into large pieces, and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly reduced, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly, about 5 minutes.

Transfer half of tomato mixture to a standard blender and blend until smooth (or use an immersion blender and puree in pot). Pour blended soup into a large bowl and repeat with remaining tomato mixture. Return soup to pot and stir in cream. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, just until warmed through (do not let it boil); season with remaining 1 1/2 tsp. salt.
Divide soup among bowls. Drizzle with cream and top with basil.
description: Boasting three different types of tomato, this robust, comforting tomato soup has big, rich flavor and a super-creamy finish.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
ingredients: 3 c. shredded cheddar, plus more for serving
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, melt butter. Add onion and celery and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 7 to 9 minutes.
Whisk in flour and cook, stirring, until vegetables are coated, about 1 minute. Slowly pour in broth; season with salt and pepper.
Stir in broccoli and carrots. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender, 8 to 12 minutes.
Slowly add milk and bring to a simmer. Stir in cheddar until melted and smooth; season with salt and pepper.
Divide soup among bowls. Top with more cheddar.
description: Panera fans, this broccoli cheddar soup recipe is not only so easy to create at home, but tastes even better (and more comforting!) than the classic.

name: Best Potato Soup
ingredients: 6 medium russet potatoes (about 3 1/2 lb. total), peeled, cut into 1/2" cubes
6 c. low-sodium vegetable or chicken broth
instructions: In a large (at least 6-qt.) pot over medium heat, melt butter. Add onion and celery and cook, stirring occasionally, until very tender and translucent, about 10 minutes. Add garlic and thyme; season with salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes more. Add potatoes and stir to combine. Stir in broth and increase heat to high. Bring to a boil and cook, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender, 5 to 7 minutes.

Reduce heat to medium-low. Using a ladle, transfer about 4 c. potato mixture and broth to a blender. Partially cover or vent lid and blend until smooth. Return to pot, stirring to incorporate. Add half-and-half and bring to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally to ensure soup isn’t scorching bottom of pot, until slightly thickened, 12 to 15 minutes.
Stir in Gouda until melted; season with salt.
Divide soup among bowls. Top with chives and a few grinds of pepper.
description: This creamy vegetarian potato soup flavored with thyme, smoked Gouda cheese, and chives is the easiest soup that will warm you up all winter.

name: Butternut Squash Soup
ingredients: 1 large butternut squash, peeled, seeds removed, cut into 1" cubes
2 Yukon Gold or russet potatoes, peeled, chopped into 1" pieces
1 tbsp. fresh thyme, plus more for garnish
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 400º. On a large baking sheet, toss squash and potatoes with 2 Tbsp. oil; generously season with salt and pepper.
Roast squash and potatoes, stirring halfway through, until tender, 30 to 35 minutes.

Meanwhile, in a large pot over medium heat, heat butter and remaining 1 Tbsp. oil until butter melts. Cook onion, celery, and carrot, stirring, until softened, 7 to 10 minutes. Stir in thyme; generously season with salt and pepper.
Add roasted squash and potatoes, then pour in broth. Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly reduced and flavors have melded, about 10 minutes.

Using an immersion blender, blend soup, adding more broth if needed, until creamy. Divide among bowls. (Alternatively, carefully transfer batches of the hot soup to a standard blender and divide among bowls.)
Top with more thyme. Drizzle with cream (if using).
description: A fall favorite, this butternut squash soup is the perfect easy, comforting meal to cozy up to on weeknights.

name: Pierogi Soup
ingredients: 1 head of savoy cabbage, cut into 1" pieces (about 4 cups)
2 large carrots, peeled, sliced 1/4" thick (about 1 1/2 cups)
1 (16-oz.) pkg. frozen pierogi (such as Mrs. T’s)
Finely chopped fresh dill and sour cream, for serving
instructions: In a large pot over medium-high heat, cook bacon, stirring occasionally, until tender and crispy, about 8 minutes. Using a slotted spoon or tongs, transfer to a small heatproof bowl, leaving fat behind.
In same pot over medium heat, cook cabbage, carrot, and garlic, stirring, until carrots are softened and cabbage is wilted with slight caramelization, 8 to 10 minutes; season with salt.
Pour in broth. Bring to a simmer, then add pierogies. Cook, stirring occasionally, until pierogies are tender and cabbage and carrots are softened but not mushy, 6 to 7 minutes.
Top soup with cheese, bacon, dill, and a dollop of sour cream.
description: I’m turning frozen pierogi into the star of a weeknight dinner by adding them to one of my favorite comforting dinners: a simple brothy soup.

name: Homemade Chicken Soup
ingredients: 2 lb. bone-in, skin-on chicken pieces, preferably a mix of thighs and breasts
1 small yellow onion, coarsely chopped (about 1 1/4 c.)
1 large carrot, peeled, halved lengthwise, sliced 1/8" thick (about 1 c.)
1 tsp. freshly ground black pepper, plus more
instructions: In a large, deep pot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Season chicken on all sides with 2 tsp. salt, then arrange in pot skin side down in a single layer. Cook, undisturbed, until golden brown on one side, about 5 minutes, then turn and cook until golden brown on the other side, about 5 minutes more.

Add stock, thyme, bay leaf, and 2 c. water. Bring to a bare simmer over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of breast registers 165°, 20 to 25 minutes.

Transfer chicken breasts to a cutting board. Continue to cook dark meat about 40 minutes more. Transfer dark meat to cutting board and let cool about 10 minutes. Remove skin and bones and discard. Shred chicken into bite-sized pieces.

Meanwhile, discard thyme and bay leaf. Add onion, celery, and carrot and cook over medium-low heat, adjusting temperature as needed to maintain a bare simmer and stirring occasionally, until just tender, 7 to 8 minutes.
Stir in shredded chicken and pepper; season with remaining 2 tsp. salt, as needed.
Divide soup among bowls. Top with parsley and more pepper.
Make Ahead: Soup can be made 5 days ahead. Store in an airtight container and refrigerate.
description: Our best chicken soup recipe features tender shredded chicken and a rich golden broth for simple, cozy comfort food.

name: Creamy Noodle Salad
ingredients: 1 tbsp. sesame seeds, toasted if desired, plus more for serving
instructions: In a large pot of boiling salted water, cook noodles, stirring occasionally, until just short of al dente according to package directions, 3 to 4 minutes. Drain immediately.
Add noodles to dressing and toss to coat, then add carrots, cabbage, edamame, and sesame seeds and toss until well combined.
Top with scallions, cilantro, and more sesame seeds.
description: Colorful, healthful, and tossed in a creamy spicy mayo dressing, this Creamy Noodle Salad is perfect for when you want to eat summer on a plate—all year round.

name: Antipasto Potato Salad
ingredients: 2 lb. baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved
1 (12-oz.) jar marinated quartered artichoke hearts, drained
Small handful of fresh basil leaves, coarsely chopped
Small handful of fresh parsley leaves, coarsely chopped
instructions: In a large pot, cover potatoes with water; generously season with salt. Bring water to a boil and cook until potatoes are easily pierced with a knife, 12 to 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk oil, vinegar, garlic, mustard, Italian seasoning, pepper, and 1 tsp. salt.
Drain potatoes, add to dressing while still hot, and toss to combine. Let cool for 20 minutes.
Add onion, artichokes, mozzarella, olives, tomatoes, soppressata, basil, and parsley. Gently toss until well combined.
description: If you're looking for a simple potato salad recipe that lightens up the classic creamy dressing, look no further than this flavor-packed antipasto potato salad.

name: Cucumber, Tomato  Onion Salad
ingredients: 2 tbsp. vinegar (red wine, white wine, or rice wine)
1 English cucumber, quartered lengthwise, thinly sliced
1/2 c. coarsely chopped fresh herbs (such as basil, cilantro, dill, mint, and/or parsley)
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk oil, vinegar, salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Add tomatoes, cucumber, and onion and toss well to combine.
Let sit at room temperature at least 15 minutes, or cover and refrigerate up to 12 hours.
Before serving, sprinkle herbs over salad.
description: Cucumber, Tomato & Onion Salad is the perfect refreshing side dish for summer meals.

name: Creamy Cucumber Salad
ingredients: 3 medium cucumbers (about 1 1/2 lb. total), thinly sliced
1 tbsp. finely chopped fresh dill, plus more for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, toss cucumbers and onion.
In a medium bowl, whisk yogurt, lemon juice, and dill until smooth; season with salt and pepper.
Pour dressing over cucumbers and onions and toss to coat. Top with more dill.
description: If you're looking for a creamy version of the classic side, our easy creamy cucumber salad will be your new favorite refreshing summer side dish.

name: Watermelon Caprese
ingredients: 1 small watermelon, cut into 1/2"-thick squares (about 3" x 3")
Extra-virgin olive oil and balsamic glaze, for serving
instructions: On a platter, alternate slices of watermelon and mozzarella. Sprinkle with basil; season with salt and pepper.
Drizzle with oil and balsamic glaze.
description: This watermelon caprese is the most refreshing, sweet take on the classic summer salad.

name: Tomato Salad
ingredients: 1 small red onion, thinly sliced (about 1 c.)
2 lb. ripe tomatoes, cored, cut into 1/2" wedges
1/4 c. finely chopped fresh herbs, such as tarragon, parsley, mint, and/or basil
instructions: In a medium bowl, cover onion with ice water. Let sit, stirring occasionally, until flavor is mellowed, about 10 minutes. Drain and pat dry.

Meanwhile, in a large bowl, whisk vinegar, honey, and mustard until combined. Whisking constantly, slowly stream in oil until emulsified; season with salt and pepper. Add tomatoes, gently stirring to coat. Let marinate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Add feta, herbs, and onions to salad and gently toss to combine. Serve immediately.
description: With juicy tomatoes, a simple red wine vinaigrette, thinly sliced red onion, herbs, and crumbled feta, this salad is the ultimate easy summer side.

name: Waldorf Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, yogurt, and lemon juice.
Add grapes, apple, celery, and parsley and fold until just combined. Season with salt and pepper. Top with walnuts and serve over lettuce.
description: This Waldorf Salad—filled with grapes, walnuts, celeries, and apples all tossed in a creamy dressing—is a perfect classic addition to any holiday.

name: Shrimp Salad
ingredients: Toasted bread or butterhead or romaine lettuce leaves, for serving
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 400°. On a large baking sheet, toss shrimp with oil; season with salt and pepper.
Bake shrimp until completely opaque, 5 to 7 minutes. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool slightly.
In a large bowl, whisk mayonnaise, lemon zest and juice, and mustard; season with salt and pepper. Add shrimp, onion, celery, and dill and toss until combined.
Serve on bread or over lettuce.
description: Our shrimp salad may be based on a classic dish, but this bright and fresh recipe is anything but old school.

name: Black Bean  Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 (15-oz.) can black beans, rinsed and drained
instructions: In a large bowl, toss beans, avocado, onion, jalapeño, corn, tomatoes, and cilantro.
In a small bowl, whisk garlic, lime juice, oil, honey, and cumin; season with salt and pepper.
Pour dressing over bean mixture and toss to combine. Add cotija and toss again to combine; season with salt and pepper, if needed.
description: This easy black bean and corn salad, full of fresh summer produce and a zippy dressing, is great as a side, dip, or taco topping.

name: Summer Couscous Salad
ingredients: Pinch of crushed red pepper flakes
2 Persian cucumbers, halved lengthwise, sliced into half-moons
1 c. fresh or frozen thawed corn kernels
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk oil, parsley, lemon juice, honey, mustard, and red pepper flakes; season with salt and black pepper.
Make Ahead: Dressing can be made 3 days ahead. Store in an airtight container and refrigerate.
In a medium pot over medium-high heat, bring water to a boil. Add couscous and salt. Stir, cover, and remove from heat. Let steam for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork, then transfer to a large bowl.
Add arugula and parsley and stir to combine. Add cucumbers, avocado, tomatoes, corn, and feta. Add dressing and toss to combine. Serve at room temperature.
Make Ahead: Salad (without avocado and dressing) can be made 1 day ahead. Store in an airtight container and refrigerate. Wait to add avocado and dressing until ready to serve.
description: This easy summer couscous salad recipe, loaded with couscous and colorful vegetables, just might become your new favorite summer salad.

name: Cobb Egg Salad
ingredients: 2 tbsp. red wine vinegar or fresh lemon juice
8 hard-boiled eggs, cut into 8 pieces, plus more for garnish
8 strips bacon, cooked, crumbled, plus more for garnish
1/2 c. crumbled blue cheese, plus more for garnish
1/2 c. cherry tomatoes, halved, plus more for garnish
instructions: In a small bowl, stir mayonnaise, yogurt, and vinegar; season with salt and pepper.

In a large bowl, gently combine eggs, bacon, avocado, blue cheese, and tomatoes. Fold in about half of dressing until lightly coated; season with salt and pepper, if needed. Top with chives and more bacon, eggs, blue cheese, and tomatoes. Drizzle with remaining dressing or serve alongside.
description: Classic egg salad is a potluck staple, but this Cobb egg salad—filled with tomatoes, bacon, avocado, and blue cheese—is the perfect upgrade.

name: Greek Salad
ingredients: 1 cucumber, halved lengthwise, thinly sliced into half-moons
1 pt. grape or cherry tomatoes, halved
instructions: In a large bowl, toss cucumber, onion, tomatoes, and olives. Gently fold in feta.
In a small bowl, whisk vinegar, lemon juice, and oregano until combined; season with salt and pepper. Slowly stream in oil, whisking until dressing is smooth and emulsified.
Drizzle dressing over salad and toss again to combine.
description: This traditional Greek salad is made with cherry tomatoes, cucumber, Kalamata olives, thinly sliced red onion, feta, and a simple dressing.

name: Cabbage Caesar
ingredients: 3 anchovy fillets, preferably packed in oil
1 small head of green cabbage (about 2 1/2 lb.), cut into 6 wedges through the core
1 1/4 tsp. kosher salt, divided, plus more
instructions: In a small bowl, mix garlic and lemon juice. Let sit for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, on a cutting board, finely chop anchovies. Sprinkle 1/4 tsp. salt on top and continue to chop, smashing anchovies with the flat edge of the blade, until a paste forms.
To bowl with garlic mixture, add mayonnaise, Worcestershire, pepper, and anchovy paste. Whisk until combined. Taste and add more salt or lemon juice, if needed.
Cover bowl and refrigerate until ready to use.
On a large baking sheet, season cabbage wedges all over with 1 tsp. salt. Let sit for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a large skillet over medium heat, heat 2 Tbsp. oil. Add panko; season with 1/4 tsp. salt. Cook, stirring often, until golden, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl. Wipe out skillet.

In same skillet over medium heat, heat 2 Tbsp. oil. Pat 3 cabbage wedges dry and arrange in pan, cut side down, in a single layer. Sear until browned on the bottom, 1 to 2 minutes. Flip and sear on second cut side until browned, 1 to 2 minutes more. (Cabbage should still be slightly crunchy in the middle.) Return cabbage to baking sheet.
Repeat with remaining oil and cabbage. Let cabbage cool slightly, then remove cores and chop cabbage into 1" square pieces.
In a serving bowl, toss cabbage and half of dressing until lightly coated. Taste and add more dressing as needed, then add half of Parmesan and toss again.
Top with remaining Parmesan and crispy breadcrumbs.
description: Showered with golden bread crumbs and Parmesan, this cabbage Caesar has become my new favorite weeknight salad—and after just one bite, it’ll be yours, too.

name: Lentil Salad
ingredients: 2 1/2 c. cooked green lentils (from about 1 c. dried)
1/2 c. coarsely chopped fresh herbs (such as basil, parsley, mint, and/or chives)
1/4 c. finely chopped roasted nuts (such as walnuts, pecans, almonds, cashews, and/or pistachios)
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk shallot, oil, vinegar, mustard, and lemon zest; season with salt and pepper. Set aside until ready to use.
Make Ahead: Vinaigrette can be made 2 weeks ahead. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate. Shake well before using.

In a large skillet over medium heat, heat oil. Add onion and carrot; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are tender and translucent, about 7 minutes. Add thyme and paprika and cook, stirring, until fragrant, 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Add lentils and vinaigrette to skillet and stir to combine. Let sit 10 minutes to allow lentils to absorb dressing. Add herbs and nuts and toss again just to combine.
description: Packed with protein﻿ and fiber﻿ and dressed in a punchy mustard dressing, you’ll be craving this lentil salad for every lunch﻿ of the week.

name: Arugula Salad
instructions: Make dressing: In a medium bowl, whisk together oil and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper, if using.
Add some dressing to a large bowl. Add arugula, and gently toss to coat. Taste and adjust seasoning. Add more dressing (if desired), then top with Parmesan.
description: This simple, no-frills arugula salad only needs lemon juice, salt, and pepper, and freshly shaved Parmesan to make it shine.

name: Roasted Beet & Goat Cheese Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°. Wrap each beet in foil and place on a baking sheet. (After scrubbing and before wrapping in foil, leave some water clinging to the beets to help speed the cooking.) Roast until tender and a knife or fork inserts easily into each beet, about 1 hour. Let cool enough to handle, then peel and cut into thin wedges.

Meanwhile, make vinaigrette: In a jar, shake together oil, vinegar, maple syrup, and Dijon until fully combined. Season to taste with salt and pepper. (Alternatively, add vinegar, Dijon, syrup, salt, and pepper to a medium-sized bowl. Slowly drizzle in oil while whisking, then season to taste.)
Place arugula in a large serving bowl and lightly dress with vinaigrette. Top with beets, avocado, goat cheese, and walnuts. Toss gently and add more vinaigrette as needed.
description: This is one of our favorite quick lunches or dinners. The beets go great with goat cheese, nuts, and avocado!

name: Thanksgiving Cobb Salad
ingredients: 1 clove garlic, grated or finely chopped
1 1/2 c. roasted sweet potatoes (from about 12 oz. potatoes)
instructions: In a small bowl, combine garlic, lemon juice, and salt. Let sit for five minutes.
Whisk in mayonnaise, sour cream, and buttermilk; season with pepper. Fold in chives; season with salt, if needed. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.
Make-Ahead: Dressing can be made 3 days ahead. Keep refrigerated.
Add bacon to a large cold skillet. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until browned and crisp, 7-9 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

Fill a medium pot with 1/2" water and bring to a simmer over high heat. Using a spoon or tongs, gently lower in eggs, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover. Steam eggs, adjusting heat as needed to maintain a simmer, for 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, fill a large bowl halfway with ice and add cold water to make an ice bath.
Transfer eggs to ice bath. Let cool, then carefully peel. Slice into wedges.
Arrange romaine on a platter. Top with turkey, potatoes, bacon, eggs, pecans, cranberries, and blue cheese; season with pepper. Serve with dressing alongside.
description: Leftover turkey, sweet potatoes, pecans, and cranberries meet Cobb salad superstars bacon, blue cheese, and eggs for a fresh take on Thanksgiving day leftovers.

name: Sweet Potato Salad
ingredients: 3 large sweet potatoes (about 2 lb.), peeled, cubed
1 small red onion, thinly sliced into half moons
2 tbsp. plus 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil, divided
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 400°. On a large baking sheet, toss potatoes and onion in 2 Tbsp. oil; season with salt and pepper. Arrange in a single layer.
Bake potatoes and onion until tender, about 20 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes, then transfer to a large bowl.

Meanwhile, in a small bowl or in a medium liquid measuring cup, whisk vinegar, mustard, honey, cumin, and paprika. Gradually pour in remaining ¼ cup oil, whisking constantly, until emulsified; season with salt and pepper.
Add dressing, cranberries, feta, and parsley to potato mixture and toss to combine. Serve warm or at room temperature.
description: This sweet potato salad—with tangy feta and sharp dried cranberries—is not only a perfect fall side, but makes for a great desk lunch all week long.

name: Tuna Salad
ingredients: 2 (5-oz.) cans white tuna, packed in water
1/2 c. finely chopped dill pickles (from about 2)
1/2 c. finely sliced celery (from about 3/4 large stalk)
1/4 c. finely chopped red onion (from about 1/4 small)
instructions: Drain tuna well and transfer to a small bowl. Using a fork, flake tuna apart into strands.

In a large bowl, whisk mayonnaise, dill, salt, pepper, and 1 tablespoon lemon juice. Stir in pickles, celery, and onion, then fold in tuna. Taste and add remaining 1 tablespoon lemon juice as desired.
Serve on bread or lettuce (if using).
Make Ahead: Tuna salad can be made 3 days ahead. Store in an airtight container and refrigerate.
description: Our favorite tuna salad features finely chopped celery, onion, and pickles along with a light zingy dressing of mayo, lemon juice, and fresh dill.

name: Spinach Salad
ingredients: 1 apple, such as Honeycrisp, thinly sliced
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk garlic, oil, vinegar, and mustard until emulsified; season with salt and pepper.
Make Ahead: Dressing can be made 5 days ahead. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate.
description: Spinach, toasted almonds, feta, and apple combine to make one of our favorite simple salads. Just toss the spinach salad together with our homemade vinaigrette!

name: Marry Me Chicken Dip
ingredients: 1 (8.5-oz.) jar sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, drained, thinly sliced
2 oz. Parmesan, finely grated (about 1 cup), divided
4 oz. white cheddar, finely grated (about 1 cup)
instructions: Arrange a rack in center of oven; preheat to 375°. In a medium, high-sided, cast-iron or other ovenproof skillet over medium heat, heat 3 Tbsp. oil. Season chicken with salt and pepper and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center registers 165°, 5 to 7 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and let cool slightly.
